嘈杂.en: One cannot study in such noise.

草率.zh: 麻烦的开头是他草率的评论。
草率.py: Má fán de kāi tóu shì tā cǎo shuài de píng lùn.
草率.en: The beginning of the trouble was his careless remark.

测量.zh: 我们测量了这条河的深度。
测量.py: Wǒ men cè liáng le zhè tiáo hé de shēn dù.
测量.en: We measured the depth of the river.

测量.py: Sān cì cè liáng, yí cì qiē chú.

策略.zh: 诚实不总是最好的策略。
策略.py: Chéng shí bù zǒng shì zuì hǎo de cè lüè.
策略.en: Honesty is not always the best policy.

策略.zh: 外行谈策略，内行谈后勤。
策略.py: Wài háng tán cè lüè, nèi háng tán hòu qín.
策略.en: Amateurs talk strategy, professionals talk logistics.

策划.py: Tā zài cè huà bù gōng zuò.
策划.en: He works in the planning section.

岔.zh: 我希望您没出什么岔子。
岔.py: Wǒ xī wàng nín méi chū shén me chà zǐ.
岔.en: I hope you did not have any problem.

岔.py: Wǒ men lái dào le chà lù kǒu.
岔.en: We've come to a fork in the road.

柴油.zh: 这个取暖装置用柴油作为燃料。
柴油.py: Zhè ge qǔ nuǎn zhuāng zhì yòng chái yóu zuò wéi rán liào.
柴油.en: This heating equipment uses diesel as fuel.

馋.py: Nǐ shuō dé wǒ chán sǐ le!
馋.en: The way you describe it makes me drool.

产业.zh: 电脑产业的发展一日千里。
产业.py: Diàn nǎo chǎn yè de fā zhǎn yí rì qiān lǐ.
产业.en: The development of the computer industry has been very rapid.

产业.py: Gāng tiě shì zhòng diǎn chǎn yè.

阐述.zh: 他简单地阐述了他的理由。
阐述.py: Tā jiǎn dān dì chǎn shù le tā de lǐ yóu.
阐述.en: He gave his reasons in brief.

颤抖.zh: 恐怖的场面让了他颤抖。
颤抖.py: Kǒng bù de chǎng miàn ràng le tā chàn dǒu.
颤抖.en: The terrible scene made him shudder.

颤抖.zh: 她的声音因愤怒而颤抖。
颤抖.py: Tā de shēng yīn yīn fèn nù ér chàn dǒu.
颤抖.en: Her voice was quivering with anger.

尝试.zh: 尝试在下一次做得更好。
尝试.py: Cháng shì zài xià yí cì zuò dé gèng hǎo.
尝试.en: Try and do better next time.

尝试.zh: 我所有的尝试都失败了。
尝试.py: Wǒ suǒ yǒu de cháng shì dōu shī bài le.
尝试.en: All of my attempts have failed.

偿还.zh: 这个家庭非常贫穷以至于无法偿还贷款。
偿还.py: Zhè ge jiā tíng fēi cháng pín qióng yǐ zhì yú wú fǎ cháng huán dài kuǎn.
偿还.en: The family is too poor to pay back the debts.

场合.zh: 他在公共场合取笑了我。
场合.py: Tā zài gōng gòng chǎng hé qǔ xiào le wǒ.
场合.en: He made fun of me in public.

场合.zh: 他习惯在公众场合说话。
场合.py: Tā xí guàn zài gōng zhòng chǎng hé shuō huà.
场合.en: He's used to speaking in public.

场面.zh: 恐怖的场面让了他颤抖。
场面.py: Kǒng bù de chǎng miàn ràng le tā chàn dǒu.
场面.en: The terrible scene made him shudder.

场面.zh: 令人震惊的场面让他吓得发抖。
场面.py: Lìng rén zhèn jīng de chǎng miàn ràng tā xià dé fā dǒu.
场面.en: The terrible scene made him tremble in fear.

场所.zh: 在公共场所请控制自己不要吸烟。
场所.py: Zài gōng gòng chǎng suǒ qǐng kòng zhì zì jǐ bú yào xī yān.
场所.en: Please refrain from smoking in public places.

场所.zh: 海滩是一个供孩子们玩乐的理想场所。
场所.py: Hǎi tān shì yí gè gòng hái zi men wán lè de lǐ xiǎng chǎng suǒ.
场所.en: The beach is an ideal place for children to play.

畅销.zh: 她抓紧时间地阅读一本畅销小说。
畅销.py: Tā zhuā jǐn shí jiān dì yuè dú yì běn chàng xiāo xiǎo shuō.
畅销.en: She lost no time in reading a best-selling novel.

畅销.zh: 宗教不过是有组织的迷信加上一本畅销书。
畅销.py: Zōng jiào bú guò shì yǒu zǔ zhī de mí xìn jiā shàng yì běn chàng xiāo shū.
畅销.en: Religion is just organised superstition with a bestseller.

敞开.py: Wǒ zhǐ shì xiǎng chǎng kāi xīn fēi.
敞开.en: I just need to get something off my chest.

敞开.py: Chǎng kāi nǐ de xīn fēi.

钞票.zh: 我经常用信用卡，而不是钞票。
钞票.py: Wǒ jīng cháng yòng xìn yòng kǎ, ér bú shì chāo piào.
钞票.en: I usually use a credit card instead of cash.

钞票.py: Zhè zhāng chāo piào shì jiǎ zào de.

超级.zh: 汤姆和玛丽在超级市场。
超级.py: Tāng mǔ hé mǎ lì zài chāo jí shì chǎng.
超级.en: Tom is at the shopping center with Mary.

超级.py: Chāo jí shì chǎng zài shí diǎn kāi mén.
超级.en: The supermarket opens at ten o'clock.

超越.py: Tā néng gòu chāo yuè suǒ yǒu kùn nán.
Zhè liàng chē chāo yuè le wǒ.

嘲笑.zh: 我今天在学校被嘲笑了。
嘲笑.py: Wǒ jīn tiān zài xué xiào bèi cháo xiào le.
嘲笑.en: I was laughed at in school today.

嘲笑.zh: 我们因为那件事嘲笑他。
嘲笑.py: Wǒ men yīn wèi nà jiàn shì cháo xiào tā.
嘲笑.en: We ridiculed him because of that thing.

潮流.py: Tā shì cháo liú de nú lì.
潮流.en: She is a slave of fashion.

潮流.zh: 今年的时尚潮流完全不同于去年。
潮流.py: Jīn nián de shí shàng cháo liú wán quán bù tóng yú qù nián.
潮流.en: This year's fashions are completely different from last year's.

潮湿.zh: 夏天总是闷热而又潮湿。
潮湿.py: Xià tiān zǒng shì mēn rè ér yòu cháo shī.
潮湿.en: Summer is always hot and humid.

潮湿.zh: 台湾的夏天很潮湿闷热。
潮湿.py: Tái wān de xià tiān hěn cháo shī mēn rè.

撤销.zh: 亨利因为伤了手臂而被撤销了比赛资格。
撤销.py: Hēng lì yīn wèi shāng le shǒu bì ér bèi chè xiāo le bǐ sài zī gé.
撤销.en: Harry had to back out of the competition because of a broken arm.

沉闷.zh: 这位老教授的讲座冗长而沉闷。
沉闷.py: Zhè wèi lǎo jiào shòu de jiǎng zuò rǒng cháng ér chén mèn.
沉闷.en: The old professor's lectures are long-winded and ponderous.

沉闷.zh: 咖啡让我在沉闷的音乐会中保持清醒。
沉闷.py: Kā fēi ràng wǒ zài chén mèn de yīn yuè huì zhōng bǎo chí qīng xǐng.
沉闷.en: The coffee enabled me to stay awake during the dull concert.

沉着.py: Mǎ lì lā yīn chén zhuó liǎn.

沉重.zh: 她的脚步沉重地落在木地板上。
沉重.py: Tā de jiǎo bù chén zhòng dì luò zài mù dì bǎn shàng.
沉重.en: Her footsteps fell ponderously on the wooden floor.

沉重.zh: 我们未曾说出口的话，份量沉重。
沉重.py: Wǒ men wèi céng shuō chū kǒu de huà, fèn liàng chén zhòng.
沉重.en: The weight of our unspoken words is heavy.

陈述.zh: 我想撤回我之前的陈述。
陈述.py: Wǒ xiǎng chè huí wǒ zhī qián de chén shù.
陈述.en: I would like to retract my previous statement.

陈述.zh: 我开始怀疑他陈述的准确性。
陈述.py: Wǒ kāi shǐ huái yí tā chén shù de zhǔn què xìng.
陈述.en: I began to doubt the accuracy of his statement.

成本.zh: 这是一部低成本的电影。
成本.py: Zhè shì yí bù dī chéng běn de diàn yǐng.
Tā men zhèng nǔ lì jiàng dī chéng běn.
成本.en: They are trying to keep costs down.

成交.zh: 鲁莽的开车容易造成交通事故
成交.py: Lǔ mǎng de kāi chē róng yì zào chéng jiāo tōng shì gù
成交.en: Reckless driving can easily lead to an accident.

成天.zh: 我们会把人间变成天堂。
成天.py: Wǒ men huì bǎ rén jiān biàn chéng tiān táng.
成天.en: We will turn the world into a paradise.

成员.zh: 委员会由四个成员组成。
成员.py: Wěi yuán huì yóu sì gè chéng yuán zǔ chéng.
成员.en: The committee consists of four members.

成员.zh: 他是教区委员会的成员。
成员.py: Tā shì jiào qū wěi yuán huì de chéng yuán.
成员.en: He is a member of the parochial board.

呈现.py: Tā de liǎn shàng chéng xiàn le fèn nù.

呈现.zh: 用本生灯加热鉀，火焰就会呈现淡紫色。
呈现.py: Yòng běn shēng dēng jiā rè jiǎ, huǒ yàn jiù huì chéng xiàn dàn zǐ sè.
呈现.en: Potassium, heated with a Bunsen burner, gives the flame a lilac color.

承诺.zh: 父母教育我要遵守承诺。
承诺.py: Fù mǔ jiào yù wǒ yào zūn shǒu chéng nuò.
承诺.en: My parents teach me to abide by my promises.

承诺.py: Bù zūn shǒu chéng nuò shì kě chǐ de.
承诺.en: It is a shame not to keep your promise.

诚挚.py: Qǐng jiē shòu wǒ chéng zhì de qiàn yì.

诚挚.zh: 请接受我对您今天的成功最诚挚的祝贺。
诚挚.py: Qǐng jiē shòu wǒ duì nín jīn tiān de chéng gōng zuì chéng zhì de zhù hè.
诚挚.en: Please accept my sincere congratulations on your success today.

城堡.zh: 图片的背景是一座城堡。
城堡.py: Tú piàn de bèi jǐng shì yí zuò chéng bǎo.
城堡.en: There is a castle in the background of the picture.

城堡.zh: 城堡如今已经成了废墟。
城堡.py: Chéng bǎo rú jīn yǐ jīng chéng le fèi xū.
城堡.en: The castle is now in ruins.

惩罚.zh: 触犯法律的人受到惩罚。
惩罚.py: Chù fàn fǎ lǜ de rén shòu dào chéng fá.
惩罚.en: People who break the law are punished.

惩罚.zh: 他将面临什么样的惩罚？
惩罚.py: Tā jiāng miàn lín shén me yàng de chéng fá?

澄清.py: Wǒ men xiàng chéng qīng zhè ge wèn tí
澄清.en: We want to clear up this problem.

澄清.zh: 让我们来澄清一下这个问题。
澄清.py: Ràng wǒ men lái chéng qīng yí xià zhè ge wèn tí.

橙.zh: 地球的外形和橙子相似。
橙.py: Dì qiú de wài xíng hé chéng zǐ xiāng sì.
橙.en: The globe is similar in shape to an orange.

橙.zh: 把橙子从冰箱里拿出来。
橙.py: Bǎ chéng zǐ cóng bīng xiāng lǐ ná chū lái.
橙.en: Take the oranges out of the fridge.

秤.zh: 请把你的行李放在这秤上。
秤.py: Qǐng bǎ nǐ de xíng li fàng zài zhè chèng shàng.
秤.en: Please put your baggage on this scale.

吃苦.py: Hào qí huì chī kǔ tóu de.

吃力.py: Tāng mǔ chī lì dì qù pèng jiǎo zhǐ.
吃力.en: Tom struggled to touch his toes.

池塘.zh: 他扔一块石头到池塘里。
池塘.py: Tā rēng yí kuài shí tou dào chí táng lǐ.
池塘.en: He threw a stone into the pond.

池塘.py: Xī shuǐ liú jìn zhè ge chí táng lǐ.
池塘.en: The stream flows into the pond.

迟缓.zh: 行动迟缓的蓝色美洲狮从勤奋的猫身下滑过。
迟缓.py: Xíng dòng chí huǎn de lán sè měi zhōu shī cóng qín fèn de māo shēn xià huá guò.
迟缓.en: The slow blue puma slides under the diligent cat.

持久.zh: 生活中绝对没有什么是持久的。
持久.py: Shēng huó zhōng jué duì méi yǒu shén me shì chí jiǔ de.
持久.en: Absolutely nothing is permanent in life.

赤道.zh: 那条船昨天穿过了赤道。
赤道.py: Nà tiáo chuán zuó tiān chuān guò le chì dào.
赤道.en: That ship crossed the equator yesterday.

赤道.zh: 赤道把地球分为两个半球。
赤道.py: Chì dào bǎ dì qiú fēn wéi liǎng gè bàn qiú.
赤道.en: The equator divides the globe into two hemispheres.

赤字.zh: 这场生意正面临着赤字。
赤字.py: Zhè chǎng shēng yì zhèng miàn lín zhe chì zì.
赤字.en: The business is in the red.

赤字.py: Wǒ men qù nián yù dào le chì zì.
赤字.en: We went into the red last year.

充当.py: Wǒ wèi nǐ chōng dāng dǎo yóu.
充当.en: I'll act as a guide for you.

充沛.zh: 我小睡后就感到精力充沛。
充沛.py: Wǒ xiǎo shuì hòu jiù gǎn dào jīng lì chōng pèi.
充沛.en: A little nap and, just like that, I'm as fresh as a daisy.

充沛.zh: 他不像从前那样精力充沛了。
充沛.py: Tā bú xiàng cóng qián nà yàng jīng lì chōng pèi le.
充沛.en: He isn't as energetic as he once was.

充足.py: Chōng zú de xiū xi shí fēn zhòng yào.
充足.en: It's very important to get enough rest.

充足.py: Liáng shí gōng yìng shí fēn chōng zú.
充足.en: There is an abundant supply of foodstuffs.

冲动.zh: 他叫自己的妻子不要冲动购物。
冲动.py: Tā jiào zì jǐ de qī zǐ bú yào chōng dòng gòu wù.
冲动.en: He told his wife to stop impulsively shopping.

冲击.zh: 魅力冲击视觉，美德征服心灵。
冲击.py: Mèi lì chōng jī shì jué, měi dé zhēng fú xīn líng.
冲击.en: Charms strike the sight, but merit wins the soul.

冲突.zh: 他们的冲突终于平息了。
冲突.py: Tā men de chōng tū zhōng yú píng xī le.
冲突.en: Finally, the discord between them came to an end.

冲突.zh: 他们有时候有矛盾冲突
冲突.py: Tā men yǒu shí hòu yǒu máo dùn chōng tū
冲突.en: Every now and then they clash over their differences.

崇拜.zh: 学生们崇拜新的英语老师。
崇拜.py: Xué shēng men chóng bài xīn de yīng yǔ lǎo shī.
崇拜.en: The students adore the new English teacher.

崇拜.py: Ān nī yǒu xǔ duō chóng bài zhě.

稠密.zh: 西里西亚省是波兰人口稠密度最大的地区。
稠密.py: Xī lǐ xī yà shěng shì bō lán rén kǒu chóu mì dù zuì dà de dì qū.
稠密.en: The Silesian Voivodeship is the most densely populated region of Poland.

筹备.zh: 她精心筹备了这个派对。
筹备.py: Tā jīng xīn chóu bèi le zhè ge pài duì.
筹备.en: She made elaborate preparations for the party.

筹备.py: Tā zhèng zài chóu bèi yí cì lǚ xíng.
筹备.en: He is making preparations for a trip.

出路.py: Nà shì wéi yī de chū lù.
出路.en: It was the only way to go.

出卖.py: Tā xī shēng shēng mìng, chū mài zǔ zhī.
出卖.en: He sacrificed his life and betrayed the organization.

出卖.zh: 他后悔对敌人出卖了他的国家。
出卖.py: Tā hòu huǐ duì dí rén chū mài le tā de guó jiā.
出卖.en: He repented having betrayed his country to the enemy.

出身.zh: 但是歌手并不否认她的出身。
出身.py: Dàn shì gē shǒu bìng bù fǒu rèn tā de chū shēn.
出身.en: However, the singer does not deny her ancestry.
I grew up in a poor family.

出神.zh: 他的武功已经达到了出神入化的境界。
出神.py: Tā de wǔ gōng yǐ jīng dá dào le chū shén rù huà de jìng jiè.
出神.en: His martial arts prowess has already reached a level of sublime perfection.

出神.zh: 汤姆出神地一边看着天空一边吸着香烟。
出神.py: Tāng mǔ chū shén dì yì biān kàn zhe tiān kōng yì biān xī zhe xiāng yān.
出神.en: Lost in thought, Tom watched the sky as he smoked a cigarette.

出洋相.zh: 你要是再给我们公司出洋相，我可就不客气了。
出洋相.py: Nǐ yào shi zài gěi wǒ men gōng sī chū yáng xiàng, wǒ kě jiù bú kè qì le.
出洋相.en: If you make fun of our company again, we certainly won’t be polite to you.

储备.zh: 面粉是那些你始终应该储备在厨房里的产品之一。
储备.py: Miàn fěn shì nà xiē nǐ shǐ zhōng yīng gāi chǔ bèi zài chú fáng lǐ de chǎn pǐn zhī yī.
储备.en: Flour is one of those products you should always have in your kitchen.

储蓄.py: Wǒ xiǎng kāi gè chǔ xù zhàng hù.
储蓄.en: I'd like to open a savings account.

储蓄.zh: 如果你想安享晚年，现在就要开始储蓄了。
储蓄.py: Rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng ān xiǎng wǎn nián, xiàn zài jiù yào kāi shǐ chǔ xù le.
储蓄.en: If you want security in your old age, begin saving now.

处境.py: Wǒ wán quán lǐ jiě nǐ dé chǔ jìng.
处境.en: I can understand your position perfectly.

处境.zh: 你可以描述一下当时的处境吗？
处境.py: Nǐ kě yǐ miáo shù yí xià dāng shí de chǔ jìng ma?
处境.en: Can you describe the situation you were in?

处置.zh: 可怜的人民任凭残暴的独裁者处置。
处置.py: Kě lián de rén mín rèn píng cán bào de dú cái zhě chǔ zhì.
处置.en: The poor people were at the mercy of the cruel dictator.

处置.zh: 在新加坡，鞭刑是处置犯人的方法之一。
处置.py: Zài xīn jiā pō, biān xíng shì chǔ zhì fàn rén de fāng fǎ zhī yī.
处置.en: In Singapore, one way to punish a criminal is to whip him or her.

触犯.zh: 触犯法律的人受到惩罚。
触犯.py: Chù fàn fǎ lǜ de rén shòu dào chéng fá.
触犯.en: People who break the law are punished.

触犯.zh: 他触犯会规，被踢出了俱乐部。
触犯.py: Tā chù fàn huì guī, bèi tī chū le jù lè bù.
触犯.en: He was excluded from the club for infractions of the rules.

川流不息.zh: 移民川流不息地进入这个国家。
川流不息.py: Yí mín chuān liú bù xī dì jìn rù zhè ge guó jiā.
川流不息.en: The immigrants entered the country in a steady flow.

穿越.zh: 现在穿越剧为什么这么火？
穿越.py: Xiàn zài chuān yuè jù wèi shén me zhè me huǒ?
穿越.en: Why are series about time travel so popular at the moment?

穿越.py: Yǒu de niǎo kě yǐ chuān yuè yīn zhàng.
穿越.en: Some birds can break the sound barrier.

传授.zh: 花代价所换来的一点才智，抵过别人传授的数倍不止。
传授.py: Huā dài jià suǒ huàn lái de yì diǎn cái zhì, dǐ guò bié rén chuán shòu de shù bèi bù zhǐ.
传授.en: An ounce of wit that is bought is worse a pound that is taught.

串.py: Nǐ men xiǎng chī jǐ chuàn kǎo yáng ròu?
串.en: How many kebabs will you have?

串.py: Dàn shì wǒ bú huì kǎo kǎo ròu chuàn!
串.en: But I don't know how to cook kebabs!

床单.zh: 她在她的床上铺了床单。
床单.py: Tā zài tā de chuáng shàng pù le chuáng dān.
床单.en: She put sheets on her bed.

床单.zh: 你可以给我一张床单吗？
床单.py: Nǐ kě yǐ gěi wǒ yì zhāng chuáng dān ma?
床单.en: Can you give me a sheet?

幢.zh: 我一个人住在这幢房子里。
幢.py: Wǒ yí gè rén zhù zài zhè zhuàng fáng zi lǐ.
幢.en: I live in this house by myself.

幢.zh: 那幢房子看起来被遗弃了。
幢.py: Nà zhuàng fáng zi kàn qǐ lái bèi yí qì le.

创立.zh: 他在五年前创立了这所学校。
创立.py: Tā zài wǔ nián qián chuàng lì le zhè suǒ xué xiào.
创立.en: He founded the school five years ago.

创立.zh: 哈佛大学是在一六三六年创立的。
创立.py: Hā fó dà xué shì zài yī liù sān liù nián chuàng lì de.

创新.py: Zhè shì gè chuàng xīn de jiě fǎ.

创新.zh: 创新创新本身就提升了创新。
创新.py: Chuàng xīn chuàng xīn běn shēn jiù tí shēng le chuàng xīn.
创新.en: Creating creativity itself is improving creativity.

创作.zh: 你是何时创作这幅画的?
创作.py: Nǐ shì hé shí chuàng zuò zhè fú huà de ?

创作.zh: 汤姆三年前创作了那首歌。
创作.py: Tāng mǔ sān nián qián chuàng zuò le nà shǒu gē.
创作.en: Tom wrote that song three years ago.

吹牛.en: He likes to throw the bull.

垂直.zh: 垂直的金发滑过她的肩膀。
垂直.py: Chuí zhí de jīn fā huá guò tā de jiān bǎng.
垂直.en: Straight golden hair slides over her shoulder.

锤.zh: 锤子与镰刀代表共产主义。
锤.py: Chuí zǐ yǔ lián dāo dài biǎo gòng chǎn zhǔ yì.
锤.en: The hammer and sickle symbolizes communism.

锤.py: Wǒ yǒu bù tóng chǐ cùn de chuí zǐ.
锤.en: I have hammers of different sizes.

纯粹.zh: 我纯粹只是喜欢交朋友。
纯粹.py: Wǒ chún cuì zhǐ shì xǐ huan jiāo péng yǒu.
纯粹.en: I really just want to make friends.

纯粹.zh: 我去那个派对纯粹是为了交际。
纯粹.py: Wǒ qù nà ge pài duì chún cuì shì wèi le jiāo jì.
纯粹.en: I attended the party just to be sociable.

纯洁.py: Tā yǒu yì kē chún jié de xīn.

纯洁.zh: 问题不是政治不纯洁，而是整个政治博弈已经腐朽。
纯洁.py: Wèn tí bú shì zhèng zhì bù chún jié, ér shì zhěng gè zhèng zhì bó yì yǐ jīng fǔ xiǔ.
纯洁.en: The trouble is not with impure politics, but that the whole game of politics is rotten.

词汇.zh: 你读那本书需要大量词汇。
词汇.py: Nǐ dú nà běn shū xū yào dà liàng cí huì.
词汇.en: You need a large vocabulary to read that book.

词汇.zh: 那个日文词汇没有对应的英文。
词汇.py: Nà ge rì wén cí huì méi yǒu duì yìng de yīng wén.
词汇.en: That Japanese word has no equivalent in English.

次序.zh: 他主张的是出生的先后次序和个性有很密切的关系。
次序.py: Tā zhǔ zhāng de shì chū shēng de xiān hòu cì xù hé gè xìng yǒu hěn mì qiè de guān xì.
次序.en: His claim is that there is a close relation between birth order and personality.

刺.zh: 没有玫瑰花是不长刺的。
刺.py: Méi yǒu méi guī huā shì bù cháng cì de.
刺.en: There is no such thing as a thornless rose.

刺.zh: 瑪莉不是有一些刺青吗？
刺.py: Mǎ lì bú shì yǒu yì xiē cì qīng ma?
刺.en: Mary has a few tattoos, doesn't she?

从容不迫.zh: 他做事总是从容不迫的。
从容不迫.py: Tā zuò shì zǒng shì cóng róng bú pò de.
从容不迫.en: He always takes his time in everything that he does.

丛.zh: 孩子们在丛林中迷路了。
丛.py: Hái zi men zài cóng lín zhōng mí lù le.
丛.en: The children got lost in the jungle.

丛.py: Mì fēng zài huā cóng zhōng fēi xíng.
丛.en: Bees are flying among the flowers.

粗鲁.zh: 他这样粗鲁，该棒打几下。
粗鲁.py: Tā zhè yàng cū lǔ, gāi bàng dǎ jǐ xià.
粗鲁.en: He deserves six of the best for being so rude.

粗鲁.py: Tā yuán liàng le nán hái de cū lǔ.
粗鲁.en: She forgave the boy for his rudeness.

窜.zh: 小偷迅速地窜入了人群。
窜.py: Xiǎo tōu xùn sù dì cuàn rù le rén qún.
窜.en: The thief whipped out into the crowd.

脆弱.py: Wǒ men hái shì cuì ruò bù kān.

脆弱.zh: 我们的爱情就像肥皂泡一样脆弱。
脆弱.py: Wǒ men de ài qíng jiù xiàng féi zào pào yí yàng cuì ruò.
脆弱.en: Our love affair was as short-lived as a soap bubble.

搓.py: Bāng wǒ cuō yí xià bèi hǎo ma?

挫折.zh: 一个人得遇到多大的挫折才会自杀？
挫折.py: Yí gè rén dé yù dào duō dà de cuò zhé cái huì zì shā?
挫折.en: How frustrated must a person be to commit suicide?

搭.zh: 或者你必须搭这辆公车?
搭.py: Huò zhě nǐ bì xū dā zhè liàng gōng chē ?
搭.en: Or do you have to take the bus?

搭.zh: 搭帐篷花了我们半小时。
搭.py: Dā zhàng péng huā le wǒ men bàn xiǎo shí.
搭.en: It took us half an hour to set up the tent.

搭档.zh: 羊屁股先生可没告诉我还有搭档。
搭档.py: Yáng pì gǔ xiān shēng kě méi gào sù wǒ hái yǒu dā dàng.
搭档.en: Mr. Goat Butt never told me there would be a partner.

搭配.py: Nán nǚ dā pèi, gàn huó bú lèi.
搭配.en: When man and woman unite, work is no longer as tiring.

搭配.py: Wǒ yòng yù mǐ dā pèi jiāng dòu.
搭配.en: I combined black-eyed beans with corn.

达成.zh: 那个目标是无法达成的。
达成.py: Nà ge mù biāo shì wú fǎ dá chéng de.
达成.en: That aim is impossible to attain.

达成.zh: 他最终达成了他的目标。
达成.py: Tā zuì zhōng dá chéng le tā de mù biāo.
达成.en: In the end he achieved his objective.

答辩.py: Nǐ zài zhǔn bèi lùn wén dá biàn ma?
答辩.en: Are you preparing for your thesis defense?

答辩.zh: 下个月就要进行硕士论文答辩了。
答辩.py: Xià gè yuè jiù yào jìn xíng shuò shì lùn wén dá biàn le.
答辩.en: The defense of the master thesis is just happening next month.

答复.py: Wǒ děng dài tā duì wǒ de dá fù
答复.en: I'm waiting for her to answer me.

答复.py: Tā gěi le yǐ xià de dá fù.

打包.zh: 她帮我打包我的手提箱。
打包.py: Tā bāng wǒ dǎ bāo wǒ de shǒu tí xiāng.
打包.en: She helped me pack my suitcase.

打包.py: Kàn lái wǒ men dé dǎ bāo le.
打包.en: I think we need a doggy bag.

打击.py: Zhè huì dǎ jī wǒ men de shēng yì.

打击.zh: 这对他来说是致命的打击。
打击.py: Zhè duì tā lái shuō shì zhì mìng de dǎ jī.
打击.en: To him this is a deadly blow.

打架.py: Liǎng gè nán rén zài jiē shàng dǎ jià.
打架.en: Two men were fighting on the street.

打架.py: Tǎo lùn zuì hòu biàn chéng le dǎ jià.
打架.en: The argument ended in a fight.

打量.zh: 他把我从头到脚打量了一番。
打量.py: Tā bǎ wǒ cóng tóu dào jiǎo dǎ liang le yì fān.
打量.en: He stared at me from head to foot.

打猎.py: Tā de bó fù hěn xǐ huan dǎ liè.

打仗.zh: 饿着肚子是没法打仗的。
打仗.py: È zhe dù zǐ shì méi fǎ dǎ zhàng de.
打仗.en: You can't fight on an empty stomach.

打仗.py: Hěn duō nián qīng rén qù le dǎ zhàng.
打仗.en: Many young men went to war.

大不了.py: Zhè méi shén me dà bù liǎo de.
Nà méi shén me dà bù liǎo de.

大伙儿.py: Dà huǒ ér wán dé gāo xìng ma?

大厦.py: Niǔ yuē chōng mǎn zhe gāo lóu dà shà.
大厦.en: New York bristles with towering buildings.

大厦.zh: 摩天大厦里的电梯是至关重要的。
大厦.py: Mó tiān dà shà lǐ de diàn tī shì zhì guān zhòng yào de.
大厦.en: The elevators in a skyscraper are vital systems.

大体.zh: 他的意见大体上说是对的。
大体.py: Tā de yì jiàn dà tǐ shàng shuō shì duì de.

大体.zh: 英国人大体上说都是保守的。
大体.py: Yīng guó rén dà tǐ shàng shuō dōu shì bǎo shǒu de.
大体.en: Englishmen are, on the whole, conservative.

大意.zh: 他责备了我的粗心大意。
大意.py: Tā zé bèi le wǒ de cū xīn dà yi.

大意.zh: 粗心大意的人很容易犯错。
大意.py: Cū xīn dà yi de rén hěn róng yì fàn cuò.
大意.en: A careless person is apt to make mistakes.

大致.py: Zhè ge xiàng mù wǒ dà zhì liǎo jiě.
大致.en: I know about this project for the most part.

大致.py: Wǒ dà zhì shàng tóng yì tā.

逮捕.zh: 他超速驾驶，被警察逮捕了。
逮捕.py: Tā chāo sù jià shǐ, bèi jǐng chá dǎi bǔ le.
逮捕.en: The policeman arrested him for speeding.

逮捕.zh: 警察因酒后驾驶逮捕了他。
逮捕.py: Jǐng chá yīn jiǔ hòu jià shǐ dǎi bǔ le tā.
逮捕.en: The policeman arrested him for drunken driving.

代价.zh: 这是他的愚蠢付出代价了。
代价.py: Zhè shì tā de yú chǔn fù chū dài jià le.
代价.en: It is foolish of him to pay for it again.

代价.py: Tāng mǔ míng bái shēng cún de dài jià.
代价.en: Tom understands what it takes to survive.

代理.py: Wǒ shì nǐ de dài lǐ rén.

代理.zh: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。
代理.py: Wàn yī yǒu jǐn jí qíng kuàng, lián xì wǒ de dài lǐ rén.
代理.en: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.

带领.zh: 幼儿园里，老师正在带领小朋友们嘻戏。
带领.py: Yòu ér yuán lǐ, lǎo shī zhèng zài dài lǐng xiǎo péng yǒu men xī xì.
带领.en: The teachers are playing games with students in the kindergarten.

担保.py: Wǒ dāng nǐ de dān bǎo rén .

胆怯.py: Tāng mǔ hài xiū dǎn qiè.

诞生.zh: 这个传统在中国诞生了。
诞生.py: Zhè ge chuán tǒng zài zhōng guó dàn shēng le.

诞生.zh: 我们是为了死亡而诞生的。
诞生.py: Wǒ men shì wèi le sǐ wáng ér dàn shēng de.

弹性.zh: 这片人造草皮踩在脚下感觉富有弹性。
弹性.py: Zhè piàn rén zào cǎo pí cǎi zài jiǎo xià gǎn jué fù yǒu tán xìng.
弹性.en: The astroturf feels springy under your feet.

淡季.zh: 在旅游淡季，机票会很便宜。
淡季.py: Zài lǚ yóu dàn jì, jī piào huì hěn pián yi.
淡季.en: When out of tourist season, the tickets will be cheap.

淡水.zh: 我相信这条鱼是淡水鱼。
淡水.py: Wǒ xiāng xìn zhè tiáo yú shì dàn shuǐ yú.
淡水.en: I believe this fish is a freshwater fish.

淡水.py: Nà yú qī xī zài dàn shuǐ yù zhōng.
淡水.en: That fish lives in fresh water.

当场.zh: 汤姆被卡车撞到而且当场死亡。
当场.py: Tāng mǔ bèi kǎ chē zhuàng dào ér qiě dāng chǎng sǐ wáng.
当场.en: Tom was hit by a truck and died instantly.

当初.zh: 我当初要是买音乐会的票就好了。
当初.py: Wǒ dāng chū yào shi mǎi yīn yuè huì de piào jiù hǎo le.
当初.en: I wish I had bought a ticket for the concert.

当初.zh: 汤姆说我当初应该去找玛丽帮我。
当初.py: Tāng mǔ shuō wǒ dāng chū yīng gāi qù zhǎo mǎ lì bāng wǒ.
当初.en: Tom said that I should've asked Mary for help.

当前.zh: 文章开头讲了当前的形势。
当前.py: Wén zhāng kāi tóu jiǎng le dāng qián de xíng shì.
当前.en: The article begins with an account of the current situation.

当前.zh: 根据当前的状况，这个项目绝对会成功。
当前.py: Gēn jù dāng qián de zhuàng kuàng, zhè ge xiàng mù jué duì huì chéng gōng.
当前.en: Judging from the current situation, this project is sure to succeed.

当心.py: Zài zhè fù jìn dāng xīn xiǎo tōu.
当心.en: Watch out for thieves around here.

当心.zh: 如果你能当心些那就更好了。
当心.py: Rú guǒ nǐ néng dāng xīn xiē nà jiù gèng hǎo le.
当心.en: If you could be a bit more careful, that would be even better.

当选.py: Tā dāng xuǎn wèi wěi yuán huì zhǔ xí.
当选.en: She was elected chairman of the committee.

当选.zh: 每个人都希望他当选州长。
当选.py: Měi gè rén dōu xī wàng tā dāng xuǎn zhōu zhǎng.
当选.en: Everybody wished he had been elected governor.

党.zh: 我自愿加入中国共产党。
党.py: Wǒ zì yuàn jiā rù zhōng guó gòng chǎn dǎng.
党.en: I willingly join the Chinese Communist Party.

党.zh: 没有共产党就没有新中国
党.py: Méi yǒu gòng chǎn dǎng jiù méi yǒu xīn zhōng guó
党.en: There would be no New China without the communist party.

档案.zh: 我在下载这份网络档案。
档案.py: Wǒ zài xià zài zhè fèn wǎng luò dàng àn.
Wǒ xū yào qù chá yí xià dàng àn.
档案.en: I need to have a quick look at the files.

档次.zh: 我们去一家档次再高点儿的餐厅怎么样？
档次.py: Wǒ men qù yì jiā dàng cì zài gāo diǎn ér de cān tīng zěn me yàng?
档次.en: Shall we go to a little more upscale restaurant?

导向.zh: 台湾是出口导向的经济体。
导向.py: Tái wān shì chū kǒu dǎo xiàng de jīng jì tǐ.

岛屿.zh: 这个岛屿位于日本的西边。
岛屿.py: Zhè ge dǎo yǔ wèi yú rì běn de xī biān.
岛屿.en: The island lies to the west of Japan.

岛屿.py: Tái wān shì yí gè dǎo yǔ guó jiā.

倒闭.py: Gōng sī hěn kuài jiù yào dǎo bì le.
倒闭.en: The company's going to go bankrupt really soon.

倒闭.zh: 公司由于缺乏资本倒闭了。
倒闭.py: Gōng sī yóu yú quē fá zī běn dǎo bì le.
倒闭.en: The firm went under due to lack of capital.

盗窃.zh: 汤姆指认了盗窃的职员。
盗窃.py: Tāng mǔ zhǐ rèn le dào qiè de zhí yuán.
盗窃.en: Tom accused the employee of stealing.

盗窃.zh: 我们走开的时候，房子被盗窃了。
盗窃.py: Wǒ men zǒu kāi de shí hòu, fáng zi bèi dào qiè le.
盗窃.en: Our house was robbed while we were away.

地步.zh: 都到了这地步，跟他争论也没有用。
地步.py: Dōu dào le zhè dì bù, gēn tā zhēng lùn yě méi yǒu yòng.
地步.en: There was no point in arguing with him at this point.

地步.zh: 他还没有傻到相信这个故事的地步。
地步.py: Tā hái méi yǒu shǎ dào xiāng xìn zhè ge gù shì de dì bù.
地步.en: He is not such a fool as to believe that story.

地势.zh: 天行健，君子以自强不息；地势坤，君子以厚德载物。
地势.py: Tiān xíng jiàn, jūn zǐ yǐ zì qiáng bù xī; dì shì kūn, jūn zǐ yǐ hòu dé zài wù.
地势.en: As heaven maintains its vigorous motion, the noble person should strive for continuous self-improvement. As the earth's nature is receptive and nurturing, the noble person should cultivate great virtue to support and carry all things.

得力.py: Zhè ge yào hěn dé lì.

得罪.py: Tā men sì hū dé zuì le cái pàn.
得罪.en: They seemed to offend the referee.

得罪.zh: 小草间的对话不要得罪大树。
得罪.py: Xiǎo cǎo jiān de duì huà bú yào dé zuì dà shù.
得罪.en: In conversation among the small grasses, do not offend the big tree.

灯笼.py: Dēng long zài shù zhī shàng diào zhe.
灯笼.en: The lamp was suspended from the branch of a tree.

登陆.zh: 可能我的孙子会是登陆火星的第一人。
登陆.py: Kě néng wǒ de sūn zi huì shì dēng lù huǒ xīng de dì yī rén.
登陆.en: Maybe my grandchild will be the first person to set foot on Mars.

等级.zh: 形式是暂时的，等级才是永恒的。
等级.py: Xíng shì shì zàn shí de, děng jí cái shì yǒng héng de.

繁殖.zh: 数月后，牠们回到了北极的繁殖地。
繁殖.py: Shù yuè hòu, tā men huí dào le běi jí de fán zhí dì.
繁殖.en: A few months later they return to their breeding grounds in the Arctic.

反驳.zh: 我不打算反驳你的论点。
反驳.py: Wǒ bù dǎ suàn fǎn bó nǐ de lùn diǎn.
反驳.en: I won't try to refute your theses.

反驳.zh: 汤姆无法反驳瑪丽的论点。
反驳.py: Tāng mǔ wú fǎ fǎn bó mǎ lì de lùn diǎn.
反驳.en: Tom was unable to refute Mary's arguments.

反常.py: Zhè jǐ nián de tiān qì hěn fǎn cháng.
反常.en: We've been having strange weather the past few years.

反常.py: Nǐ jīn ér yǒu diǎn fǎn cháng .
反常.en: There's something off about you today.

反动.py: Fǎn dòng pài bèi rén mín suǒ tuī fān.
反动.en: Reactionary groups were overthrown by the people.

反动.zh: 保守分子不一定是反动分子。
反动.py: Bǎo shǒu fēn zǐ bù yí dìng shì fǎn dòng fēn zǐ.
反动.en: A conservative is not always a reactionary.

反感.zh: 她对被称为懦夫很反感。
反感.py: Tā duì bèi chēng wéi nuò fū hěn fǎn gǎn.
反感.en: She resented being called a coward.

反感.py: Tā zhēn de ràng wǒ hěn fǎn gǎn.

反抗.zh: 他常以反抗的态度对我们。
反抗.py: Tā cháng yǐ fǎn kàng de tài dù duì wǒ men.
反抗.en: He often takes a defiant attitude toward us.

反馈.zh: 公司欢迎消费者对他们产品的反馈
反馈.py: Gōng sī huān yíng xiāo fèi zhě duì tā men chǎn pǐn de fǎn kuì
反馈.en: The company welcomes feedback from consumers who use their products.

反面.zh: 人们必须查看硬币的正反面。
反面.py: Rén men bì xū chá kàn yìng bì de zhèng fǎn miàn.
反面.en: People must examine the front and back of a coin.

反面.zh: 你把书拿反了，这是反面，这才是正面。
反面.py: Nǐ bǎ shū ná fǎn le, zhè shì fǎn miàn, zhè cái shì zhèng miàn.
反面.en: You're holding the book upside-down. This is upside-down and this is right-side up.

泛滥.py: Dà yǔ shǐ hé shuǐ fàn làn.
泛滥.en: The rivers were flooded by the heavy rain.

范畴.zh: 俄语动词的一个特征是存在体的范畴。
范畴.py: É yǔ dòng cí de yí gè tè zhēng shì cún zài tǐ de fàn chóu.
范畴.en: A special feature of verbs in the Russian language is the presence of the category of aspect.

贩卖.zh: 这台自动贩卖机故障了。
贩卖.py: Zhè tái zì dòng fàn mài jī gù zhàng le.

贩卖.zh: 咖啡自动贩卖机是坏的。
贩卖.py: Kā fēi zì dòng fàn mài jī shì huài de.

方言.py: Wú yǔ de fāng yán chā yì hěn dà.
方言.en: Different variants of Shanghainese differ greatly with each other.

方言.zh: 关于这种方言的资料很少。
方言.py: Guān yú zhè zhǒng fāng yán de zī liào hěn shǎo.
方言.en: There is little information about this dialect.

防御.py: Jìn gōng shì zuì hǎo de fáng yù.
防御.en: Attack is the best form of defense.

防止.zh: 她穿着一件厚外套以防止冷。
防止.py: Tā chuān zhe yí jiàn hòu wài tào yǐ fáng zhǐ lěng.
防止.en: She was wearing a thick coat against the chill.

防止.py: Fáng zhǐ shān huǒ, rén rén yǒu zé.
防止.en: The prevention of forest fires is everyone's responsibility.

纺织.zh: 苏格兰以其羊毛纺织品而着名。
纺织.py: Sū gé lán yǐ qí yáng máo fǎng zhī pǐn ér zhe míng.
纺织.en: Scotland is famous for its woollen textiles.

纺织.zh: 他们主要输出的产品是纺织品，尤其以丝绸和绵为主。
纺织.py: Tā men zhǔ yào shū chū de chǎn pǐn shì fǎng zhī pǐn, yóu qí yǐ sī chóu hé mián wéi zhǔ.
纺织.en: Their main exports are textiles, especially silk and cotton.

放大.zh: 这台显微镜能把物体放大一百倍。
放大.py: Zhè tái xiǎn wēi jìng néng bǎ wù tǐ fàng dà yì bǎi bèi.
放大.en: This microscope magnifies objects by 100 times.

放射.py: "fàng shè xìng" shì yí gè huà xué shù yǔ.
Tā shì yí gè fàng shè kē yī shēng.

放手.zh: 人们常说拿在手里没有感觉的东西还是放手的好。
放手.py: Rén men cháng shuō ná zài shǒu lǐ méi yǒu gǎn jué de dōng xī hái shì fàng shǒu de hǎo.
放手.en: People often say: "If something in your hand no longer feels right, it's better to let it go."

飞翔.zh: 你曾经梦想在天空飞翔吗？
飞翔.py: Nǐ céng jīng mèng xiǎng zài tiān kōng fēi xiáng ma?
飞翔.en: Do you ever dream about flying through the sky?

飞翔.zh: 许多鸟儿高高地飞翔在天空中
飞翔.py: Xǔ duō niǎo ér gāo gāo dì fēi xiáng zài tiān kōng zhōng
飞翔.en: Many birds fly high in the sky.

非法.py: Wǒ méi yǒu zuò guò fēi fǎ de shì.
非法.en: I've never done anything illegal in my life.

非法.zh: 许多人能够非法进入美国。
非法.py: Xǔ duō rén néng gòu fēi fǎ jìn rù měi guó.
非法.en: Many are able to enter the USA illegally.

肥沃.zh: 他农场的土地十分肥沃。
肥沃.py: Tā nóng chǎng de tǔ dì shí fēn féi wò.
肥沃.en: The land on his farm is very fertile.

肥沃.zh: 他的农场的土地十分肥沃。
肥沃.py: Tā de nóng chǎng de tǔ dì shí fēn féi wò.
肥沃.en: The land on his farm is very fertile.

废除.py: Nà xiē jiù fǎ dōu bèi fèi chú le.
废除.en: Those old laws were all done away with.

废除.zh: 许多国家已经废除了死刑。
废除.py: Xǔ duō guó jiā yǐ jīng fèi chú le sǐ xíng.
废除.en: Many countries have abolished capital punishment.

废墟.zh: 城堡如今已经成了废墟。
废墟.py: Chéng bǎo rú jīn yǐ jīng chéng le fèi xū.
废墟.en: The castle is now in ruins.

废墟.zh: 这座城市成为了一片废墟。
废墟.py: Zhè zuò chéng shì chéng wéi le yí piàn fèi xū.

沸腾.zh: 听到这个让我感觉热血沸腾。
沸腾.py: Tīng dào zhè ge ràng wǒ gǎn jué rè xuè fèi téng.
沸腾.en: It made my blood boil to hear that.

沸腾.py: Shuǐ fèi téng hòu biàn wèi zhēng qì.
沸腾.en: Water turns into steam when it is boiled.

分辨.zh: 是非对错，有时很难分辨。
分辨.py: Shì fēi duì cuò, yǒu shí hěn nán fēn biàn.
分辨.en: It is sometimes hard to tell right from wrong.

分辨.zh: 我们不能分辨那对双胞胎。
分辨.py: Wǒ men bù néng fēn biàn nà duì shuāng bāo tāi.
分辨.en: We could not tell the twins one from the other.

分寸.py: Tā shuō huà hěn méi fēn cùn.
分寸.en: He has no filter for what he says.

分寸.zh: 我父母在的时候，请你言语注意分寸。
分寸.py: Wǒ fù mǔ zài de shí hòu, qǐng nǐ yán yǔ zhù yì fēn cùn.
分寸.en: Please keep your language decent while my parents are here.

分裂.zh: 进入地球大气层后，小行星分裂成了无数的小块。
分裂.py: Jìn rù dì qiú dà qì céng hòu, xiǎo xíng xīng fēn liè chéng le wú shù de xiǎo kuài.
分裂.en: The asteroid broke up into small pieces as it entered Earth's atmosphere.

分明.py: Tā men fēn míng shuō le huǎng.
分明.en: It was obvious that they had told a lie.

分明.zh: 欧洲四季分明，是最适合人类居住的地区。
分明.py: Ōu zhōu sì jì fēn míng, shì zuì shì hé rén lèi jū zhù de dì qū.
分明.en: Europe, with its four distinct seasons, is the most suitable environment for the human race to live in.

分歧.zh: 是在这点上我们的意见有分歧。
分歧.py: Shì zài zhè diǎn shàng wǒ men de yì jiàn yǒu fēn qí.
分歧.en: It is on this point that our opinions differ.

分歧.zh: 吉姆有时与他的妻子意见分歧。
分歧.py: Jí mǔ yǒu shí yǔ tā de qī zǐ yì jiàn fēn qí.
分歧.en: Jim sometimes has disagreements with his wife.

分散.zh: 我们分散开来并在树林中展开搜索。
分散.py: Wǒ men fēn sàn kāi lái bìng zài shù lín zhōng zhǎn kāi sōu suǒ.
分散.en: We spread out and began to search through the woods.

分散.zh: 与此同时江琴分散了江枫的哥哥燕大侠的注意力。
分散.py: Yǔ cǐ tóng shí jiāng qín fēn sàn le jiāng fēng de gē ge yàn dà xiá de zhù yì lì.
分散.en: Meanwhile, Jiang Qin distracted Jiang Feng's older brother Yan Daxia.

分手.zh: 约翰和瑪丽上周分手了。
分手.py: Yuē hàn hé mǎ lì shàng zhōu fēn shǒu le.
分手.en: John and Mary broke up last week.

分手.zh: 汤姆和南西上个月分手了。
分手.py: Tāng mǔ hé nán xī shàng gè yuè fēn shǒu le.
分手.en: Tom and Nancy broke up last month.

吩咐.zh: 接下来该怎么做，我完全听从您的吩咐。
吩咐.py: Jiē xià lái gāi zěn me zuò, wǒ wán quán tīng cóng nín de fēn fù.
吩咐.en: I will follow your advice fully from here onwards.

坟墓.zh: 让苔藓盖上我的坟墓吧。
坟墓.py: Ràng tái xiǎn gài shàng wǒ de fén mù ba.
Yáo lán lǐ xué de dài dào fén mù.
坟墓.en: What is learned in the cradle is carried to the tomb.

粉末.py: Zhuō shàng bù mǎn le fěn mò.
粉末.en: The table is covered with powder.

粉色.py: Wǒ de bǐ jì běn shì fěn sè de.

粉碎.zh: 车头的挡风玻璃被砸至粉碎。
粉碎.py: Chē tóu de dǎng fēng bō lí bèi zá zhì fěn suì.
粉碎.en: The front windshield of a car was smashed to pieces.

丰盛.zh: 她为我们煮了丰盛的一餐。
丰盛.py: Tā wèi wǒ men zhǔ le fēng shèng de yì cān.
丰盛.en: She cooked us a wonderful meal.

丰收.py: Yù qī jīn nián dào mǐ huì fēng shōu.
丰收.en: This year promises a good harvest of rice.

丰收.py: Wǒ men qī wàng jīn nián fēng shōu.
丰收.en: We're expecting a good harvest this year.

风暴.py: Yīn wèi fēng bào, tā men wǎn dào le.
风暴.en: They arrived late because of the storm.

风暴.zh: 一棵大树在风暴中倒下了。
风暴.py: Yì kē dà shù zài fēng bào zhōng dǎo xià le.
风暴.en: A big tree has fallen in the storm.

风趣.zh: “她又有魅力又风趣！” “那她会做饭吗？” “谁在乎？”
风趣.py: "tā yòu yǒu mèi lì yòu fēng qù!" "nà tā huì zuò fàn ma?" "shuí zài hū?"
风趣.en: "She's not only beautiful but also humorous." "Can she cook?" "Who cares?"

风味.zh: 充分氧化反应赋予红茶浓郁醇厚的风味和深琥珀色。
风味.py: Chōng fèn yǎng huà fǎn yìng fù yǔ hóng chá nóng yù chún hòu de fēng wèi hé shēn hǔ pò sè.
风味.en: Full oxidation gives black tea its deep, robust flavor and dark amber color.

封闭.zh: 她告诉我们道路被封闭了。
封闭.py: Tā gào sù wǒ men dào lù bèi fēng bì le.
封闭.en: She told us the road was closed.

封闭.zh: 中国乒乓球队进行了一个月的封闭式冬训。
封闭.py: Zhōng guó pīng pāng qiú duì jìn xíng le yí gè yuè de fēng bì shì dōng xùn.
封闭.en: The China National Table Tennis Team had a month's closed training in winter.

封建.zh: 众所周知，直到上个世纪中叶日本是一个封建国家。
封建.py: Zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī, zhí dào shàng gè shì jì zhōng yè rì běn shì yí gè fēng jiàn guó jiā.
封建.en: It is well known that up to the middle of the last century Japan was a feudal state.

锋利.py: Zhè bǎ dāo bú gòu fēng lì.
Xiǎo xīn diǎn, tā hěn fēng lì.

逢.zh: 有缘千里来相会，无缘对面不相逢。
逢.py: Yǒu yuán qiān lǐ lái xiāng huì, wú yuán duì miàn bù xiāng féng.
逢.en: Those fated to meet will do so regardless of distance. Those not fated will not, even if they are across from one another.

逢.zh: 我父亲每逢星期天都会去打高尔夫球。
逢.py: Wǒ fù qīn měi féng xīng qī tiān dōu huì qù dǎ gāo ěr fū qiú.
逢.en: My father plays golf every Sunday.

奉献.zh: 他的父亲把一生奉献给了科学。
奉献.py: Tā de fù qīn bǎ yì shēng fèng xiàn gěi le kē xué.
奉献.en: His father dedicated his life to science.

否决.zh: 他们为什么否决了你的建议呢？
否决.py: Tā men wèi shén me fǒu jué le nǐ de jiàn yì ne?
否决.en: Why did they turn down your proposal?

否决.zh: 美国总统有权否决与退回法案。
否决.py: Měi guó zǒng tǒng yǒu quán fǒu jué yǔ tuì huí fǎ àn.
否决.en: The President of the United States has the power to veto and send back legislation.

符号.zh: 这个符号代表答案正确。
符号.py: Zhè ge fú hào dài biǎo dá àn zhèng què.
符号.en: The sign means that the answer is correct.

符号.zh: ☭ 是一个共产主义的符号。
符号.py: ☭  shì yí gè gòng chǎn zhǔ yì de fú hào.
符号.en: The ☭ is a symbol of communism.

幅度.zh: 这个政策导致物价大幅度的上升。
幅度.py: Zhè ge zhèng cè dǎo zhì wù jià dà fú dù de shàng shēng.
幅度.en: This policy resulted in a great rise in prices.

福利.py: Tā zài fú lì bàn shì chù shàng bān.
福利.en: He works at the welfare office.

福利.zh: 法国是一个福利国家，但它却不再能够负担得起了。
福利.py: Fǎ guó shì yí gè fú lì guó jiā, dàn tā què bú zài néng gòu fù dān dé qǐ le.
福利.en: France is running a welfare state it can no longer afford.

抚养.zh: 我被我的祖母抚养长大。
抚养.py: Wǒ bèi wǒ de zǔ mǔ fǔ yǎng zhǎng dà.
抚养.en: I was brought up by my grandmother.

抚养.zh: 他被他的叔叔抚养长大。
抚养.py: Tā bèi tā de shū shu fǔ yǎng zhǎng dà.
抚养.en: He was brought up by his uncle.

腐败.zh: 让我们赶走腐败的政客！
腐败.py: Ràng wǒ men gǎn zǒu fǔ bài de zhèng kè!

腐败.zh: 政治家以揭露政府官员的腐败来推动改革。
腐败.py: Zhèng zhì jiā yǐ jiē lù zhèng fǔ guān yuán de fǔ bài lái tuī dòng gǎi gé.
腐败.en: The politician pushed for reform by denouncing the corruption of the government officials.

腐烂.zh: 水果一般不久就会腐烂。
腐烂.py: Shuǐ guǒ yì bān bù jiǔ jiù huì fǔ làn.
Zhè xiē jú zǐ yǐ jīng fǔ làn le .

腐蚀.zh: 酸性会腐蚀含有金属的物质。
腐蚀.py: Suān xìng huì fǔ shí hán yǒu jīn shǔ de wù zhì.
腐蚀.en: Acid acts on things which contain metal.

腐蚀.py: Suān xìng fǔ shí le jīn shǔ.
腐蚀.en: The acid ate into the metal.

腐朽.zh: 问题不是政治不纯洁，而是整个政治博弈已经腐朽。
腐朽.py: Wèn tí bú shì zhèng zhì bù chún jié, ér shì zhěng gè zhèng zhì bó yì yǐ jīng fǔ xiǔ.
腐朽.en: The trouble is not with impure politics, but that the whole game of politics is rotten.

负担.zh: 那个责任对他是个负担。
负担.py: Nà ge zé rèn duì tā shì gè fù dān.
负担.en: That responsibility is a burden to him.

负担.zh: 我负担不起打网球的费用。
负担.py: Wǒ fù dān bù qǐ dǎ wǎng qiú de fèi yòng.
负担.en: I can't afford to play tennis.

附和.py: "wǒ yě nà yàng jué de." tā fù hè dào.
附和.en: "I think so, too," she chimed in.

复活.py: Míng tiān xīng qī yī shì fù huó jié.

复活.zh: 据说耶穌曾经令一个死人复活。
复活.py: Jù shuō yē sū céng jīng lìng yí gè sǐ rén fù huó.
复活.en: Jesus is said to have raised a man from the dead.

副.zh: 他摆出一副无辜的样子。
副.py: Tā bǎi chū yí fù wú gū de yàng zi.
副.en: He put on an air of innocence.

副.zh: 他把全副心神放在学业上。
副.py: Tā bǎ quán fù xīn shén fàng zài xué yè shàng.
副.en: He applied himself to his study.

副作用.py: Zhè yào méi yǒu fù zuò yòng.
副作用.en: This medicine does not have side effects.

副作用.zh: 这个药没有有害的副作用效果。
副作用.py: Zhè ge yào méi yǒu yǒu hài de fù zuò yòng xiào guǒ.
副作用.en: This medicine doesn't have any harmful side effects.

富裕.zh: 以他的薪水不会很富裕。
富裕.py: Yǐ tā de xīn shuǐ bú huì hěn fù yù.
富裕.en: He won't get fat on his salary.

富裕.zh: 玛丽不穷，相反，她相当富裕。
富裕.py: Mǎ lì bù qióng, xiāng fǎn, tā xiāng dāng fù yù.
富裕.en: Mary is not poor. On the contrary, she is quite rich.

赋予.py: Shén me fù yǔ le rén shēng yì yì?
Líng hún fù yǔ ròu tǐ shēng mìng.

夫妇.zh: 史密斯夫妇现在分居了。
夫妇.py: Shǐ mì sī fū fù xiàn zài fēn jū le.
夫妇.en: Mr. and Mrs. Smith live apart from each other now.

夫妇.py: Zhè duì fū fù shēng le gè ér zi.

夫人.zh: 鐳是居里夫人所发现的。
夫人.py: Léi shì jū lǐ fū rén suǒ fā xiàn de.
夫人.en: It was Marie Curie who discovered radium.

夫人.zh: 这位就是谁想见你的夫人。

混淆.en: These two words are easily confused.

活该.zh: 如果不用考试，我们的校园生活该有多快乐啊！
活该.py: Rú guǒ bú yòng kǎo shì, wǒ men de xiào yuán shēng huó gāi yǒu duō kuài lè a!
活该.en: If it were not for examinations, how happy our school life would be!

活力.py: Hái zi men dōu chōng mǎn le huó lì.

活力.zh: 年轻人通常都是充满活力的。
活力.py: Nián qīng rén tōng cháng dōu shì chōng mǎn huó lì de.
活力.en: Young people are usually full of energy.

火箭.py: Huǒ jiàn fā shè jìn rù tài kōng.
火箭.en: The rocket was launched into space.

火箭.zh: 哪一件休斯敦火箭球衣最好看？
火箭.py: Nǎ yí jiàn xiū sī dūn huǒ jiàn qiú yī zuì hǎo kàn?
火箭.en: Which Houston Rockets jersey looks the nicest?

火焰.zh: 硫磺燃烧着蓝色的火焰。
火焰.py: Liú huáng rán shāo zhe lán sè de huǒ yàn.
火焰.en: Sulfur burns with a blue flame.

火焰.zh: 用本生灯加热鉀，火焰就会呈现淡紫色。
火焰.py: Yòng běn shēng dēng jiā rè jiǎ, huǒ yàn jiù huì chéng xiàn dàn zǐ sè.
火焰.en: Potassium, heated with a Bunsen burner, gives the flame a lilac color.

火药.zh: 你们知道谁发明了火药吗？
火药.py: Nǐ men zhī dào shuí fā míng le huǒ yào ma?
火药.en: Do you know who invented gunpowder?

火药.py: Yì diǎn huǒ huā ràng huǒ yào bào zhà.
火药.en: A spark caused the gunpowder to explode.

或许.zh: 她或许知道我们在这儿。
或许.py: Tā huò xǔ zhī dào wǒ men zài zhè ér.
或许.en: She might know that we are here.

或许.zh: 这或许是个不好的例子。
或许.py: Zhè huò xǔ shì gè bù hǎo de lì zǐ.
或许.en: Maybe this is a bad example.

货币.zh: 在商朝，贝朋为通用货币。
货币.py: Zài shāng cháo, bèi péng wèi tōng yòng huò bì.
货币.en: Seashells were the legal tender in the Shang dynasty.

货币.py: Tái wān de huò bì shì shén me  ?
货币.en: What is the currency of Taiwan?

饥饿.zh: 每年有几百万人死于饥饿。
饥饿.py: Měi nián yǒu jǐ bǎi wàn rén sǐ yú jī è.
饥饿.en: Millions of people starve to death every year.

饥饿.py: Shì jiè shàng xǔ duō rén hěn jī è.
饥饿.en: There are many hungry people in the world.

机动.zh: 城市里的机动车数量增加了。
机动.py: Chéng shì lǐ de jī dòng chē shù liàng zēng jiā le.
机动.en: The number of motor vehicles in the city has increased.

机构.zh: 我一得到一大笔钱就捐一部分给慈善机构。
机构.py: Wǒ yì dé dào yí dà bǐ qián jiù juān yí bù fen gěi cí shàn jī gòu.
机构.en: Whenever I get a large sum of money, I donate some of it to charity.

机构.zh: 汤姆捐一半他的薪水给他最喜欢的慈善机构。
机构.py: Tāng mǔ juān yí bàn tā de xīn shuǐ gěi tā zuì xǐ huan de cí shàn jī gòu.
机构.en: Tom donates half his salary to his favorite charity.

机关.zh: 请把收音机关小声一点。
机关.py: Qǐng bǎ shōu yīn jī guān xiǎo shēng yì diǎn.

机关.zh: 你该上床了。把收音机关了。
机关.py: Nǐ gāi shàng chuáng le. Bǎ shōu yīn jī guān le.
机关.en: It is time you went to bed. Turn off the radio.

机灵.py: Tāng mǔ zhēn shì tè bié jī líng.

机密.py: Jī mì wén jiàn bèi cáng qǐ lái le.
Tā shēn fù jī mì shǐ mìng.
机密.en: He was charged with a secret mission.

机械.zh: 机械力代替人力, 这是蒸汽机发明的结果。
机械.py: Jī xiè lì dài tì rén lì ,  zhè shì zhēng qì jī fā míng de jié guǒ.
机械.en: The result of the invention of the steam engine was that human power was replaced by mechanical power.

机智.py: Tā shì gè jī zhì de rén.

迹象.zh: 所有迹象表明她好起来了。
迹象.py: Suǒ yǒu jì xiàng biǎo míng tā hǎo qǐ lái le.
迹象.en: All the signs are that she is getting better.

迹象.py: Zhè yǔ méi yǒu yào tíng de jì xiàng.
迹象.en: The rain shows no sign of stopping.

基地.zh: 这附近有一个军事基地。
基地.py: Zhè fù jìn yǒu yí gè jūn shì jī dì.
基地.en: There is a military base near here.

基金.zh: 他因滥用公共基金而被捕。
基金.py: Tā yīn làn yòng gōng gòng jī jīn ér bèi bǔ.
基金.en: He was arrested for abusing public funds.

基金.zh: 国际货币基金组织不考虑再借款给该国。
基金.py: Guó jì huò bì jī jīn zǔ zhī bù kǎo lǜ zài jiè kuǎn gěi gāi guó.
基金.en: The IMF ruled out any new loans to that country.

基因.zh: 我们应该对人使用基因编辑吗？
基因.py: Wǒ men yīng gāi duì rén shǐ yòng jī yīn biān jí ma?
基因.en: Should we use genetic engineering on people?

基因.zh: 一些疾病的产生原因是基因缺陷。
基因.py: Yì xiē jí bìng de chǎn shēng yuán yīn shì jī yīn quē xiàn.
基因.en: Some diseases are caused by a defective gene.

激励.zh: 他的演说激励了所有的男孩。
激励.py: Tā de yǎn shuō jī lì le suǒ yǒu de nán hái.
激励.en: His speech inspired all the boys.

激情.zh: 分享激情，就是完全沉浸在里面。
激情.py: Fēn xiǎng jī qíng, jiù shì wán quán chén jìn zài lǐ miàn.
激情.en: To share one's passion is to live it fully.

激情.zh: 这场足球赛充满着激情和精彩的竞争。
激情.py: Zhè chǎng zú qiú sài chōng mǎn zhe jī qíng hé jīng cǎi de jìng zhēng.
激情.en: This soccer match is full of energetic and splendid competition.

及早.py: Jǐn kě néng jí zǎo bài fǎng nín.
及早.en: I'll come as soon as I can.

级别.zh: 记住我的级别在你的之上。
级别.py: Jì zhù wǒ de jí bié zài nǐ de zhī shàng.

即便.zh: 即便是小孩子也能做到呢。
即便.py: Jí biàn shì xiǎo hái zi yě néng zuò dào ne.
即便.en: Even a child can do it.

即便.zh: 即便她不喜欢你，你也要完成工作。
即便.py: Jí biàn tā bù xǐ huan nǐ, nǐ yě yào wán chéng gōng zuò.
即便.en: Even if she doesn't like you, you still have to finish the work.

即将.py: Shā mǐ de hūn lǐ jí jiāng dào lái.

即将.zh: 他们宣布了暴风雨即将来临。
即将.py: Tā men xuān bù le bào fēng yǔ jí jiāng lái lín.
即将.en: They announced that a storm was coming.

极端.zh: 关于教育，他持极端意见。
极端.py: Guān yú jiào yù, tā chí jí duān yì jiàn.
极端.en: Regarding education, he has extreme opinions.

极端.py: Qīng nián rén zǒng ài tiǎo zhàn jí duān.
极端.en: Young people are apt to go to extremes.

极限.zh: 他的耐心已经到了极限。
极限.py: Tā de nài xīn yǐ jīng dào le jí xiàn.

急剧.py: Xiāo shòu lǜ zhèng zài jí jù xià huá.
Shì jiè rén kǒu jí jù zēng zhǎng.

急切.py: Tā jí qiè dì xué xí le rì yǔ.
Tāng mǔ hǎo xiàng hěn jí qiè.

疾病.py: Shù qiān rén shòu cǐ jí bìng suǒ hài.
疾病.en: Several thousand people became victims of this disease.

疾病.zh: 你是否身患需服药的疾病？
疾病.py: Nǐ shì fǒu shēn huàn xū fú yào de jí bìng?
疾病.en: Do you suffer from diseases that require medication?

集团.zh: 在上次会议中我们已经讨论了我们集团的组织问题。
集团.py: Zài shàng cì huì yì zhōng wǒ men yǐ jīng tǎo lùn le wǒ men jí tuán de zǔ zhī wèn tí.
集团.en: In the previous meeting, we already discussed the organizational problem within our company.

嫉妒.zh: 不要嫉妒其他人的成功。
嫉妒.py: Bú yào jí dù qí tā rén de chéng gōng.
嫉妒.en: Don't be jealous of the success of others.

嫉妒.zh: 许多人嫉妒汤姆的成功。
嫉妒.py: Xǔ duō rén jí dù tāng mǔ de chéng gōng.

计较.zh: 如果你不计较太多，生活会更容易些。
计较.py: Rú guǒ nǐ bú jì jiào tài duō, shēng huó huì gèng róng yì xiē.
计较.en: Life would be so much better if you didn't care so much.

记性.py: Piàn zi men bì xū yǒu hǎo jì xìng.
记性.en: Liars must have a good memory.

记性.py: Nǐ de jì xìng hěn hǎo.

技能.zh: 我想她肯定有其他技能。
技能.py: Wǒ xiǎng tā kěn dìng yǒu qí tā jì néng.
技能.en: I'm sure she has other skills.

技能.zh: 控制一个班级需要你做老师的所有技能。
技能.py: Kòng zhì yí gè bān jí xū yào nǐ zuò lǎo shī de suǒ yǒu jì néng.
技能.en: To control a class calls for all your skills as a teacher.

季度.zh: 企业第一季度收益大幅增长。
季度.py: Qǐ yè dì yī jì dù shōu yì dà fú zēng zhǎng.
季度.en: Corporate earnings in the first quarter improved sharply.

继承.zh: 他继承了他父亲的事业。
继承.py: Tā jì chéng le tā fù qīn de shì yè.
继承.en: He took over his father's business.

继承.zh: 他将会继承大笔的遗产。
继承.py: Tā jiāng huì jì chéng dà bǐ de yí chǎn.
继承.en: He will come into a large fortune.

寂静.py: Qiǎn jiān shān xiàn zài shì jì jìng de.
Yí piàn jì jìng wú shēng.

寄托.py: Bǎ xiǎo hái jì tuō gěi nǎi nai yǎng.
寄托.en: Let Grandma take care of the kid.

加工.py: Zhè shì yì zhǒng zài jiā gōng chá yè.
加工.en: This is a type of reprocessed tea.

加工.zh: 我无法相信他有种向老板要求加工资。
加工.py: Wǒ wú fǎ xiàng xìn tā yǒu zhǒng xiàng lǎo bǎn yāo qiú jiā gōng zī.
加工.en: I can't believe he had the balls to ask the boss for a raise.

加剧.zh: 恐伊斯兰是个正在加剧的问题。
加剧.py: Kǒng yī sī lán shì gè zhèng zài jiā jù de wèn tí.
加剧.en: Islamophobia is a problem that's on the rise.

加剧.zh: 海面随着全球变暖的加剧而越来越高。
加剧.py: Hǎi miàn suí zhe quán qiú biàn nuǎn de jiā jù ér yuè lái yuè gāo.
加剧.en: As global warming increases, sea levels get higher and higher.

夹杂.zh: 他说话夹杂着台湾口音。
夹杂.py: Tā shuō huà jiā zá zhe tái wān kǒu yīn.
夹杂.en: He spoke with a Taiwanese accent mixed in.

家常.zh: 你最喜欢的家常菜是什么？
家常.py: Nǐ zuì xǐ huan de jiā cháng cài shì shén me?
Shèng bài shì bīng jiā cháng shì.
家常.en: Both victory and defeat are but an everyday occurrence to a soldier.

家伙.zh: 他是个无可救药的家伙。
家伙.py: Tā shì gè wú kě jiù yào de jiā huo.

家伙.zh: 你们这些家伙真不懂事。
家伙.py: Nǐ men zhè xiē jiā huo zhēn bù dǒng shì.

家属.py: Tāng mǔ yǒu jiā shǔ xū yào shàn yǎng.

家属.zh: 家属对军方的说法高度置疑。
家属.py: Jiā shǔ duì jūn fāng de shuō fǎ gāo dù zhì yí.
家属.en: The family was highly doubtful of the statement from the military.

假设.py: Nín de jiǎ shè shì gēn jù shén me ?
假设.en: What is the basis of your assumptions?

假设.py: Ràng wǒ men jiǎ shè tā zài zhè lǐ.
假设.en: Let us suppose she is here.

坚定.zh: 算帐愈是精确, 友谊愈是坚定。
坚定.py: Suàn zhàng yù shì jīng què ,  yǒu yì yù shì jiān dìng.
坚定.en: The more precise the calculations, the stronger the friendship.

坚定.zh: 有了坚定的目标，你会做得很好。
坚定.py: Yǒu le jiān dìng de mù biāo, nǐ huì zuò dé hěn hǎo.
坚定.en: With a firm goal in mind, you will do well.

坚固.py: Nà shì gè jiān gù de lán gān.

坚固.zh: 这个梯子是否足够坚固以承受我的重量？
坚固.py: Zhè ge tī zǐ shì fǒu zú gòu jiān gù yǐ chéng shòu wǒ de zhòng liàng?
坚固.en: Is this ladder strong enough to bear my weight?

坚韧.zh: 学好一门外语需要坚韧不拔的毅力。
坚韧.py: Xué hǎo yì mén wài yǔ xū yào jiān rèn bù bá de yì lì.
坚韧.en: Mastering a foreign language involves a lot of patience.

坚韧.zh: 猎人们用坚韧的绳网把野生动物捉住了。
坚韧.py: Liè rén men yòng jiān rèn de shéng wǎng bǎ yě shēng dòng wù zhuō zhù le.
坚韧.en: The hunters captured the wild animal with a strong rope net.

坚硬.zh: 昆虫有一层坚硬的表皮。
坚硬.py: Kūn chóng yǒu yì céng jiān yìng de biǎo pí.
Nà rú shí tou yì bān jiān yìng.

间谍.zh: 他相信我们中间有间谍。
间谍.py: Tā xiāng xìn wǒ men zhōng jiān yǒu jiàn dié.
间谍.en: He believes there is a spy among us.

间谍.py: Tā men qí zhōng yì rén shì jiàn dié.
间谍.en: One of them is a spy.

间隔.zh: 他们之间隔着很远的距离。
间隔.py: Tā men zhī jiàn gé zhe hěn yuǎn de jù lí.
间隔.en: They are separated by a great distance.

间隔.zh: 广东与广西之间隔着什么？
间隔.py: Guǎng dōng yǔ guǎng xī zhī jiàn gé zhe shén me?

艰难.zh: 这个月我过得有点艰难。
艰难.py: Zhè ge yuè wǒ guò dé yǒu diǎn jiān nán.
艰难.en: This month was kind of difficult.

艰难.py: Zhè shì gè hěn jiān nán de dòu zhēng.

兼职.zh: 我必须找一份兼职工作。
兼职.py: Wǒ bì xū zhǎo yí fèn jiān zhí gōng zuò.
兼职.en: I have to find a part-time job.

兼职.zh: 我正在找一份兼职的工作。
兼职.py: Wǒ zhèng zài zhǎo yí fèn jiān zhí de gōng zuò.
兼职.en: I'm looking for a part-time job.

监视.en: He is keeping an eye out.

监狱.zh: 警方将把你关在监狱里。
监狱.py: Jǐng fāng jiāng bǎ nǐ guān zài jiān yù lǐ.
监狱.en: The police will put you in prison.

监狱.zh: 汤姆在监狱里待了三年。
监狱.py: Tāng mǔ zài jiān yù lǐ dài le sān nián.
监狱.en: Tom has spent the past three years in prison.

拣.zh: 不要对人家送的礼物挑三拣四，嫌东嫌西的。
拣.py: Bú yào duì rén jiā sòng de lǐ wù tiāo sān jiǎn sì, xián dōng xián xī de.
拣.en: Don't look a gift horse in the mouth.

见解.py: Tā yǒu hěn duō dú dào de jiàn jiě.
见解.en: He has a lot of original ideas.

见解.zh: 应该做什么，我和他的见解不同。
见解.py: Yīng gāi zuò shén me, wǒ hé tā de jiàn jiě bù tóng.
见解.en: My view was different from his as to what should be done.

溅.zh: 为溅出的牛奶哭也没用。
溅.py: Wèi jiàn chū de niú nǎi kū yě méi yòng.
溅.en: It is no use crying over spilt milk.

溅.py: Tāng mǔ hé wǒ jiàn le duì fāng.
溅.en: Tom and I splashed each other.

践踏.zh: 穿过花园时，请勿践踏花坛。
践踏.py: Chuān guò huā yuán shí, qǐng wù jiàn tà huā tán.
践踏.en: Please don’t stomp on the flower beds when you walk through the garden.

践踏.py: Bú yào jiàn tà cǎo dì.

鉴定.py: Jīng jiàn dìng, cǐ rén sān guān bú zhèng.
鉴定.en: This person's worldview is officially unhealthy.

将近.zh: 这场战争持续了将近十年。
将近.py: Zhè chǎng zhàn zhēng chí xù le jiāng jìn shí nián.
将近.en: The war lasted nearly ten years.

将近.zh: 我已经等了将近半个小时。
将近.py: Wǒ yǐ jīng děng le jiāng jìn bàn gè xiǎo shí.
将近.en: I have already waited nearly half an hour.

僵硬.py: Tā xià dé quán shēn jiāng yìng.

奖励.zh: 秘密的礼物公开的奖励。
奖励.py: Mì mì de lǐ wù gōng kāi de jiǎng lì.
Tā bèi jiǎng lì le yí kuài jīn biǎo.
奖励.en: He received a golden watch as a prize.

桨.py: Zhè sōu chuán yǒu liù gè jiǎng.

降临.py: Bú xìng jiàng lín dào tā de tóu shàng.

降临.zh: 夜幕降临时，孩子们回家了。
降临.py: Yè mù jiàng lín shí, hái zi men huí jiā le.
降临.en: The children returned home at dusk.

交叉.zh: 他的双脚被交叉捆绑着。
交叉.py: Tā de shuāng jiǎo bèi jiāo chā kǔn bǎng zhe.

交叉.zh: 火车在快到交叉路口的时候减速、按喇叭。
交叉.py: Huǒ chē zài kuài dào jiāo chā lù kǒu de shí hòu jiǎn sù, àn lǎ ba.
交叉.en: The train slowed and blared its horn as it approached the railway crossing.

交代.zh: 把玛丽交代你去做的事告诉汤姆。
交代.py: Bǎ mǎ lì jiāo dài nǐ qù zuò de shì gào sù tāng mǔ.
交代.en: Tell Tom what Mary asked you to do.

交往.zh: 别跟轻易放弃的人交往。
交往.py: Bié gēn qīng yì fàng qì de rén jiāo wǎng.
交往.en: Don't associate yourself with people that give up easily.

交往.py: Wǒ hé tā jiāo wǎng jǐ gè yuè le.
交往.en: I've been going out with her for months.

交易.py: Zhè shì yì bǐ bú cuò de jiāo yì.
Wǒ kàn nǐ gāi zuò zhè jiāo yì.
交易.en: I think you should make the deal.

教养.py: Tā shì gè yǒu jiào yǎng de rén.

阶层.zh: 中国有日益壮大的中产阶层。

皆.py: Rú guǒ xiāng xìn, yí qiè jiē yǒu kě néng.

揭露.zh: 这种秘密总有一天会被揭露的。
揭露.py: Zhè zhǒng mì mì zǒng yǒu yì tiān huì bèi jiē lù de.
揭露.en: Such secrets are always eventually revealed.

揭露.en: The politician pushed for reform by denouncing the corruption of the government officials.

结局.py: Wǒ piān hǎo jié jú yuán mǎn de xiǎo shuō.

结局.py: Gǎn jué zhè bú huì yǒu gè hǎo jié jú.
结局.en: I feel like this isn't going to end well.

截至.zh: 截至上周，我还没有收到答复。
截至.py: Jié zhì shàng zhōu, wǒ hái méi yǒu shōu dào dá fù.

竭尽全力.zh: 他竭尽全力地讨好他老婆。

竭尽全力.en: He bent over backward to please his wife.

竭尽全力.en: Tom did his best to catch up.

解雇.py: Tā shòu quán gěi wǒ jiě gù le tā men.

解剖.zh: 丹甚至没有上过基础解剖课。
解剖.py: Dān shèn zhì méi yǒu shàng guò jī chǔ jiě pōu kè.

解剖.en: She studied the bat's anatomy for her biology project.

戒备.zh: 这名士兵在黑暗中保持戒备。

界限.en: Everything has been suspected and been inspected; thoughts have no boundaries.

借助.zh: 汤姆说，他真的没有借助他人协助，自己完成了那件事。

借助.en: Tom said that he really did do that without anybody's help.

金融.zh: 汤姆是一名金融分析师。

津津有味.zh: 那场演讲很长，但我却听得津津有味。

尽快.zh: 我会尽快给你打电话的。
尽快.py: Wǒ huì jǐn kuài gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà de.
尽快.en: I'll call you as soon as I can.

尽快.zh: 为了赶上她，他尽快的走。
尽快.py: Wèi le gǎn shàng tā, tā jǐn kuài de zǒu.
尽快.en: He walked as fast as he could to catch up with her.

紧迫.zh: 周五上午时间非常紧迫。
紧迫.py: Zhōu wǔ shàng wǔ shí jiān fēi cháng jǐn pò.

近来.zh: 近来各方面都有所改进。

酒精.zh: 东欧的酒精消耗量比西欧高。

开除.en: His son was expelled from school.

开除.zh: 汤姆什么时候被开除的?
开除.py: Tāng mǔ shén me shí hòu bèi kāi chú de ?

开朗.zh: 她开朗的个性使我觉得快乐。
开朗.py: Tā kāi lǎng de gè xìng shǐ wǒ jué de kuài lè.
开朗.en: I get a kick out of her cheerful personality.

开朗.zh: 她的脸上总是挂着开朗的微笑。
开朗.py: Tā de liǎn shàng zǒng shì guà zhe kāi lǎng de wēi xiào.
开朗.en: She is always bright and smiling.

开明.zh: 他一直都对他的未来事业保持着开明的心态。
开明.py: Tā yì zhí dōu duì tā de wèi lái shì yè bǎo chí zhe kāi míng de xīn tài.
开明.en: He always kept an open mind about his future career.

开水.py: Yú lí kāi shuǐ jiù wú fǎ shēng cún.
开水.en: Fish cannot live out of water.

开水.zh: 杰西正在烧开水来冲咖啡。
开水.py: Jié xī zhèng zài shāo kāi shuǐ lái chōng kā fēi.
开水.en: Jessie is boiling water to make coffee.

开拓.zh: 年轻的时候你应该开拓你的思想。
开拓.py: Nián qīng de shí hòu nǐ yīng gāi kāi tuò nǐ de sī xiǎng.
开拓.en: You should enrich your mind when young.

开支.zh: 计划的总开支为一亿円。
开支.py: Jì huà de zǒng kāi zhī wèi yí yì yuán.
开支.en: The total expense for the project amounts to one hundred million yen.

开支.zh: 政府的开支有些过头了。
开支.py: Zhèng fǔ de kāi zhī yǒu xiē guò tóu le.
开支.en: The government's expenditures are a bit excessive.

刊登.zh: 我在报纸上刊登了我的房子的广告。
刊登.py: Wǒ zài bào zhǐ shàng kān dēng le wǒ de fáng zi de guǎng gào.
刊登.en: I advertised my house in the newspaper.

看待.zh: 他不想被当成孩子看待。
看待.py: Tā bù xiǎng bèi dàng chéng hái zi kàn dài.
看待.en: He objects to being treated like a child.

看待.zh: 他把我当成陌生人来看待。
看待.py: Tā bǎ wǒ dàng chéng mò shēng rén lái kàn dài.
看待.en: He treats me as if I am a stranger.

看望.py: Wǒ bù néng měi tiān qù kàn wàng nǐ.
看望.en: I can't visit you every day.

看望.zh: 我决定顺便去看望看望他。
看望.py: Wǒ jué dìng shùn biàn qù kàn wàng kàn wàng tā.
看望.en: I decided to take the opportunity to go and visit him.

慷慨.zh: 我很钦佩他的慷慨大方。
慷慨.py: Wǒ hěn qīn pèi tā de kāng kǎi dà fāng.
慷慨.en: I had great admiration for his generosity.

慷慨.py: Dà zì rán hěn kāng kǎi.

扛.zh: 他累坏了，需要有人扛着。
扛.py: Tā lèi huài le, xū yào yǒu rén káng zhe.
扛.en: He's exhausted and need to be carried.

扛.py: Wǒ bǎ hé zi káng zài jiān shàng.
扛.en: I carried the box on my shoulder.

考察.zh: 我发现实地考察很有教育意义。
考察.py: Wǒ fā xiàn shí dì kǎo chá hěn yǒu jiào yù yì yì.
考察.en: I found the field trip very educational.

考古.py: Tā cóng shì kǎo gǔ xué gōng zuò.

考古.zh: 汤姆是位考古学家，在领导罗马附近的发掘项目。
考古.py: Tāng mǔ shì wèi kǎo gǔ xué jiā, zài lǐng dǎo luó mǎ fù jìn de fā jué xiàng mù.
考古.en: Tom is an archaeologist leading the excavations near Rome.

考验.zh: 我们的友谊受到了考验。
考验.py: Wǒ men de yǒu yì shòu dào le kǎo yàn.
考验.en: Our friendship was put to the test.

考验.zh: 汤姆的严酷考验远没有结束。
考验.py: Tāng mǔ de yán kù kǎo yàn yuǎn méi yǒu jié shù.
考验.en: Tom's ordeal was far from over.

科目.zh: 你在学校里读哪些科目?
科目.py: Nǐ zài xué xiào lǐ dú nǎ xiē kē mù ?
科目.en: What subjects are you taking at school?

科目.zh: 代数是我最喜欢的科目。
科目.py: Dài shù shì wǒ zuì xǐ huan de kē mù.

磕.zh: 他磕碎了下巴，掉了几颗牙。
磕.py: Tā kē suì le xià bā, diào le jǐ kē yá.
磕.en: He got a broken jaw and lost some teeth.

可恶.zh: 可恶，家的钥匙到底放哪去了?
可恶.py: Kě wù, jiā de yào shi dào dǐ fàng nǎ qù le ?
可恶.en: Shit, where the fuck did I put my home keys?

可恶.zh: 那是出车祸了吗？可恶，我现在绝对来不及准时上班了！
可恶.py: Nà shì chū chē huò le ma? Kě wù, wǒ xiàn zài jué duì lái bù jí zhǔn shí shàng bān le!
可恶.en: Is that a car accident? Crap, now I'll never make it to work on time!

可观.zh: 你应该认为这是个很可观的改进。
可观.py: Nǐ yīng gāi rèn wéi zhè shì gè hěn kě guān de gǎi jìn.
可观.en: You must think of this as a great improvement.

可观.py: Jié guǒ bìng bù kě guān.

可口.py: Tā men hē kě kǒu kě lè.

可行.zh: 她认为计划很好，但不可行。
可行.py: Tā rèn wéi jì huà hěn hǎo, dàn bù kě xíng.
可行.en: She thought the plan was fine but impractical.

可行.py: Tā de zhǔ yì zǒng shì kě xíng de.

渴望.zh: 世界所有人都渴望和平。
渴望.py: Shì jiè suǒ yǒu rén dōu kě wàng hé píng.
Tā yǐ wéi tā men kě wàng róng yào.
渴望.en: He thinks that they are eager for glory.

客户.zh: 投资者把他客户的资金窃取了.
客户.py: Tóu zī zhě bǎ tā kè hù de zī jīn qiè qǔ le .
客户.en: The investor stole the capital of his client.

客户.zh: 慧如那个简报档还没传喔？客户在催。
客户.py: Huì rú nà ge jiǎn bào dàng hái méi chuán wō? Kè hù zài cuī.
客户.en: Hasn't Huiru sent the slides yet? The client's pushing.

课题.zh: 让我们来简单地了解一下这个课题。
课题.py: Ràng wǒ men lái jiǎn dān dì liǎo jiě yí xià zhè ge kè tí.
课题.en: Let's take a brief look at this topic.

课题.zh: 我是人类学的研究学生，课题是“中医在英国”。
课题.py: Wǒ shì rén lèi xué de yán jiū xué shēng, kè tí shì "zhōng yī zài yīng guó".
课题.en: I'm an anthropology research student, and my topic is 'Chinese medicine in Britain'.

恳切.zh: 尽管我恳切地要求，他们还是拒绝跟我说话。
恳切.py: Jǐn guǎn wǒ kěn qiè dì yāo qiú, tā men hái shì jù jué gēn wǒ shuō huà.
恳切.en: They refused to talk to me in spite of my earnest request.

啃.py: Wǒ quàn tā bié lǎo xiǎng zhe kěn lǎo.
啃.en: I advised him to be independent of his parents.
She's still dependent on her parents.

坑.zh: 他愤怒地践踏水坑，弄得泥水四溅。
坑.py: Tā fèn nù dì jiàn tà shuǐ kēng, nòng dé ní shuǐ sì jiàn.
坑.en: Angrily, he stomped on the puddle, splashing mud everywhere.

坑.zh: 我只用一天就用铲子挖了一个大坑。
坑.py: Wǒ zhī yòng yì tiān jiù yòng chǎn zǐ wā le yí gè dà kēng.
坑.en: I dug a huge pit with my shovel in just one day.

空白.py: Wǒ de nǎo yí piàn kòng bái.

空白.zh: 如果没有你，我的人生就会变得空白一片。
空白.py: Rú guǒ méi yǒu nǐ, wǒ de rén shēng jiù huì biàn de kòng bái yí piàn.
空白.en: My life would be completely empty without you.

空洞.zh: 中国的当代青年文化很空洞。
空洞.py: Zhōng guó de dāng dài qīng nián wén huà hěn kōng dòng.
空洞.en: Contemporary Chinese youth culture is very shallow.

空隙.zh: 请小心月台与车厢之间的空隙。
空隙.py: Qǐng xiǎo xīn yuè tái yǔ chē xiāng zhī jiān de kòng xì.
空隙.en: Please mind the gap between the train and the platform.

空虚.zh: 没有他我的生活是空虚的。
空虚.py: Méi yǒu tā wǒ de shēng huó shì kōng xū de.
空虚.en: My life is hollow without him.

孔.py: Wǒ yòu bí kǒng lǐ yǒu wān dòu.
孔.en: There's a pea in my right nostril.

孔.py: Wǒ méi kàn jiàn shén me tán kǒng.
孔.en: I don't see any bullet holes.

恐惧.py: Wǒ bù xiǎng zài kǒng jù zhōng shēng huó.
恐惧.en: I don't want to live my life in fear.

恐惧.py: Tāng mǔ chéng rèn le tā de kǒng jù.

恐吓.zh: 市长一家人一整天不断遭到了恐吓电话的骚扰。
恐吓.py: Shì zhǎng yì jiā rén yì zhěng tiān bú duàn zāo dào le kǒng hè diàn huà de sāo rǎo.
恐吓.en: The mayor's family was harassed with threatening phone calls all day.

口气.zh: 我会战斗到最后一口气。
口气.py: Wǒ huì zhàn dòu dào zuì hòu yì kǒu qì.
口气.en: I will fight to the last breath.

口气.zh: 深吸一口气然后屏住气。
口气.py: Shēn xī yì kǒu qì rán hòu píng zhù qì.
口气.en: Take a breath and hold it.

口头.zh: 我不需要你口头上的温柔。
口头.py: Wǒ bù xū yào nǐ kǒu tóu shàng de wēn róu.
口头.en: I don't need your verbal gentleness.

口音.zh: 他说话夹杂着台湾口音。
口音.py: Tā shuō huà jiā zá zhe tái wān kǒu yīn.
口音.en: He spoke with a Taiwanese accent mixed in.

口音.py: Tā shuō yīng yǔ yǒu dé guó kǒu yīn.
口音.en: He speaks English with a German accent.

枯竭.py: Wǒ líng gǎn kū jié le.

枯燥.zh: 如果没有了音乐，这个世界一定会变得十分枯燥乏味。
枯燥.py: Rú guǒ méi yǒu le yīn yuè, zhè ge shì jiè yí dìng huì biàn de shí fēn kū zào fá wèi.
枯燥.en: If not for music, the world would be a dull place.

跨.zh: 阿尔卑斯山地跨欧洲八国。
跨.py: Ā ěr bēi sī shān dì kuà ōu zhōu bā guó.
跨.en: The Alps extend across eight European countries.

跨.zh: 阴阳人与跨性别是两码事。
跨.py: Yīn yáng rén yǔ kuà xìng bié shì liǎng mǎ shì.
跨.en: Intersex and trans are two different things.

宽敞.py: Wǒ xīn jiā de kè tīng hěn kuān chǎng.
宽敞.en: The living room in my new house is very large.

宽敞.zh: 房间里的镜面墙营造出宽敞的错觉。
宽敞.py: Fáng jiān lǐ de jìng miàn qiáng yíng zào chū kuān chǎng de cuò jué.
宽敞.en: A mirror wall in the room creates an illusion of spaciousness.

款式.zh: 今年流行甚么款式的外套？
款式.py: Jīn nián liú xíng shèn me kuǎn shì de wài tào?
款式.en: What sort of coats are in fashion this year?

款式.zh: 这种款式的帽子现在很流行。
款式.py: Zhè zhǒng kuǎn shì de mào zi xiàn zài hěn liú xíng.
款式.en: This style of hat is now in fashion.

框架.zh: 整个框架由铁金属制成。
框架.py: Zhěng gè kuàng jià yóu tiě jīn shǔ zhì chéng.
框架.en: The whole framework was made of iron.

框架.zh: 我们需要让阿尔及利亚保持在社会主义框架内。
框架.py: Wǒ men xū yào ràng ā ěr jí lì yà bǎo chí zài shè huì zhǔ yì kuàng jià nèi.
框架.en: We need to keep Algeria within the socialist framework.

况且.zh: 你这么漂亮，况且又这么聪明，怎么可能没人追你呢？
况且.py: Nǐ zhè me piào liang, kuàng qiě yòu zhè me cōng ming, zěn me kě néng méi rén zhuī nǐ ne?
况且.en: You're beautiful and intelligent, how is it possible that no man is chasing after you?

旷课.py: Tāng mǔ zǒng shì kuàng kè.

昆虫.zh: 他对收集昆虫很有兴趣。
昆虫.py: Tā duì shōu jí kūn chóng hěn yǒu xìng qù.
昆虫.en: He has an interest in collecting insects.

昆虫.zh: 昆虫有一层坚硬的表皮。
昆虫.py: Kūn chóng yǒu yì céng jiān yìng de biǎo pí.

捆绑.zh: 他的双脚被交叉捆绑着。
捆绑.py: Tā de shuāng jiǎo bèi jiāo chā kǔn bǎng zhe.

扩散.zh: 癌细胞已经扩散到她的胃。
扩散.py: Ái xì bāo yǐ jīng kuò sàn dào tā de wèi.
扩散.en: The cancer has spread to her stomach.

扩张.zh: 城市扩张会对环境造成破坏。
扩张.py: Chéng shì kuò zhāng huì duì huán jìng zào chéng pò huài.

喇叭.zh: 火车在快到交叉路口的时候减速、按喇叭。
喇叭.py: Huǒ chē zài kuài dào jiāo chā lù kǒu de shí hòu jiǎn sù, àn lǎ ba.
喇叭.en: The train slowed and blared its horn as it approached the railway crossing.

啦.zh: 我当然有资格这么说啦。
啦.py: Wǒ dāng rán yǒu zī gé zhè me shuō lā.
啦.en: I am certainly entitled to speak like this.

啦.zh: 那我就恭敬不如从命啦。
啦.py: Nà wǒ jiù gōng jìng bù rú cóng mìng lā.
啦.en: Then I'll work on the principle that deference is no substitute for obedience.

来源.zh: 什么是您最大的灵感来源？
来源.py: Shén me shì nín zuì dà de líng gǎn lái yuán?
来源.en: What is your greatest source of inspiration?

来源.py: Zhè ge cí lái yuán yú xī là yǔ.
来源.en: This word is derived from Greek.

懒惰.py: Tā duì lǎn duò de rén hěn yán lì.
懒惰.en: He is very hard on lazy people.

懒惰.zh: 弗雷德是一个懒惰的家伙。
懒惰.py: Fú léi dé shì yí gè lǎn duò de jiā huo.

朗读.zh: 请汤姆大声朗读纸上的内容。
朗读.py: Qǐng tāng mǔ dà shēng lǎng dú zhǐ shàng de nèi róng.
朗读.en: I'd like Tom to read what's written on that paper aloud.

捞.zh: 船的残骸从海底被打捞上来。
捞.py: Chuán de cán hái cóng hǎi dǐ bèi dǎ lāo shàng lái.
捞.en: The wreckage of the ship was salvaged after it had gone to Davy Jones's locker.

捞.py: Zhè hǎo bǐ dà hǎi lāo zhēn.
捞.en: It is like looking for a needle in a haystack.

牢固.zh: 绳子不够牢固，撑不住他。
牢固.py: Shéng zi bú gòu láo gù, chēng bú zhù tā.
牢固.en: The rope wasn't strong enough to support him.

牢骚.py: Měi rén xīn lǐ dōu yǒu láo sāo.
牢骚.en: Everyone has something that's troubling him.

牢骚.py: Tāng mǔ lǎo shì fā láo sāo.

唠叨.py: Bié láo dao! Wǒ xū yào xué xí.
唠叨.en: Don't chatter! I have to study.

唠叨.py: Wǒ bìng bù xiǎng láo dao nǐ.
唠叨.en: I don't mean to nag you.

乐趣.zh: 我的一个乐趣是看电视。
乐趣.py: Wǒ de yí gè lè qù shì kàn diàn shì.
乐趣.en: One of my pleasures is watching TV.

乐趣.zh: 她唯一的乐趣就是听音乐。
乐趣.py: Tā wéi yī de lè qù jiù shì tīng yīn yuè.
乐趣.en: Her only pleasure is listening to music.

乐意.zh: 你是真的很乐意帮忙吗?
乐意.py: Nǐ shì zhēn de hěn lè yì bāng máng ma ?
乐意.en: Are you really willing to help?

乐意.zh: 我乐意每年秋季去苹果园。
乐意.py: Wǒ lè yì měi nián qiū jì qù píng guǒ yuán.
乐意.en: I delight in going to the apple orchard each fall.

雷达.py: Zhè sōu chuán méi yǒu léi dá zhuāng bèi.
雷达.en: The ship is not equipped with radar.

类似.zh: 我也听过一个类似的故事。
类似.py: Wǒ yě tīng guò yí gè lèi shì de gù shì.
类似.en: I also heard a similar story.

类似.py: Nǐ de wèn tí lèi sì yú wǒ de.
类似.en: Your problem is similar to mine.

冷淡.zh: 很多日本人对政治冷淡。
冷淡.py: Hěn duō rì běn rén duì zhèng zhì lěng dàn.
冷淡.en: Lots of people in Japan are indifferent to politics.

冷淡.py: Wǒ duì tā hěn lěng dàn.
冷淡.en: I was very cold towards her.

冷酷.py: Nǐ zhēn lěng kù wú qíng.

冷酷.zh: 他冷酷的性格使朋友们一个一个地疏远了他。
冷酷.py: Tā lěng kù de xìng gé shǐ péng yǒu men yí gè yi gè dì shū yuǎn le tā.
冷酷.en: His coolness has alienated his friends.

冷却.zh: 金属冷却的时候会收缩。
冷却.py: Jīn shǔ lěng què de shí hòu huì shōu suō.

冷却.zh: 在你侍酒前最好先将白葡萄酒冷却一下。
冷却.py: Zài nǐ shì jiǔ qián zuì hǎo xiān jiāng bái pú táo jiǔ lěng què yí xià.
冷却.en: It's better to chill white wine before you serve it.

黎明.py: Lí míng shí wǒ men bì xū qǐ chuáng.
黎明.en: We must get up at dawn.

黎明.zh: 他们在黎明前控制住了火势。
黎明.py: Tā men zài lí míng qián kòng zhì zhù le huǒ shì.
黎明.en: It was before dawn that they got the fire under control.

礼节.zh: 他们礼节性地相互打了个招呼。
礼节.py: Tā men lǐ jié xìng dì xiāng hù dǎ le gè zhāo hū.

礼节.zh: 我们老师确实很讲究礼节，不是吗？
礼节.py: Wǒ men lǎo shī què shí hěn jiǎng jiū lǐ jié, bú shì ma?
礼节.en: Our teacher really stands on ceremony, doesn't she?

里程碑.zh: 登月是一项里程碑式的成就。
里程碑.py: Dēng yuè shì yí xiàng lǐ chéng bēi shì de chéng jiù.
里程碑.en: The moon landing was a monumental achievement.

理睬.zh: 凯特看了克里斯一眼，然后不理睬他，使他感到痛苦。
理睬.py: Kǎi tè kàn le kè lǐ sī yì yǎn, rán hòu bù lǐ cǎi tā, shǐ tā gǎn dào tòng kǔ.
理睬.en: Kate glanced at Chris and then ignored him, making him feel miserable.

理所当然.zh: 她理所当然的取得了胜利。
理所当然.py: Tā lǐ suǒ dāng rán de qǔ dé le shèng lì.

理所当然.zh: 我理所当然认为你会站在我这边。
理所当然.py: Wǒ lǐ suǒ dāng rán rèn wéi nǐ huì zhàn zài wǒ zhè biān.
理所当然.en: I took it for granted that you were on my side.

理智.zh: 他听到消息后失去了理智。
理智.py: Tā tīng dào xiāo xī hòu shī qù le lǐ zhì.
理智.en: He went mad when he heard the story.

理智.py: Tā zhōng yú huī fù le lǐ zhì.
理智.en: He finally came to his senses.

力所能及.zh: 给予汤姆一些你力所能及的帮助。
力所能及.py: Jǐ yǔ tāng mǔ yì xiē nǐ lì suǒ néng jí de bāng zhù.
力所能及.en: Give Tom any help you can.

力争.py: Zì yóu shì wǒ men suǒ lì zhēng de.
力争.en: Freedom is what we're fighting for.

历来.zh: 这是我们历来经历过最大的地震。
历来.py: Zhè shì wǒ men lì lái jīng lì guò zuì dà de dì zhèn.
历来.en: The earthquake was the biggest one that we had ever experienced.

立场.py: Wǒ shí fēn lǐ jiě nǐ de lì chǎng.

立场.zh: 你站在我的立场上考虑看看。
立场.py: Nǐ zhàn zài wǒ de lì chǎng shàng kǎo lǜ kàn kàn.
立场.en: Just put yourself in my shoes.

立体.zh: 往立体声音响上放一枚唱片。
立体.py: Wǎng lì tǐ shēng yīn xiǎng shàng fàng yì méi chàng piàn.
立体.en: Put a record on the stereo.

立足.py: Fàng yǎn quán qiú, lì zú běn tǔ.

利率.py: Xiàn zài de dài kuǎn lì lǜ hěn gāo.
利率.en: Interest on loans is high at present.

利率.py: Lì lǜ hé tōng huò péng zhàng hěn gāo.
利率.en: Interest rates and inflation were high.

例外.py: Měi tiáo guī zé dōu yǒu lì wài.
例外.en: There are exceptions to every rule.

例外.py: Zhè tiáo guī dìng bù xǔ lì wài.

连同.zh: 妈妈把被单连同床单一起拿去洗了。
连同.py: Mā ma bǎ bèi dān lián tóng chuáng dān yī qǐ ná qù xǐ le.
连同.en: Mom took the blanket along with the bedsheet to wash.

连同.zh: 我卖了房子和家具，连同我的手饰一起才凑了五十万。
连同.py: Wǒ mài le fáng zi hé jiā jù, lián tóng wǒ de shǒu shì yì qǐ cái còu le wǔ shí wàn.
连同.en: I sold my house and furniture, together with my jewelry, in order to scrape together a half a million.

联络.zh: 我们以后要保持联络啊。
联络.py: Wǒ men yǐ hòu yào bǎo chí lián luò a.
联络.en: From now on, let's keep in touch.

联络.zh: 你最近有没有和他联络？
联络.py: Nǐ zuì jìn yǒu méi yǒu hé tā lián luò?
联络.en: Have you been in contact with him recently?

联盟.py: Tāng mǔ bú zài nǐ de lián méng lǐ.
联盟.en: Tom is out of your league.

联盟.zh: 请立即将世界语订为欧洲联盟的官方语言
联盟.py: Qǐng lì jí jiāng shì jiè yǔ dìng wèi ōu zhōu lián méng de guān fāng yǔ yán
联盟.en: Esperanto, an official language of the European Union, now!

联想.zh: 这首歌会让我联想到他的名字。
联想.py: Zhè shǒu gē huì ràng wǒ lián xiǎng dào tā de míng zì.
联想.en: I associate this song with his name.

联想.zh: 难怪我们会把蝙蝠和黑暗的地方联想在一起了。
联想.py: Nán guài wǒ men huì bǎ biān fú hé hēi àn de dì fāng lián xiǎng zài yì qǐ le.
联想.en: No wonder we associate bats with dark places.

良心.py: Tā tū rán liáng xīn fā xiàn.
良心.en: His conscience suddenly awoke in him.

良心.zh: 他对一个生病的男人说这种事真是没良心。
良心.py: Tā duì yí gè shēng bìng de nán rén shuō zhè zhǒng shì zhēn shì méi liáng xīn.
良心.en: It was heartless of him to say such a thing to the sick man.

晾.zh: 这是一个晾衣服的器具。
晾.py: Zhè shì yí gè liàng yī fu de qì jù.
晾.en: This is an appliance for drying clothes.

晾.zh: 这天气最适合晾衣服了。
晾.py: Zhè tiān qì zuì shì hé liàng yī fu le.
晾.en: This is perfect weather for drying clothes.

辽阔.zh: 巴西是一个幅员辽阔的国家。
辽阔.py: Bā xī shì yí gè fú yuán liáo kuò de guó jiā.

辽阔.zh: 中国幅员辽阔,因而茶的品种繁多。
辽阔.py: Zhōng guó fú yuán liáo kuò , yīn ér chá de pǐn zhǒng fán duō.
辽阔.en: China's territory is vast, thus the types of tea vary.

临床.zh: 不是所有的临床研究都是假设驱动的。
临床.py: Bú shì suǒ yǒu de lín chuáng yán jiū dōu shì jiǎ shè qū dòng de.
临床.en: Not all clinical studies are hypothesis-driven.

淋.zh: 珍想要一个冰淇淋甜筒。
淋.py: Zhēn xiǎng yào yí gè bīng qí lín tián tǒng.
淋.en: Jane wanted an ice cream cone.

淋.zh: 我喜欢草莓味的冰淇淋。
淋.py: Wǒ xǐ huan cǎo méi wèi de bīng qí lín.

吝啬.py: Nǐ zhè ge lìn sè de lǎo tóu.
Nǐ zhēn shì gè lìn sè guǐ!

灵感.zh: 什么是您最大的灵感来源？
灵感.py: Shén me shì nín zuì dà de líng gǎn lái yuán?
灵感.en: What is your greatest source of inspiration?

灵感.zh: 她突然有了一个绝妙的灵感。
灵感.py: Tā tū rán yǒu le yí gè jué miào de líng gǎn.
灵感.en: Suddenly she had a brilliant inspiration.

灵魂.zh: 你的灵魂已坠进了地狱。
灵魂.py: Nǐ de líng hún yǐ zhuì jìn le dì yù.
灵魂.en: Your soul has been condemned to hell.

灵魂.zh: 人是由灵魂和肉身组成的。
灵魂.py: Rén shì yóu líng hún hé ròu shēn zǔ chéng de.
灵魂.en: Man consists of soul and body.

灵敏.zh: 盲人的耳朵通常十分灵敏。
灵敏.py: Máng rén de ěr duo tōng cháng shí fēn líng mǐn.
灵敏.en: A blind person's hearing is often very acute.

灵敏.zh: 玩这些电脑游戏要反应灵敏。
灵敏.py: Wán zhè xiē diàn nǎo yóu xì yào fǎn yìng líng mǐn.
灵敏.en: You need to have quick reactions to play these computer games.

凌晨.py: Wǒ men liáo dào líng chén liǎng diǎn.
凌晨.en: We talked until two in the morning.

凌晨.zh: 凶杀案于凌晨三到五点间发生。
凌晨.py: Xiōng shā àn yú líng chén sān dào wǔ diǎn jiān fā shēng.
凌晨.en: The murder happened between 3 a.m. and 5 a.m.

零星.zh: 池塘里漂浮着零星的几片落叶。
零星.py: Chí táng lǐ piāo fú zhe líng xīng de jǐ piàn luò yè.
零星.en: A few fragments of dead leaves floated on the pond.

领会.py: Wǒ méi yǒu lǐng huì zhè ge yì yì.

领会.zh: 对我们来说，最重要的是领会领导意图。
领会.py: Duì wǒ men lái shuō, zuì zhòng yào de shì lǐng huì lǐng dǎo yì tú.
领会.en: For us, what’s most important is understanding the intention of the leadership.

领事馆.zh: 在法国，你在大使馆工作还是领事馆？
领事馆.py: Zài fǎ guó, nǐ zài dà shǐ guǎn gōng zuò hái shì lǐng shì guǎn?
领事馆.en: In France did you work at the embassy or in the consulate?

领事馆.zh: 在法国的时候，你是在大使馆工作还是在领事馆工作？
领事馆.py: Zài fǎ guó de shí hòu, nǐ shì zài dà shǐ guǎn gōng zuò hái shì zài lǐng shì guǎn gōng zuò?
领事馆.en: In France did you work at the embassy or in the consulate?

领土.zh: 他们扩阔了帝国的领土。
领土.py: Tā men kuò kuò le dì guó de lǐng tǔ.
领土.en: They increased the territory of the empire.

领土.py: Jūn duì zhàn lǐng le zhěng piàn lǐng tǔ.
领土.en: The armed forces occupied the entire territory.

领先.py: Tái wān shì gāo kē jì lǐng xiān guó.

领先.zh: 这款笔记型电脑价格亲民，技术领先。
领先.py: Zhè kuǎn bǐ jì xíng diàn nǎo jià gé qīn mín, jì shù lǐng xiān.
领先.en: The laptop provides cutting-edge technology at an affordable price.

领袖.py: Tā shì xià yí dài rén de lǐng xiù.
领袖.en: He's the leader of the next generation.

领袖.py: Tā men bǎ tā fèng wèi lǐng xiù.
领袖.en: They looked up to him as their leader.

溜.zh: 你比较喜欢溜冰还是滑雪？
溜.py: Nǐ bǐ jiào xǐ huan liū bīng hái shì huá xuě?
溜.en: Which do you like better, skating or skiing?

溜.py: Liū bīng shì wǒ de shì hào zhī yī.
溜.en: Skating is one of my hobbies.

流浪.zh: 我一辈子都是个流浪者。
流浪.py: Wǒ yí bèi zi dōu shì gè liú làng zhě.
Tā duì liú làng gǒu hěn xiǎo xīn.

流露.zh: 她的心流露着感激之情。
流露.py: Tā de xīn liú lù zhe gǎn jī zhī qíng.
Bú yào liú lù nǐ de gǎn qíng.

流氓.zh: 该名青年将少女从流氓团伙中救了出来。
流氓.py: Gāi míng qīng nián jiāng shào nǚ cóng liú máng tuán huǒ zhōng jiù le chū lái.
流氓.en: The young man saved the girl from a bunch of hoodlums.

留恋.zh: 你一定要活在当下，不能总是留恋过去。
留恋.py: Nǐ yí dìng yào huó zài dāng xià, bù néng zǒng shì liú liàn guò qù.
留恋.en: You must live in the present, not in the past.

留念.py: Ràng wǒ men pāi zhào liú niàn.
留念.en: Let's take a picture for memory's sake.

留神.zh: 请留神看着我的手提箱。
留神.py: Qǐng liú shén kàn zhe wǒ de shǒu tí xiāng.
留神.en: Please keep an eye on my suitcase.

留神.py: Yào liú shén, tā bù róng yì shòu piàn.
留神.en: Be careful. He's not an easy one to swindle.

笼罩.zh: 田野和小径被雾气笼罩着。
笼罩.py: Tián yě hé xiǎo jìng bèi wù qì lǒng zhào zhe.
笼罩.en: Mist hung over the fields and footpaths.

笼罩.py: Yīn mái lǒng zhào zhe lún dūn.

聋哑.py: Lóng yǎ de rén yòng shǒu yǔ shuō huà.
聋哑.en: Deaf-mute people talk using sign language.

聋哑.py: Tāng mǔ shì lóng yǎ rén.

隆重.zh: 新的社区中心在昨天隆重落成。
隆重.py: Xīn de shè qū zhōng xīn zài zuó tiān lóng zhòng luò chéng.
隆重.en: The new community center was inaugurated yesterday with pomp and circumstance.

垄断.py: Tā céng jīng fǎn duì lǒng duàn.

垄断.zh: 他们垄断了原物料供应，并开天价。
垄断.py: Tā men lǒng duàn le yuán wù liào gōng yìng, bìng kāi tiān jià.
垄断.en: They monopolized the supply market and drastically raised prices.

炉灶.zh: 约翰离开了公司，另起炉灶。
炉灶.py: Yuē hàn lí kāi le gōng sī, lìng qǐ lú zào.
炉灶.en: John turned his back on the company and started on his own.

炉灶.zh: 烹饪结束后请清洁炉灶和烤箱。
炉灶.py: Pēng rèn jié shù hòu qǐng qīng jié lú zào hé kǎo xiāng.
炉灶.en: Clean the stove and oven after cooking.

履行.zh: 军人必须履行他们的命令。
履行.py: Jūn rén bì xū lǚ xíng tā men de mìng lìng.
履行.en: Soldiers must carry out their orders.

履行.zh: 我理所当然地认为他会履行诺言。
履行.py: Wǒ lǐ suǒ dāng rán dì rèn wéi tā huì lǚ xíng nuò yán.
履行.en: I took it for granted that he would keep his word.

轮廓.zh: 线条艺术强调形式和轮廓，而不是颜色、阴影和纹理。
轮廓.py: Xiàn tiáo yì shù qiáng diào xíng shì hé lún kuò, ér bú shì yán sè, yīn yǐng hé wén lǐ.
轮廓.en: Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.

轮胎.zh: 我的脚踏车轮胎没气了。
轮胎.py: Wǒ de jiǎo tà chē lún tāi méi qì le.
轮胎.en: My bicycle has a flat tire.

轮胎.py: Nǐ de lún tāi bào le yí gè.
轮胎.en: One of your tires is flat.

论坛.zh: 我在这些论坛上没有帐号。

论证.en: The teacher demonstrated the idea with an experiment.

论证.zh: 我们有充分的理由论证这个假设。
论证.py: Wǒ men yǒu chōng fèn de lǐ yóu lùn zhèng zhè ge jiǎ shè.
论证.en: We have sufficient evidence to prove this hypothesis.

落成.zh: 部落成员沿着河岸定居了。
落成.py: Bù luò chéng yuán yán zhe hé àn dìng jū le.
落成.en: Members of that tribe settled along the river.

落成.zh: 新的社区中心在昨天隆重落成。
落成.py: Xīn de shè qū zhōng xīn zài zuó tiān lóng zhòng luò chéng.
落成.en: The new community center was inaugurated yesterday with pomp and circumstance.

麻醉.zh: 在麻醉剂的作用下，他昏了过去。
麻醉.py: Zài má zuì jì de zuò yòng xià, tā hūn le guò qù.
麻醉.en: He lost consciousness under the influence of the anesthetic.

麻醉.zh: 他在麻醉剂的作用下，他失去了知觉。
麻醉.py: Tā zài má zuì jì de zuò yòng xià, tā shī qù le zhī jué.
麻醉.en: He lost consciousness under the influence of the anesthetic.

嘛.zh: 你干嘛不穿件连衣裙呢？
嘛.py: Nǐ gān ma bù chuān jiàn lián yī qún ne?
嘛.en: Why don't you wear a dress?

嘛.zh: 我干嘛在跟你叨叨这些？
嘛.py: Wǒ gān ma zài gēn nǐ dāo dāo zhè xiē?
嘛.en: Why am I telling you all this?

埋伏.zh: 我们刚刚收到情报，敌方正在前方两英里处埋伏。
埋伏.py: Wǒ men gāng gāng shōu dào qíng bào, dí fāng zhèng zài qián fāng liǎng yīng lǐ chù mái fú.
埋伏.en: We've just received intelligence that the enemy is waiting in ambush two miles down the road.

埋怨.zh: 汤姆埋怨玛丽从来不帮他。
埋怨.py: Tāng mǔ mán yuàn mǎ lì cóng lái bù bāng tā.
埋怨.en: Tom complained that Mary never helped him.

埋怨.py: Tā de mán yuàn méi yǒu jìn tóu.
埋怨.en: There is no end to his complaining.

埋葬.py: Tā mái zàng le tā de dú shēng zǐ.

埋葬.zh: 他们把他埋葬在教堂旁的墓园。
埋葬.py: Tā men bǎ tā mái zàng zài jiào táng páng de mù yuán.
埋葬.en: They buried him in the graveyard by the church.

迈.zh: 迈克是他家里最年轻的。

迈.en: Mike is the youngest in his family.

迈.py: Zuó tiān mài kè pǎo dé fēi cháng kuài.

脉搏.zh: 医生正在量病人的脉搏。
脉搏.py: Yī shēng zhèng zài liáng bìng rén de mài bó.
脉搏.en: The doctor is taking the patient's pulse.

脉搏.py: Zài jiǎn chá yí xià tāng mǔ de mài bó.

慢性.py: Tā shì gè màn xìng zǐ.

慢性.zh: 鲍勃已无法忍受她老婆的慢性子。
慢性.py: Bào bó yǐ wú fǎ rěn shòu tā lǎo pó de màn xìng zǐ.
慢性.en: Bob got impatient at his wife's delay.

漫画.py: Wǒ de shì hào shì kàn màn huà shū.
Zhè piān màn huà zài zhōng guó mán huǒ.
漫画.en: This manga is pretty popular in China.

漫长.zh: 五年太漫长而无法等待。
漫长.py: Wǔ nián tài màn cháng ér wú fǎ děng dài.
漫长.en: Five years is too long to wait.

漫长.zh: 十年是一段漫长的岁月。
漫长.py: Shí nián shì yí duàn màn cháng de suì yuè.
漫长.en: Ten years is a really long period of time.

蔓延.py: Huǒ shì yǐ shàn xíng xùn sù màn yán.
蔓延.en: The fire spread out in a fan-shape.

蔓延.zh: 这些措施可以预防疾病蔓延。
蔓延.py: Zhè xiē cuò shī kě yǐ yù fáng jí bìng màn yán.
蔓延.en: These measures can prevent the disease from spreading.

忙碌.zh: 他这个星期一直很忙碌。
忙碌.py: Tā zhè ge xīng qī yī zhí hěn máng lù.
忙碌.en: He has been very busy this week.

忙碌.py: Wǒ yǒu yí gè máng lù de shēng huó.

盲目.py: Rén men shuō ài qíng shì máng mù dì.

盲目.zh: 爱情让他盲目到看不到她的错。
盲目.py: Ài qíng ràng tā máng mù dào kàn bú dào tā de cuò.
盲目.en: Love blinded him to her faults.

茫茫.zh: 突然，从茫茫大雾中出现了一艘船。

茫茫.en: Suddenly, a ship appeared through the fog.

茫然.py: Tā zhàn zài nà lǐ , yì liǎn máng rán.
茫然.en: He was standing there with a vacant look.

茂盛.py: Tā cháng dé hěn mào shèng.

枚.zh: 克里斯取得了七枚金币！
