媒体.en: The media stuck a shiv into his reputation.

媒体.zh: 媒体近几个月只讨论一件事：经济危机。
媒体.py: Méi tǐ jìn jǐ gè yuè zhī tǎo lùn yí jiàn shì: jīng jì wēi jī.
媒体.en: The media has only discussed one thing in the last few months; the economic crisis.

美满.zh: 有智慧才能分辨善恶邪正；有谦虚才能建立美满人生。
美满.py: Yǒu zhì huì cái néng fēn biàn shàn è xié zhèng; yǒu qiān xū cái néng jiàn lì měi mǎn rén shēng.
美满.en: Only with wisdom can one distinguish between good and evil; only with humility can one build a happy life.

美妙.zh: 这是世界上最美妙的声音。
美妙.py: Zhè shì shì jiè shàng zuì měi miào de shēng yīn.
美妙.en: That's the most beautiful sound in the world.

美妙.zh: 非常感谢您昨晚美妙的晚餐。
美妙.py: Fēi cháng gǎn xiè nín zuó wǎn měi miào de wǎn cān.
美妙.en: Thank you very much for the wonderful dinner last night.

蒙.zh: 乌兰巴托是蒙古的首都。
蒙.py: Wū lán bā tuō shì měng gǔ de shǒu dū.
蒙.en: Ulaanbaatar is the capital of Mongolia.

蒙.zh: 她是什么时候去蒙古的？
蒙.py: Tā shì shén me shí hòu qù měng gǔ de?
蒙.en: When did she go to Mongolia?

梦想.zh: 我没有钱，但是我有梦想。
梦想.py: Wǒ méi yǒu qián, dàn shì wǒ yǒu mèng xiǎng.
梦想.en: I have no money, but I have dreams.

梦想.zh: 是约翰让她的梦想成真。
梦想.py: Shì yuē hàn ràng tā de mèng xiǎng chéng zhēn.
梦想.en: It was John who helped make her dream come true.

眯.py: Tā xiào mī mī de duì wǒ zhāo shǒu.
眯.en: She waved her hand to me, smiling brightly.

眯.zh: 我眯了一会之后把作业写了。
眯.py: Wǒ mī le yí huì zhī hòu bǎ zuò yè xiě le.
眯.en: I did my homework after I took a nap.

弥补.py: Mí bǔ yǒng yuǎn bú huì tài wǎn.
弥补.en: It's never too late to make amends.

弥补.py: Nín bì xū mí bǔ sǔn shī.
弥补.en: You must make up for the loss.

弥漫.zh: 玫瑰的芬芳弥漫了整个房间.
弥漫.py: Méi guī de fēn fāng mí màn le zhěng gè fáng jiān .
弥漫.en: The smell of roses filled the room.

弥漫.zh: 她缓缓消失在雾气弥漫的森林中。
弥漫.py: Tā huǎn huǎn xiāo shī zài wù qì mí màn de sēn lín zhōng.
弥漫.en: She slowly disappeared into the foggy forest.

迷惑.zh: 她告诉了我她很迷惑的。
迷惑.py: Tā gào sù le wǒ tā hěn mí huò de.
迷惑.en: She told me that she's puzzled.

迷惑.zh: 我对他的问题感到非常迷惑。
迷惑.py: Wǒ duì tā de wèn tí gǎn dào fēi cháng mí huò.
迷惑.en: I was terribly confused by his question.

迷人.zh: 今天你看起来很迷人啊。
迷人.py: Jīn tiān nǐ kàn qǐ lái hěn mí rén a.
Tā hái zi bān de xiào hěn mí rén.

迷失.py: Tā kě néng yǐ jīng mí shī le.
迷失.en: He might have lost his way.

迷信.zh: 这种荒谬的迷信已不复存在了。
迷信.py: Zhè zhǒng huāng miù de mí xìn yǐ bú fù cún zài le.
迷信.en: Such a ridiculous superstition no longer exists.

迷信.zh: 宗教不过是有组织的迷信加上一本畅销书。
迷信.py: Zōng jiào bú guò shì yǒu zǔ zhī de mí xìn jiā shàng yì běn chàng xiāo shū.
迷信.en: Religion is just organised superstition with a bestseller.

密度.py: Rì běn de rén kǒu mì dù hěn gāo.
密度.en: Japan has a high population density.

密度.zh: 西里西亚省是波兰人口稠密度最大的地区。
密度.py: Xī lǐ xī yà shěng shì bō lán rén kǒu chóu mì dù zuì dà de dì qū.
密度.en: The Silesian Voivodeship is the most densely populated region of Poland.

密封.py: Zhè xiē róng qì shì mì fēng de.

免得.zh: 我们是不是该退一步，免得倒下？
免得.py: Wǒ men shì bu shì gāi tuì yí bù, miǎn de dǎo xià?
免得.en: Maybe we should take a step back before we fall?

免得.zh: 你必须尽一切可能尽力而为, 免得你以后后悔。
免得.py: Nǐ bì xū jìn yí qiè kě néng jìn lì ér wéi ,  miǎn de nǐ yǐ hòu hòu huǐ.
免得.en: You must do all you can lest you should regret later.

免疫.zh: 现今每个人都对天花免疫了。
免疫.py: Xiàn jīn měi gè rén dōu duì tiān huā miǎn yì le.
免疫.en: Everybody is immune to smallpox nowadays.

勉强.zh: 她勉强能自己煮晚餐吃。
勉强.py: Tā miǎn qiǎng néng zì jǐ zhǔ wǎn cān chī.
勉强.en: She was able to cook herself dinner, after a fashion.

勉强.zh: 他勉强同意了我的建议。
勉强.py: Tā miǎn qiǎng tóng yì le wǒ de jiàn yì.
勉强.en: He reluctantly agreed to my proposal.

面子.py: Tā shè fǎ bǎo zhù miàn zi.
面子.en: She managed to keep up appearances.

面子.py: Nǐ jiù shì yào miàn zi.

描绘.zh: 我不是诗人，无法用一行文字描绘它的美丽。
描绘.py: Wǒ bú shì shī rén, wú fǎ yòng yì háng wén zì miáo huì tā de měi lì.
描绘.en: I'm not a poet; I couldn't write a single line to depict its beauty.

渺小.zh: 眼前的景色让齐里感到自身的渺小。
渺小.py: Yǎn qián de jǐng sè ràng qí lǐ gǎn dào zì shēn de miǎo xiǎo.
渺小.en: Ziri felt humbled by such a scenery.

灭亡.zh: 核战争将会为人类带来灭亡。
灭亡.py: Hé zhàn zhēng jiāng huì wèi rén lèi dài lái miè wáng.
灭亡.en: A nuclear war will bring about the destruction of mankind.

灭亡.zh: 从古到今，没有过不灭亡的国家。
灭亡.py: Cóng gǔ dào jīn, méi yǒu guò bú miè wáng de guó jiā.
灭亡.en: There has never been a nation that was not eventually destroyed.

民间.zh: 民间运动表达了民间的不满。
民间.py: Mín jiān yùn dòng biǎo dá le mín jiān de bù mǎn.

民用.zh: 渔民用他的网捕到了一只紫色的水母。
民用.py: Yú mín yòng tā de wǎng bǔ dào le yì zhī zǐ sè de shuǐ mǔ.
民用.en: The fisherman caught a purple jellyfish in his net.

敏感.zh: 她对当下的流行很敏感。
敏感.py: Tā duì dāng xià de liú xíng hěn mǐn gǎn.
敏感.en: She is sensitive to current fashions.

敏感.py: Bú yào duì pī píng tài mǐn gǎn le.
敏感.en: Don't be too sensitive to criticism.

敏捷.zh: 可怜的猫！ 她无法抓住敏捷的老鼠。
敏捷.py: Kě lián de māo!  Tā wú fǎ zhuā zhù mǐn jié de lǎo shǔ.
敏捷.en: Poor cat! She can't catch the nimble mouse.

敏捷.py: Sōng shǔ dòng zuò mǐn jié.

敏锐.zh: 狗的嗅觉比人类敏锐得多。
敏锐.py: Gǒu de xiù jué bǐ rén lèi mǐn ruì dé duō.
敏锐.en: A dog's sense of smell is much keener than a human's.

敏锐.zh: 艺术家必须拥有敏锐的色彩眼光。
敏锐.py: Yì shù jiā bì xū yōng yǒu mǐn ruì de sè cǎi yǎn guāng.
敏锐.en: An artist has to have a color-sensitive eye.

名誉.py: Méi tǐ mǒ hēi le tā de míng yù.
名誉.en: The media stuck a shiv into his reputation.

名誉.zh: 我觉得我的名誉受到了威胁。
名誉.py: Wǒ jué de wǒ de míng yù shòu dào le wēi xié.
名誉.en: I felt that my honor was at stake.

明明.py: Wǒ míng míng méi zhāo rě rèn hé rén.
明明.en: I didn't ask to be abused.

明明.zh: 明明签订了互不侵犯条约，竟然还来攻击我们。
明明.py: Míng míng qiān dìng le hù bù qīn fàn tiáo yuē, jìng rán hái lái gōng jī wǒ men.
明明.en: They still attacked us, despite clearly agreeing to sign the non-aggression pact.

命名.zh: 他们把船命名为「五月花号」。
命名.py: Tā men bǎ chuán mìng míng wèi 「 wǔ yuè huā hào 」.
命名.en: They named the ship the Mayflower.

命名.zh: 他以他祖父的名字被命名。
命名.py: Tā yǐ tā zǔ fù de míng zì bèi mìng míng.
命名.en: He was named after his grandfather.

摸索.py: Tā men bú duàn dì mō suǒ.
摸索.en: They kept on feeling their way.

摸索.py: Tā mō suǒ zhe yì zhāng zhǐ.
摸索.en: She fumbled with a piece of paper.

模式.zh: 您现已切换至手动呼吸模式。
模式.py: Nín xiàn yǐ qiè huàn zhì shǒu dòng hū xī mó shì.

模式.zh: 这些进食模式是习得性行为。
模式.py: Zhè xiē jìn shí mó shì shì xí dé xìng xíng wéi.
模式.en: These eating patterns are a learned behavior.

模型.zh: 我的嗜好是做模型飞机。
模型.py: Wǒ de shì hào shì zuò mó xíng fēi jī.
模型.en: My hobby is making model planes.

模型.py: Wǒ zào le yí jià mó xíng fēi jī.

模样.zh: 从太空中看，地球是什么模样呢?
模样.py: Cóng tài kōng zhōng kàn, dì qiú shì shén me mú yàng ne ?
模样.en: What does the earth look like from space?

模样.zh: 你看他傻乎乎的模样，倒也挺可爱。
模样.py: Nǐ kàn tā shǎ hū hū de mú yàng, dǎo yě tǐng kě ài.
模样.en: Look at him. He looks like an idiot but he's also very cute.

膜.zh: 我五年前做了网膜剥离。
膜.py: Wǒ wǔ nián qián zuò le wǎng mó bāo lí.
膜.en: I had retinal detachment five years ago.

膜.zh: 我十四岁的时候，父亲死于蛛网膜下出血。
膜.py: Wǒ shí sì suì de shí hòu, fù qīn sǐ yú zhū wǎng mó xià chū xuè.
膜.en: My father died of a subarachnoid hemorrhage when I was fourteen.

魔鬼.py: Wǒ zài gěi mó guǐ dāng biàn hù shì.
魔鬼.en: I'm just playing the devil's advocate.

魔鬼.py: Zhè rén bǎ líng hún mài gěi mó guǐ.
魔鬼.en: The man sold his soul to the devil.

魔术.zh: 萨米不是个好的魔术师。
魔术.py: Sà mǐ bú shì gè hǎo de mó shù shī.
魔术.en: Sami is not good at being a magician.

魔术.zh: 汤姆是个专业的魔术师。
魔术.py: Tāng mǔ shì gè zhuān yè de mó shù shī.

默默.zh: 我的母亲只是默默地哭泣。
默默.py: Wǒ de mǔ qīn zhǐ shì mò mò dì kū qì.
默默.en: My mother did nothing but weep.

默默.py: Tā mò mò dì kàn zhe wǒ.

母语.zh: 塞尔维亚语是她的母语。
母语.py: Sāi ěr wéi yà yǔ shì tā de mǔ yǔ.
母语.en: She is a native speaker of Serbian.

母语.zh: 西班牙语是他们的母语。
母语.py: Xī bān yá yǔ shì tā men de mǔ yǔ.

目睹.zh: 所目睹的不一定是真的。
目睹.py: Suǒ mù dǔ de bù yí dìng shì zhēn de.
目睹.en: Things that you see with your eyes are not necessarily true.

目睹.zh: 我不忍目睹这种残酷的行径。
目睹.py: Wǒ bù rěn mù dǔ zhè zhǒng cán kù de xíng jìng.
目睹.en: I cannot abide to see such cruelty.

目光.py: Bèi hòu gǎn shòu dào tā de mù guāng.
目光.en: I felt her gaze from behind.

目光.zh: 汤姆瞥了一眼就移开目光了。
目光.py: Tāng mǔ piē le yì yǎn jiù yí kāi mù guāng le.

沐浴.zh: 小木屋沐浴在月光之中。
沐浴.py: Xiǎo mù wū mù yù zài yuè guāng zhī zhōng.
沐浴.en: The little cabin was bathed in moonlight.

沐浴.py: Qiū líng mù yù zài yáng guāng xià.
沐浴.en: The hills are bathed in sunlight.

嗯.zh: 嗯。。。我可以加入你的小组嘛
嗯.py: Ǹg... Wǒ kě yǐ jiā rù nǐ de xiǎo zǔ ma
嗯.en: Um... can we join your group?

嗯.zh: 她发现了他的真实面目，嗯？
嗯.py: Tā fā xiàn le tā de zhēn shí miàn mù, ǹg?
嗯.en: She sniffed out his true intentions, huh.

拿手.py: Mù xū ròu shì wǒ de ná shǒu cài.
拿手.en: Mu shu pork is my speciality.

拿手.zh: 为什么你做饭那么拿手呢？
拿手.py: Wèi shén me nǐ zuò fàn nà me ná shǒu ne?
拿手.en: Why are you so good at cooking?

耐用.zh: 我需要耐用好几年的手机。
耐用.py: Wǒ xū yào nài yòng hǎo jǐ nián de shǒu jī.
耐用.en: I need a phone that can last for several years.

难得.zh: 我生平难得做了一件好事...却是没用的。
难得.py: Wǒ shēng píng nán dé zuò le yí jiàn hǎo shì ... Què shì méi yòng de.
难得.en: For once in my life I'm doing a good deed... And it is useless.

难得.zh: 如果你不会说英语，你就很难得到一个好的职位。
难得.py: Rú guǒ nǐ bú huì shuō yīng yǔ, nǐ jiù hěn nán dé dào yí gè hǎo de zhí wèi.
难得.en: You're much less likely to get a good position if you don't speak English.

难堪.py: Wǒ méi xiǎng yào ràng nǐ nán kān.
难堪.en: I didn't mean to embarrass you.

难免.zh: 我们知道人皆难免一死。
难免.py: Wǒ men zhī dào rén jiē nán miǎn yì sǐ.
难免.en: We know that all men are mortal.

难免.zh: 生活中的烦恼在所难免。
难免.py: Shēng huó zhōng de fán nǎo zài suǒ nán miǎn.
难免.en: The troubles of life are inevitable.

内在.zh: 是我内在的兽性想要它。
内在.py: Shì wǒ nèi zài de shòu xìng xiǎng yào tā.
内在.en: It's the animal in me that wants it.

内在.zh: 我们一定不能忘记每个人的内在价值。
内在.py: Wǒ men yí dìng bù néng wàng jì měi gè rén de nèi zài jià zhí.
内在.en: We must never forget the inherent value of every human being.

能量.py: Wǒ zhèng zài chuán dì zhèng néng liàng. Wēng ——
Hái yào huā néng liàng kǎn diào.
能量.en: It still costs energy to chop it off.

捏.py: Tāng mǔ niē le mǎ lì de shǒu.

捏.zh: 她虚弱的样子让我捏了一把汗。
捏.py: Tā xū ruò de yàng zi ràng wǒ niē le yì bǎ hàn.
捏.en: It worried me that she looked pale.

宁肯.zh: 与其知道你要走，我宁肯你没有回来过。
宁肯.py: Yǔ qí zhī dào nǐ yào zǒu, wǒ nìng kěn nǐ méi yǒu huí lái guò.
宁肯.en: I would rather that you never returned than know that you wanted to leave.

宁愿.zh: 我宁愿工作也不愿闲着。
宁愿.py: Wǒ nìng yuàn gōng zuò yě bú yuàn xián zhe.
宁愿.en: I prefer working to doing nothing.

宁愿.zh: 我宁愿走路胜过搭公车。
宁愿.py: Wǒ nìng yuàn zǒu lù shèng guò dā gōng chē.
宁愿.en: I'd rather walk than take a bus.

拧.zh: 汤姆拧干毛巾挂起来晾干。
拧.py: Tāng mǔ nǐng gān máo jīn guà qǐ lái liàng gān.
拧.en: Tom wrung out the towel and hung it up to dry.

拧.py: Yòng nǐng méng zhī dài tì cù.
拧.en: Use lemon juice instead of vinegar.

凝固.zh: 水泥会在数个小时内凝固。
凝固.py: Shuǐ ní huì zài shù gè xiǎo shí nèi níng gù.
凝固.en: The cement will set in a couple of hours.

凝视.py: Nǚ hái níng shì zhe yáng wá wa.
凝视.en: The girl was gazing at the doll.

凝视.py: Tāng mǔ níng shì le shuāng jiǎo.

扭转.py: Niǔ zhuǎn zhì liáo shì kù xíng.

扭转.zh: 他觉得自己占了上风，但我反过来扭转了局面。
扭转.py: Tā jué de zì jǐ zhàn le shàng fēng, dàn wǒ fǎn guò lái niǔ zhuǎn le jú miàn.
扭转.en: He thought he had the upper hand, but I turned the tables on him.

农历.py: Chūn jié, jí nóng lì xīn nián.
农历.en: Spring Festival is also known as Chinese New Year.

农历.py: Jīn tiān shì nóng lì jǐ hào?
农历.en: What day is today in the Chinese calendar?

奴隶.zh: 他对待我就像他的奴隶。
奴隶.py: Tā duì dài wǒ jiù xiàng tā de nú lì.
奴隶.en: He treats me like his slave.

奴隶.zh: 这个人是您的奴隶，是吧？
奴隶.py: Zhè ge rén shì nín de nú lì, shì ba?
奴隶.en: This person is your slave, right?

虐待.zh: 坏孩子们喜欢虐待动物。
虐待.py: Huài hái zi men xǐ huan nüè dài dòng wù.
虐待.en: Bad children love to torment animals.

虐待.py: Tā shòu dào yán zhòng de nüè dài.
虐待.en: He was treated with great cruelty.

挪.zh: 把椅子挪一挪靠近桌子。
挪.py: Bǎ yǐ zi nuó yi nuó kào jìn zhuō zi.
挪.en: Move the chair nearer to the desk.

挪.py: Mǎ lì yà zài jiào wǒ nuó wēi yǔ.

哦.zh: 哪条路都可以去公园哦。
哦.py: Nǎ tiáo lù dōu kě yǐ qù gōng yuán ò.
哦.en: You can reach the park by either road.

哦.zh: 我一直住这家酒店的哦。
哦.py: Wǒ yì zhí zhù zhè jiā jiǔ diàn de ò.
哦.en: I always stay at this hotel.

欧洲.zh: 我想去欧洲的某个地方。
欧洲.py: Wǒ xiǎng qù ōu zhōu de mǒu gè dì fāng.
欧洲.en: I want to go somewhere in Europe.

欧洲.zh: 我打算下个星期去欧洲。
欧洲.py: Wǒ dǎ suàn xià gè xīng qī qù ōu zhōu.
欧洲.en: I'm planning to leave for Europe next week.

殴打.py: Tā bèi ōu dǎ dé kuài sǐ.
殴打.en: He was beaten to within an inch of his life.

呕吐.zh: 你是否有恶心呕吐的感觉。
呕吐.py: Nǐ shì fǒu yǒu ě xīn ǒu tǔ de gǎn jué.

呕吐.zh: 我只能描述这可怕的味道像呕吐物混合着烂肉。
呕吐.py: Wǒ zhǐ néng miáo shù zhè kě pà de wèi dào xiàng ǒu tǔ wù hùn hé zhe làn ròu.
呕吐.en: I can only describe the terrible smell as vomit mixed with rotting flesh.

趴.zh: 汤姆趴在方向盘上睡着了。
趴.py: Tāng mǔ pā zài fāng xiàng pán shàng shuì zháo le.
趴.en: Tom fell asleep at the wheel.

排除.zh: 他把问题从脑子里排除了。
排除.py: Tā bǎ wèn tí cóng nǎo zǐ lǐ pái chú le.
排除.en: He cast off the problem from his mind.

排除.py: Nǐ men yào pái chú wàn nán.
排除.en: You have to overcome the difficulties.

攀登.py: Tā céng sì cì pān dēng fù shì shān.
攀登.en: He climbed Mount Fuji four times.

攀登.py: Wǒ men xiǎng pān dēng fù shì shān.
攀登.en: We want to climb Mt. Fuji.

盘旋.zh: 一团尘土与瓦礫腾空而起，在空中盘旋了数分钟。
盘旋.py: Yì tuán chén tǔ yǔ wǎ lì téng kōng ér qǐ, zài kōng zhōng pán xuán le shù fēn zhōng.
盘旋.en: A cloud of dust and debris rose and lingered in the sky for a few minutes afterward.

判决.zh: 汤姆下个星期一会被判决。
判决.py: Tāng mǔ xià gè xīng qī yī huì bèi pàn jué.
判决.en: Tom will be sentenced next Monday.

判决.py: Pàn jué duì zhèng fǔ bú lì.
判决.en: The judgement went against the government.

畔.zh: 英国首都伦敦在泰晤士河畔。
畔.py: Yīng guó shǒu dū lún dūn zài tài wù shì hé pàn.
畔.en: London, the capital of England, is on the Thames.

庞大.zh: 他死前累积了庞大的财富。
庞大.py: Tā sǐ qián lěi jī le páng dà de cái fù.
庞大.en: He amassed a large fortune before he died.

庞大.zh: 他继承了他爸爸的庞大遗产。
庞大.py: Tā jì chéng le tā bà ba de páng dà yí chǎn.
庞大.en: He succeeded to his father's large property.

抛弃.zh: 她们被抛弃在一座荒岛上。
抛弃.py: Tā men bèi pāo qì zài yí zuò huāng dǎo shàng.
抛弃.en: They were marooned on a desert isle.

抛弃.zh: 他们被抛弃在一座荒岛上。
抛弃.py: Tā men bèi pāo qì zài yí zuò huāng dǎo shàng.
抛弃.en: They were marooned on a desert isle.

配备.py: Wǒ men de chē pèi bèi le kōng tiáo.
配备.en: Our car is equipped with air conditioning.

配备.zh: 这个实验室配备了最新的计算机。
配备.py: Zhè ge shí yàn shì pèi bèi le zuì xīn de jì suàn jī.
配备.en: This laboratory is equipped with the latest computers.

烹饪.py: Zhè xiē píng guǒ yí yú pēng rèn.

烹饪.zh: 她打算去烹饪学校上几堂课。
烹饪.py: Tā dǎ suàn qù pēng rèn xué xiào shàng jǐ táng kè.
烹饪.en: She's thinking of taking a couple of courses at a cooking school.

捧.zh: 汤姆弯下腰，捧起了一把沙子。
捧.py: Tāng mǔ wān xià yāo, pěng qǐ le yì bǎ shā zi.
捧.en: Tom bent down and picked up a handful of sand.

捧.zh: 现在很多年轻人追捧小鲜肉的现象正常吗？
捧.py: Xiàn zài hěn duō nián qīng rén zhuī pěng xiǎo xiān ròu de xiàn xiàng zhèng cháng ma?
捧.en: Is it normal that many young people these days idolize pretty boy stars?

劈.py: Luàn fā shì huì zāo léi pī de.
劈.en: If you swear reckless oaths, lightning will strike you.

皮革.zh: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。
皮革.py: Rén zào pí gé shì bǐ bú shàng zhēn pí de.
皮革.en: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.

皮革.py: Zhè xuē shì yòng pí gé zuò de.
皮革.en: These boots are made of leather.

疲惫.zh: 我因为时差而感到疲惫。
疲惫.py: Wǒ yīn wèi shí chā ér gǎn dào pí bèi.
疲惫.en: I feel exhausted because of jet lag.

疲惫.py: Nán xī kàn qǐ lái hěn pí bèi.

疲倦.py: Nǐ kàn qǐ lái hěn pí juàn.

屁股.py: Qǐ chuáng le, tài yáng shài pì gǔ le.

屁股.zh: 它像婴儿的屁股一样光滑。
屁股.py: Tā xiàng yīng ér de pì gǔ yí yàng guāng huá.
屁股.en: It's as smooth as a baby's bottom.

譬如.zh: 你有出国过吗？譬如说，美国？
譬如.py: Nǐ yǒu chū guó guò ma? Pì rú shuō, měi guó?
譬如.en: Have you visited foreign countries, say America?

偏见.zh: 我对外籍员工没有偏见。
偏见.py: Wǒ duì wài jí yuán gōng méi yǒu piān jiàn.
偏见.en: I don't have a prejudice against foreign workers.

偏见.py: Tā duì wài guó rén yǒu piān jiàn.
偏见.en: He has a prejudice against foreigners.

偏僻.py: Nà ge wèi zhì hěn piān pì.

片刻.py: Zài fáng jiān wài miàn děng dài piàn kè.
片刻.en: Wait for a moment outside the room.

片刻.py: Tā zài nà dì fāng dài le piàn kè.
片刻.en: She stayed in that area for a short while.

漂浮.zh: 池塘里漂浮着零星的几片落叶。
漂浮.py: Chí táng lǐ piāo fú zhe líng xīng de jǐ piàn luò yè.
漂浮.en: A few fragments of dead leaves floated on the pond.

漂浮.py: Yóu piāo fú zài shuǐ shàng.

拼命.py: Kě néng nǐ gōng zuò dé tài pīn mìng?
拼命.en: Maybe you are working too hard.

拼命.zh: 这么拼命工作有什么意义？
拼命.py: Zhè me pīn mìng gōng zuò yǒu shén me yì yì?
拼命.en: What's the sense of working so hard?

贫乏.py: Rì běn zì rán zī yuán pín fá.
贫乏.en: Japan is poor in natural resources.

贫困.zh: 阿尔及利亚仍国境贫困。
贫困.py: Ā ěr jí lì yà réng guó jìng pín kùn.

贫困.zh: 他怎么在这样的贫困中谋生？
贫困.py: Tā zěn me zài zhè yàng de pín kùn zhōng móu shēng?
贫困.en: How did he make his living in such poverty?

频繁.py: Dì zhèn pín fán dì xí jī rì běn.

频繁.zh: 最近频繁的地震让我们很焦虑。
频繁.py: Zuì jìn pín fán de dì zhèn ràng wǒ men hěn jiāo lǜ.
频繁.en: The recent frequency of earthquakes makes us nervous.

品尝.zh: 你在台湾品尝过火锅吗 ?
品尝.py: Nǐ zài tái wān pǐn cháng guò huǒ guō ma  ?
品尝.en: Have you tried the hot pot in Taiwan?

品尝.zh: 新竹的贡丸和米粉非常有名，吸引不少游客品尝。
品尝.py: Xīn zhú de gòng wán hé mǐ fěn fēi cháng yǒu míng, xī yǐn bù shǎo yóu kè pǐn cháng.
品尝.en: Hsinchu's meatballs and rice noodles are very famous, attracting many tourists to taste them.

品行.zh: 她是一位品行端正的女士。
品行.py: Tā shì yí wèi pǐn xíng duān zhèng de nǚ shì.
品行.en: She is a very correct lady.

品行.zh: 汤姆想在发出录取通知前先确认申请人的品行证明。
品行.py: Tāng mǔ xiǎng zài fā chū lù qǔ tōng zhī qián xiān què rèn shēn qǐng rén de pǐn xíng zhèng míng.
品行.en: Tom wanted to check the applicant's character reference before extending an offer.

品质.py: Nǐ yǒu pǐn zhì hǎo yì diǎn de ma ?
品质.en: Have you got anything that's better quality?

品质.zh: 这些产品的品质是一样的。
品质.py: Zhè xiē chǎn pǐn de pǐn zhì shì yí yàng de.
品质.en: The quality of these products is the same.

平凡.zh: 她只是一个平凡的小女孩。
平凡.py: Tā zhǐ shì yí gè píng fán de xiǎo nǚ hái.
平凡.en: She is just an ordinary girl.

平凡.zh: 我们过着十分平凡的生活。
平凡.py: Wǒ men guò zhe shí fēn píng fán de shēng huó.
平凡.en: We lead a very ordinary life.

平面.zh: 首先，因为海水变热时膨胀，海平面可能提高。
平面.py: Shǒu xiān, yīn wèi hǎi shuǐ biàn rè shí péng zhàng, hǎi píng miàn kě néng tí gāo.
平面.en: First of all, the level of the ocean could rise, because ocean water expands as it grows warmer.

平面.zh: 我在想是否北极的冰融化的时候, 海平面就会上升。
平面.py: Wǒ zài xiǎng shì fǒu běi jí de bīng róng huà de shí hòu ,  hǎi píng miàn jiù huì shàng shēng.
平面.en: I wonder if the sea levels will rise when the North Pole melts.

平行.zh: 平行四边形的对边平行。
平行.py: Píng xíng sì biān xíng de duì biān píng xíng.
平行.en: The opposite sides of a parallelogram are parallel.

平行.py: Liǎng tiáo jiē dào hù xiāng píng xíng.
平行.en: The two streets run parallel to one another.

平原.zh: 水道如树枝般越过了平原。
平原.py: Shuǐ dào rú shù zhī bān yuè guò le píng yuán.
平原.en: The waterways branch out across the plain.

评估.zh: 她能很准确地评估投资。
评估.py: Tā néng hěn zhǔn què dì píng gū tóu zī.
评估.en: She can assess investments very accurately.

评论.zh: 他们的评论很有启发性。
评论.py: Tā men de píng lùn hěn yǒu qǐ fā xìng.

评论.zh: 他的评论简洁且击中要害。
评论.py: Tā de píng lùn jiǎn jié qiě jī zhòng yào hài.
评论.en: His comment was concise and to the point.

坡.zh: 蜿蜒的小路爬上了陡坡。
坡.py: Wān yán de xiǎo lù pá shàng le dǒu pō.
坡.en: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.

坡.zh: 他下个一月从新加坡回。
坡.py: Tā xià gè yī yuè cóng xīn jiā pō huí.
坡.en: He comes back from Singapore next January.

颇.zh: 汤姆好像颇为忙，对不对？
颇.py: Tāng mǔ hǎo xiàng pō wèi máng, duì bu duì?
颇.en: Tom seemed quite busy, didn't he?

颇.zh: 这件物件的表面颇为粗糙。
颇.py: Zhè jiàn wù jiàn de biǎo miàn pō wèi cū cāo.
颇.en: The surface of the object is fairly rough.

迫不及待.zh: 他迫不及待地想要知道结果。
迫不及待.py: Tā pò bù jí dài dì xiǎng yào zhī dào jié guǒ.
迫不及待.en: He is anxious to know the result.

迫不及待.zh: 他迫不及待地想试一下他的新冲浪板。
迫不及待.py: Tā pò bù jí dài dì xiǎng shì yí xià tā de xīn chōng làng bǎn.
迫不及待.en: He couldn't wait to try out his new surfboard.

迫害.py: Zhèng zhì pò hài kāi shǐ le.
Tā men shòu dào pò hài.

泼.py: Tè lǎng pǔ shā le ài pō sī tǎn.
Ài pō sī tǎn méi yǒu zì shā.

扑.zh: 把扑克牌放在橡木桌上。
扑.py: Bǎ pū kè pái fàng zài xiàng mù zhuō shàng.
扑.en: Place the deck of cards on the oaken table.

扑.zh: 汤姆说要跟我们玩扑克。
扑.py: Tāng mǔ shuō yào gēn wǒ men wán pū kè.
扑.en: Tom said he wanted to play poker with us.

朴实.zh: 真理的语言必定是朴实无华、毫无矫饰的。
朴实.py: Zhēn lǐ de yǔ yán bì dìng shì pǔ shí wú huá, háo wú jiǎo shì de.
朴实.en: The language of truth must be, with no doubt, simple and without artifice.

普及.py: Yīng yǔ yǐ jīng pǔ jí quán guó.
普及.en: English has spread all over the country.

普及.py: Xiàn jīn shǒu jī fēi cháng pǔ jí.
普及.en: Nowadays mobile phones are very popular.

铺.zh: 她在她的床上铺了床单。
铺.py: Tā zài tā de chuáng shàng pù le chuáng dān.
铺.en: She put sheets on her bed.

铺.zh: 肯每天早上自己整理床铺。
铺.py: Kěn měi tiān zǎo shàng zì jǐ zhěng lǐ chuáng pù.
铺.en: Ken makes his own bed every morning.

瀑布.zh: 我看见那儿有个很美的瀑布。
瀑布.py: Wǒ kàn jiàn nà ér yǒu gè hěn měi de pù bù.
瀑布.en: I saw a wonderful fall there.

曝光.zh: 汤姆和我之间的秘密被曝光了。
曝光.py: Tāng mǔ hé wǒ zhī jiān de mì mì bèi bào guāng le.
曝光.en: Tom and my secret came to light.

凄凉.zh: 看着眼前凄凉的景象，我们不禁流下了泪来。
凄凉.py: Kàn zhuó yǎn qián qī liáng de jǐng xiàng, wǒ men bù jīn liú xià le lèi lái.
凄凉.en: The pitiful sight moved us to tears.

期望.zh: 她没有辜负我们的期望。
期望.py: Tā méi yǒu gū fù wǒ men de qī wàng.
期望.en: She lived up to our expectations.

期望.zh: 你对你的孩子期望过高。
期望.py: Nǐ duì nǐ de hái zi qī wàng guò gāo.
期望.en: You expect too much of your child.

期限.zh: 汤姆不知道今天是期限。
期限.py: Tāng mǔ bù zhī dào jīn tiān shì qī xiàn.
期限.en: Tom didn't know the deadline was today.

期限.zh: 这本护照的有用期限为五年。
期限.py: Zhè běn hù zhào de yǒu yòng qī xiàn wèi wǔ nián.
期限.en: This passport is valid for five years.

欺负.zh: 他在学校老是被人欺负。
欺负.py: Tā zài xué xiào lǎo shì bèi rén qī fù.
欺负.en: He always gets bullied at school.

欺负.py: Tā qī fù bǐ tā xiǎo de hái zi

欺骗.zh: 一些人被甜言蜜语欺骗。
欺骗.py: Yì xiē rén bèi tián yán mì yǔ qī piàn.
欺骗.en: Some are deceived by fair words.

欺骗.zh: 这将是你最后一次被欺骗了。
欺骗.py: Zhè jiāng shì nǐ zuì hòu yí cì bèi qī piàn le.
欺骗.en: This will be the last time you're deceived.

齐全.zh: 这套房子设施便利齐全。
齐全.py: Zhè tào fáng zi shè shī biàn lì qí quán.
齐全.en: The house has all the conveniences.

齐全.py: Fáng jiān lǐ jiā jù qí quán.

奇妙.zh: 你的弟弟真是个奇妙的人。
奇妙.py: Nǐ de dì di zhēn shì gè qí miào de rén.
奇妙.en: What a marvelous person your brother is!

奇妙.zh: 有时候，现实比科幻还奇妙。
奇妙.py: Yǒu shí hòu, xiàn shí bǐ kē huàn hái qí miào.

歧视.py: Tā fǎn duì zhǒng zú qí shì.

旗袍.zh: 在中国南方，旗袍又称“长衫”。
旗袍.py: Zài zhōng guó nán fāng, qí páo yòu chēng "cháng shān".
旗袍.en: In Southern China, the qipao is also known as "changshan".

旗袍.py: Zuì chū de qí páo shì kuān sōng de.
旗袍.en: The original qipao was wide and loose.

旗帜.py: Qí zhì shì guó jiā xiàng zhēng.
旗帜.en: A flag is a national symbol.

旗帜.py: Zhè shì shén me qí zhì?

乞丐.zh: 这名乞丐在收集干面包。
乞丐.py: Zhè míng qǐ gài zài shōu jí gān miàn bāo.
乞丐.en: The beggar is collecting stale bread.

乞丐.zh: 他很富有，但活得像个乞丐。
乞丐.py: Tā hěn fù yǒu, dàn huó dé xiàng gè qǐ gài.
乞丐.en: He is rich yet he lives like a beggar.

启程.zh: 我们启程开车去卡比利亚。
启程.py: Wǒ men qǐ chéng kāi chē qù kǎ bǐ lì yà.

启示.zh: 在僵尸启示录的事件中你会怎么做？
启示.py: Zài jiāng shī qǐ shì lù de shì jiàn zhōng nǐ huì zěn me zuò?
启示.en: What would you do in the event of a zombie apocalypse?

起初.zh: 起初我听不懂他说的话。
起初.py: Qǐ chū wǒ tīng bù dǒng tā shuō de huà.
起初.en: I couldn't understand him at first.

起初.zh: 我起初以为他是你哥哥。
起初.py: Wǒ qǐ chū yǐ wéi tā shì nǐ gē ge.
起初.en: At first, I thought he was your brother.

起伏.py: Rén shēng chōng mǎn le gāo dī qǐ fú.
起伏.en: Life is full of ups and downs.

起伏.py: Shēng huó zhōng yǒu gāo dī qǐ fú.
起伏.en: In life there are ups and downs.

起码.zh: 汤姆起码比我高一个头。
起码.py: Tāng mǔ qǐ mǎ bǐ wǒ gāo yí gè tóu.
起码.en: Tom is at least one head taller than I am.

起码.zh: 他每天起码会看一部电影。
起码.py: Tā měi tiān qǐ mǎ huì kàn yí bù diàn yǐng.
起码.en: He watches at least one movie a day.

起源.zh: 奥林匹克的起源是什么？
起源.py: Ào lín pǐ kè de qǐ yuán shì shén me?
起源.en: What are the origins of the Olympics?

起源.py: Fó jiào qǐ yuán yú yìn dù.
起源.en: Buddhism had its beginnings in India.

气色.zh: 她的气色看起来比以前好。
气色.py: Tā de qì sè kàn qǐ lái bǐ yǐ qián hǎo.
Nǐ kàn qǐ lái qì sè bú tài hǎo.

气味.py: Zhè niú nǎi yǒu tè shū de qì wèi.
气味.en: This milk has a peculiar smell.

气味.zh: 这些花有一种独特的气味。
气味.py: Zhè xiē huā yǒu yì zhǒng dú tè de qì wèi.
气味.en: These flowers have a unique smell.

气象.zh: 气象学家说会有暴风雨。
气象.py: Qì xiàng xué jiā shuō huì yǒu bào fēng yǔ.
气象.en: The weatherman says there is a storm on the way.

气象.zh: 根据气象预报，明天会是晴天。
气象.py: Gēn jù qì xiàng yù bào, míng tiān huì shì qíng tiān.
气象.en: According to the weather report, tomorrow will be a fine day.

气压.zh: 气压计下降了 - 要下雨了。
气压.py: Qì yā jì xià jiàng le  -  yào xià yǔ le.
气压.en: The barometer is falling. It is going to rain.

人道.zh: 存在主义是一种人道主义。

人格.zh: 要想有良好的人格魅力，必须要有聪慧的头脑。

人间.zh: 我们会把人间变成天堂。
人间.py: Wǒ men huì bǎ rén jiān biàn chéng tiān táng.
人间.en: We will turn the world into a paradise.

人为.zh: 人为生而食，非为食而活。
人为.py: Rén wéi shēng ér shí, fēi wèi shí ér huó.
人为.en: Man eats to live, he does not live to eat.

忍耐.en: Patience is the most beautiful virtue.

忍受.zh: 我无法再忍受那噪音了。
忍受.py: Wǒ wú fǎ zài rěn shòu nà zào yīn le.
忍受.en: I can't put up with that noise any longer.

忍受.zh: 如果你能忍受我们的话。
忍受.py: Rú guǒ nǐ néng rěn shòu wǒ men de huà.
忍受.en: If you can put up with us, put us up.

认可.en: I'm not in agreement with your methods at all.

任命.zh: 他被任命为驻英国大使。

任命.py: Tā bèi rèn mìng wèi zhù měi rì běn dà shǐ.
任命.en: He was accredited to the United States to represent Japan.

任意.py: Bèi ěr bèi fàn guī le, qiú duì huò dé le rèn yì qiú.
任意.en: Bale was fouled, and his team was awarded a free kick.

仍旧.zh: 我仍旧无法相信我居然做了这种事。

仍旧.en: I still can't believe I did it.

日益.py: Wǒ men de guó jiā rì yì fù qiáng.

日益.en: China has a growing middle class.

容纳.en: This hotel has accommodations for 1,000 guests.

容纳.zh: 这房间太小了，容纳不下五十人。

容忍.py: Wǒ wú fǎ róng rěn tā de xíng wéi.

融洽.zh: 我与我的弟弟相处融洽。

融洽.en: I get along with my younger brother.

融洽.zh: 我和婆婆相处得十分融洽。

撒谎.zh: 汤姆有可能对你撒谎了。

撒谎.py: Tā píng zhí jué fā xiàn tā zài sā huǎng.

生锈.py: Nǐ de dāo shēng xiù le.

生锈.zh: 萨米将生锈的叉子放进了洗碗机。
生锈.py: Sà mǐ jiāng shēng xiù de chā zi fàng jìn le xǐ wǎn jī.
生锈.en: Sami put the rusty fork in the dishwasher.

声明.zh: 她承认我的声明是真实的。
声明.py: Tā chéng rèn wǒ de shēng míng shì zhēn shí de.
声明.en: She acknowledged that my statement was true.

声明.py: Zhè xū yào jiā miǎn zé shēng míng ma?

声势.py: Tāng mǔ zài xū zhāng shēng shì.

声誉.zh: 维持一个人的声誉是很难的。
声誉.py: Wéi chí yí gè rén de shēng yù shì hěn nán de.
声誉.en: It is hard to maintain one's reputation.

声誉.zh: 丑闻让他付出了失去声誉的代价。
声誉.py: Chǒu wén ràng tā fù chū le shī qù shēng yù de dài jià.
声誉.en: That scandal cost him his reputation.

牲畜.zh: 图阿雷格人该把他们的牲畜转移到山谷去了。
牲畜.py: Tú ā léi gé rén gāi bǎ tā men de shēng chù zhuǎn yí dào shān gǔ qù le.
牲畜.en: It's time for the Tuaregs to transfer their herds to the valley.

省会.py: Háng zhōu shì zhè jiāng shěng de shěng huì.
省会.en: Hangzhou is the provincial capital of Zhejiang Province.

盛.zh: 华盛顿的樱花现在开放。
盛.py: Huá shèng dùn de yīng huā xiàn zài kāi fàng.
盛.en: Cherry trees are now in bloom in Washington.

盛.zh: 那习俗已经不再盛行了。
盛.py: Nà xí sú yǐ jīng bú zài shèng xíng le.
盛.en: That tradition has fallen into desuetude.

盛产.py: Ā lā bó shèng chǎn shí yóu.
Gāi guó shèng chǎn shí yóu.

盛开.zh: 在花园里的玫瑰正盛开着。
盛开.py: Zài huā yuán lǐ de méi guī zhèng shèng kāi zhe.
盛开.en: The roses in the garden are blooming.

盛开.py: Yù jīn xiāng hěn kuài jiāng shèng kāi.

盛情.zh: 照这样的情况，很抱歉，我不能接受你的盛情邀请。
盛情.py: Zhào zhè yàng de qíng kuàng, hěn bào qiàn, wǒ bù néng jiē shòu nǐ de shèng qíng yāo qǐng.
盛情.en: As such is the case, I am sorry I can't accept your kind invitation.

盛行.zh: 那习俗已经不再盛行了。
盛行.py: Nà xí sú yǐ jīng bú zài shèng xíng le.
盛行.en: That tradition has fallen into desuetude.

盛行.zh: 在哥伦比亚，天主教习俗盛行。
盛行.py: Zài gē lún bǐ yà, tiān zhǔ jiào xí sú shèng xíng.

尸体.zh: 这就是发现尸体的房间。
尸体.py: Zhè jiù shì fā xiàn shī tǐ de fáng jiān.
尸体.en: This is the room where the body was found.

尸体.zh: 每个人都可能变成尸体。
尸体.py: Měi gè rén dōu kě néng biàn chéng shī tǐ.
尸体.en: Every man is a potential corpse.

失误.py: Tāng mǔ fàn le gè dà shī wù.
失误.en: Tom has made a big mistake.

失踪.py: Shī zōng de māo hái méi bèi zhǎo dào.
失踪.en: The missing cat has not been found yet.

失踪.py: Jù wǒ suǒ zhī, tā réng rán shī zōng.
失踪.en: As far as I know, she is still missing.

十足.zh: 他看上去是个十足的绅士。
十足.py: Tā kàn shàng qù shì gè shí zú de shēn shì.
十足.en: He looks every inch a gentleman.

十足.zh: 我的邻居是个十足的洁癖。
十足.py: Wǒ de lín jū shì gè shí zú de jié pǐ.

石油.zh: 我为一家石油公司工作。
石油.py: Wǒ wèi yì jiā shí yóu gōng sī gōng zuò.
石油.en: I work for an oil company.

石油.zh: 世界上的石油快用完了。
石油.py: Shì jiè shàng de shí yóu kuài yòng wán le.
石油.en: The world is running out of oil.

时差.zh: 他过马路时差点被车撞。
时差.py: Tā guò mǎ lù shí chā diǎn bèi chē zhuàng.
时差.en: He was nearly hit by the car while crossing the street.

时差.zh: 我因为时差而感到疲惫。
时差.py: Wǒ yīn wèi shí chā ér gǎn dào pí bèi.
时差.en: I feel exhausted because of jet lag.

时常.zh: 我们时常发照片给对方。
时常.py: Wǒ men shí cháng fā zhào piàn gěi duì fāng.
时常.en: We often send each other pictures.

时常.py: Lǎo rén shí cháng zì yán zì yǔ.
时常.en: Old people often talk to themselves.

时而.py: Wǒ shí ér lè guān, shí ér bēi guān.
时而.en: I am by turns an optimist and a pessimist.

时光.zh: 我有一段美好的旧时光。
时光.py: Wǒ yǒu yí duàn měi hǎo de jiù shí guāng.
时光.en: I had a fine old time.

时光.zh: 你度过愉快的时光了吗？
时光.py: Nǐ dù guò yú kuài de shí guāng le ma?
时光.en: Did you have a good time?

时机.zh: 你要好好把握这个时机。
时机.py: Nǐ yào hǎo hǎo bǎ wò zhè ge shí jī.
时机.en: You should make good use of this opportunity.

时机.zh: 现在是买它的最好时机。
时机.py: Xiàn zài shì mǎi tā de zuì hǎo shí jī.
时机.en: Now is a great time to buy one of those.

时事.zh: 他组织了一场关于时事的课堂辩论。
时事.py: Tā zǔ zhī le yì chǎng guān yú shí shì de kè táng biàn lùn.
时事.en: He organized a classroom debate on current events.

时装.py: Shí zhuāng bú shì wǒ de tiān fèn.

时装.zh: 三十年前的时装款式又流行起来了。
时装.py: Sān shí nián qián de shí zhuāng kuǎn shì yòu liú xíng qǐ lái le.
时装.en: Fashions of thirty years ago have come back in style.

实力.zh: 我们必须加强经济实力。
实力.py: Wǒ men bì xū jiā qiáng jīng jì shí lì.
Bú yào dī gū zì jǐ de shí lì.

实施.zh: 广泛的安全措施实施了。
实施.py: Guǎng fàn de ān quán cuò shī shí shī le.
实施.en: Broad safety measures were put into effect.

实施.zh: 根本就没实施过逮捕行动。
实施.py: Gēn běn jiù méi shí shī guò dǎi bǔ xíng dòng.

实质.zh: 这是一场没有实质内容的争论。
实质.py: Zhè shì yì chǎng méi yǒu shí zhì nèi róng de zhēng lùn.
实质.en: It was an argument of little substance.

使命.zh: 今天的使命：奶茶跟麻糬。
使命.py: Jīn tiān de shǐ mìng: nǎi chá gēn má shǔ.
使命.en: Today's mission: milk tea with mochi.

使命.py: Tā wán chéng le tā de shǐ mìng.

示范.py: Nín kě yǐ shì fàn yí xià ma ?

示范.zh: 齐里向里瑪示范如何正确修剪棕櫚树。
示范.py: Qí lǐ xiàng lǐ mǎ shì fàn rú hé zhèng què xiū jiǎn zōng lǘ shù.
示范.en: Ziri showed Rima how to properly prune her palm trees.

示威.zh: 我要参加一个示威游行。
示威.py: Wǒ yào cān jiā yí gè shì wēi yóu xíng.
示威.en: I'm going to join a demonstration.

示威.zh: 工会参加了示威游行吗？
示威.py: Gōng huì cān jiā le shì wēi yóu xíng ma?
示威.en: Did the union participate in the demonstration?

示意.py: Fù qīn shì yì wǒ lí kāi fáng jiān.
示意.en: Father gestured to me to leave the room.

示意.zh: 我父亲示意我离开会议室。
示意.py: Wǒ fù qīn shì yì wǒ lí kāi huì yì shì.
示意.en: My father motioned for me to leave the meeting room.

事故.zh: 事故耽误了我们半小时。
事故.py: Shì gù dān wù le wǒ men bàn xiǎo shí.
事故.en: An accident delayed us for half an hour.

事故.zh: 事故差点让他丢了性命。
事故.py: Shì gù chà diǎn ràng tā diū le xìng mìng.
事故.en: The accident almost cost him his life.

事件.zh: 这起事件使他一举成名。
事件.py: Zhè qǐ shì jiàn shǐ tā yì jǔ chéng míng.

事件.zh: 该事件播下了战争的种子。
事件.py: Gāi shì jiàn bō xià le zhàn zhēng de zhǒng zi.
事件.en: The incident sowed the seeds of the war.

事务.py: Tā zhī dào hěn duō wài guó shì wù.
事务.en: He knows a lot about foreign affairs.

事务.zh: 你没有干涉他人事务的权力。
事务.py: Nǐ méi yǒu gān shè tā rén shì wù de quán lì.
事务.en: You have no right to interfere in other people's affairs.

事业.zh: 他继承了他父亲的事业。
事业.py: Tā jì chéng le tā fù qīn de shì yè.
事业.en: He took over his father's business.

事业.zh: 他必须继承父亲的事业。
事业.py: Tā bì xū jì chéng fù qīn de shì yè.
事业.en: He must succeed to his father's business.

势力.zh: 他试图扩大自己的势力范围。
势力.py: Tā shì tú kuò dà zì jǐ de shì lì fàn wéi.
势力.en: He tried to enlarge his sphere of influence.

势力.zh: 美国在中东的行为如同恐怖主义势力。
势力.py: Měi guó zài zhōng dōng de xíng wéi rú tóng kǒng bù zhǔ yì shì lì.
势力.en: The USA is acting like a terrorist force in the Middle East.

视力.zh: 这些天我的视力正在变差。
视力.py: Zhè xiē tiān wǒ de shì lì zhèng zài biàn chà.
视力.en: My vision is getting worse these days.

视力.py: Wǒ yào lái jiǎn chá nǐ de shì lì.

视线.zh: 鸟儿从我的视线中消失了。
视线.py: Niǎo ér cóng wǒ de shì xiàn zhōng xiāo shī le.
Niǎo ér jiàn jiàn fēi lí le shì xiàn.
视线.en: The bird flew away and was lost to sight.

视野.py: Wǒ xǐ huan shì yě hǎo de fáng zi.
视野.en: I'd like a room with a good view.

试图.zh: 他试图自杀，但是失败了。
试图.py: Tā shì tú zì shā, dàn shì shī bài le.
试图.en: He tried to kill himself but it ended in failure.

试图.zh: 他们试图冲破敌军防线。
试图.py: Tā men shì tú chōng pò dí jūn fáng xiàn.
试图.en: They attempted to break through the enemy line.

试验.py: Zhè cì hé shì yàn chéng gōng le.
试验.en: This time, the nuclear test was a success.

试验.py: Zhè cì hé shì yàn shī bài le.
试验.en: This time, the nuclear test failed.

是非.zh: 婴儿不懂得分是非黑白。
是非.py: Yīng ér bù dǒng de fēn shì fēi hēi bái.
是非.en: A baby has no knowledge of good and evil.

是非.zh: 是非对错，有时很难分辨。
是非.py: Shì fēi duì cuò, yǒu shí hěn nán fēn biàn.
是非.en: It is sometimes hard to tell right from wrong.

逝世.py: Tā zuó tiān shì shì le.

释放.zh: 你用什么方式释放压力？
释放.py: Nǐ yòng shén me fāng shì shì fàng yā lì?
Guó wáng xià lìng bǎ qiú fàn shì fàng.
释放.en: The king ordered that the prisoner should be set free.

拾.zh: 他一步一步地拾级而上。
拾.py: Tā yí bù yi bù dì shí jí ér shàng.
拾.en: He went up the steps slowly.

拾.zh: 她经常在饭后收拾桌子。
拾.py: Tā jīng cháng zài fàn hòu shōu shí zhuō zi.
拾.en: She always clears the table after a meal.

收藏.zh: 我想看看您的邮票收藏。
收藏.py: Wǒ xiǎng kàn kàn nín de yóu piào shōu cáng.
收藏.en: I would like to have a look at your collection of stamps.

收缩.zh: 金属冷却的时候会收缩。
收缩.py: Jīn shǔ lěng què de shí hòu huì shōu suō.

收益.zh: 企业第一季度收益大幅增长。
收益.py: Qǐ yè dì yī jì dù shōu yì dà fú zēng zhǎng.
收益.en: Corporate earnings in the first quarter improved sharply.

收益.zh: 他们在这次的投资中得到百分之八的收益。
收益.py: Tā men zài zhè cì de tóu zī zhōng dé dào bǎi fēn zhī bā de shōu yì.
收益.en: They obtained a yield of 8 percent on their investment.

收音机.zh: 请把收音机关小声一点。
收音机.py: Qǐng bǎ shōu yīn jī guān xiǎo shēng yì diǎn.

收音机.zh: 她降低了收音机的音量。
收音机.py: Tā jiàng dī le shōu yīn jī de yīn liàng.

手势.zh: 约翰当时在疯狂地打手势。
手势.py: Yuē hàn dāng shí zài fēng kuáng dì dǎ shǒu shì.

手势.zh: 人们在美国使用这些手势吗?
手势.py: Rén men zài měi guó shǐ yòng zhè xiē shǒu shì ma ?
手势.en: Do people in America use these gestures?

手艺.zh: 汤姆去学校学习调琴手艺。
手艺.py: Tāng mǔ qù xué xiào xué xí tiáo qín shǒu yì.
手艺.en: Tom went to school to learn how to tune pianos.

手艺.zh: 我强烈推荐任何想学习一门手艺的人都去读这本书。
手艺.py: Wǒ qiáng liè tuī jiàn rèn hé xiǎng xué xí yì mén shǒu yì de rén dōu qù dú zhè běn shū.
手艺.en: I greatly recommend reading it to anybody thinking of learning a craft.

守护.zh: 默默守护中，有人跑到街头，叫来了协警。
守护.py: Mò mò shǒu hù zhōng, yǒu rén pǎo dào jiē tóu, jiào lái le xié jǐng.
守护.en: As everyone stood guard silently, someone ran to the corner of the street and called over a police officer.

授予.zh: 这名士兵被授予紫心勳章。
授予.py: Zhè míng shì bīng bèi shòu yǔ zǐ xīn xūn zhāng.
授予.en: This soldier was awarded the Purple Heart.

授予.py: Tā céng jīng bèi shòu yǔ jīn pái.
授予.en: He's been awarded a gold medal once.

书法.py: Wǒ duì shū fǎ lüè zhī yī èr.
书法.en: I know a bit about calligraphy.

书法.py: Nǐ shàn cháng shū fǎ ma?

书籍.zh: 他有几十本的英文书籍。
书籍.py: Tā yǒu jǐ shí běn de yīng wén shū jí.
书籍.en: He has dozens of English books.

书籍.py: Jǐn kě néng dì duō yuè dú shū jí.

书记.zh: 直到党委书记出面加以解释，才算打消了这种想法。
书记.py: Zhí dào dǎng wěi shū jì chū miàn jiā yǐ jiě shì, cái suàn dǎ xiāo le zhè zhǒng xiǎng fǎ.
书记.en: Only when the Party Committee Secretary came in person to resolve it was this point of view dispelled entirely.

书面.zh: 口语比书面语更贴近生活。
书面.py: Kǒu yǔ bǐ shū miàn yǔ gèng tiē jìn shēng huó.
书面.en: Spoken language is closer to life than written language.

书面.zh: 哲学不是书面上的学问，而是一种生活的方式。
书面.py: Zhé xué bú shì shū miàn shàng de xué wèn, ér shì yì zhǒng shēng huó de fāng shì.
书面.en: Philosophy is not a written subject, but a way of life.

疏忽.py: Tā zé bèi le wǒ de shū hū.
疏忽.en: He reprimanded me for my oversight.

疏忽.zh: 提交工作内容之前请仔细检查，这里有疏忽的地方。
疏忽.py: Tí jiāo gōng zuò nèi róng zhī qián qǐng zǐ xì jiǎn chá, zhè lǐ yǒu shū hū de dì fāng.
疏忽.en: Edit your work better before you submit it, it's sloppy.

束.zh: 典礼结束时，新人接了吻。
束.py: Diǎn lǐ jié shù shí, xīn rén jiē le wěn.
束.en: At the end of the ceremony, the new couple kissed.

束.zh: 我建议让我们结束会议。
束.py: Wǒ jiàn yì ràng wǒ men jié shù huì yì.
束.en: I suggested that we bring the meeting to an end.

束缚.zh: 我想她想要的是束缚与支配。
束缚.py: Wǒ xiǎng tā xiǎng yào de shì shù fù yǔ zhī pèi.
束缚.en: I guess she's into bondage and domination.

树立.zh: 上海人要树立上海新形象。
树立.py: Shàng hǎi rén yào shù lì shàng hǎi xīn xíng xiàng.
树立.en: The Shanghainese people must build up Shanghai's new image.

树立.zh: 你应该给你的孩子们树立好榜样。
树立.py: Nǐ yīng gāi gěi nǐ de hái zi men shù lì hǎo bǎng yàng.
树立.en: You should set a good example for your children.

竖.py: Wǒ shù qǐ le ěr duo tīng.

竖.zh: 看到鬼的时候，我吓得汗毛直竖。
竖.py: Kàn dào guǐ de shí hòu, wǒ xià dé hàn máo zhí shù.
竖.en: When I saw the ghost, I was so frightened that my hair stood on end.

数.zh: 对我来说，质量不如数量。
数.py: Duì wǒ lái shuō, zhì liàng bù rú shù liàng.

数.zh: 爱因斯坦是个数学天才。
数.py: Ài yīn sī tǎn shì gè shù xué tiān cái.

耍.zh: 我小时候常常独自玩耍。
耍.py: Wǒ xiǎo shí hòu cháng cháng dú zì wán shuǎ.
耍.en: I used to play alone when I was a child.

耍.zh: 玛丽希望能够出去玩耍。
耍.py: Mǎ lì xī wàng néng gòu chū qù wán shuǎ.
耍.en: Mary wished she could go outside and play.

衰老.zh: 衰老不得，智慧不得不得。
衰老.py: Shuāi lǎo bù dé, zhì huì bù dé bu dé.
Méi yǒu rén néng táo guò shuāi lǎo.
衰老.en: No one can escape growing old.

衰退.zh: 我们不能愁闷地看着这个城市就这样衰退下去。
衰退.py: Wǒ men bù néng chóu mèn dì kàn zhe zhè ge chéng shì jiù zhè yàng shuāi tuì xià qù.
衰退.en: We can't just look on dejectedly while this city continues to go into decline.

双胞胎.zh: 我们不能分辨那对双胞胎。
双胞胎.py: Wǒ men bù néng fēn biàn nà duì shuāng bāo tāi.
双胞胎.en: We could not tell the twins one from the other.

双胞胎.zh: 这对双胞胎长得一模一样。
双胞胎.py: Zhè duì shuāng bāo tāi cháng dé yì mú yí yàng.
双胞胎.en: Those twins look like two peas in a pod.

爽快.zh: 朋友之间，大家谈谈心，非常爽快。
爽快.py: Péng yǒu zhī jiān, dà jiā tán tán xīn, fēi cháng shuǎng kuài.
爽快.en: Between friends, to have a heart-to-heart is really rejuvenating.

水龙头.zh: 厨房里的水龙头在漏水。
水龙头.py: Chú fáng lǐ de shuǐ lóng tóu zài lòu shuǐ.
水龙头.en: The faucet in the kitchen is dripping.

水龙头.zh: 他打开了浴缸里的水龙头。
水龙头.py: Tā dǎ kāi le yù gāng lǐ de shuǐ lóng tóu.
水龙头.en: He has the water running in the bathtub.

水泥.zh: 水泥会在数个小时内凝固。
水泥.py: Shuǐ ní huì zài shù gè xiǎo shí nèi níng gù.
水泥.en: The cement will set in a couple of hours.

水泥.zh: 我们往下看，是一片水泥丛林。
水泥.py: Wǒ men wǎng xià kàn, shì yí piàn shuǐ ní cóng lín.
水泥.en: Looking down, we saw a concrete jungle.

司法.zh: 你曾是一宗司法案件的证人？
司法.py: Nǐ céng shì yì zōng sī fǎ àn jiàn de zhèng rén?
司法.en: Have you ever served as a witness in a court case?

司法.zh: 美国的司法制度是世界上最好的。
司法.py: Měi guó de sī fǎ zhì dù shì shì jiè shàng zuì hǎo de.
司法.en: The legal system in America is the world's finest.

私自.zh: 他是个极其自私自利的人。
私自.py: Tā shì gè jí qí zì sī zì lì de rén.
私自.en: He is a lump of selfishness.

私自.zh: 他只不过是个自私自利的人。
私自.py: Tā zhī bú guò shì gè zì sī zì lì de rén.
私自.en: He is nothing more than an egoist.

思念.zh: 你知不知道思念的滋味？
思念.py: Nǐ zhī bu zhī dào sī niàn de zī wèi?
思念.en: Do you know the taste of thought?

思念.py: Wǒ hěn sī niàn guò qù de rì zi.
思念.en: I really miss the old days.

思索.zh: 汤姆不假思索脱口而出。
思索.py: Tāng mǔ bù jiǎ sī suǒ tuō kǒu ér chū.
Tāng mǔ bù jiā sī suǒ dì xíng dòng.

思维.zh: 学习物理能够改变思维。
思维.py: Xué xí wù lǐ néng gòu gǎi biàn sī wéi.
思维.en: Learning physics can change your way of thinking.

思维.py: Tā de sī wéi fāng shì hěn yòu zhì.
思维.en: His way of thinking is very childish.

思绪.py: Gōng zuò zhī qián xiān shōu hǎo sī xù.
思绪.en: Collect your thoughts before you begin your work.

死亡.zh: 所有悲剧都由死亡终结。
死亡.py: Suǒ yǒu bēi jù dōu yóu sǐ wáng zhōng jié.
死亡.en: All tragedies end with a death.

死亡.zh: 动物一个接一个的死亡。
死亡.py: Dòng wù yí gè jiē yí gè de sǐ wáng.
死亡.en: One after another, the animals died.

搜索.zh: 我们分散开来并在树林中展开搜索。
搜索.py: Wǒ men fēn sàn kāi lái bìng zài shù lín zhōng zhǎn kāi sōu suǒ.
搜索.en: We spread out and began to search through the woods.

搜索.zh: 主要互联网的搜索引擎之一说：“快比慢好”。
搜索.py: Zhǔ yào hù lián wǎng de sōu suǒ yǐn qíng zhī yī shuō:"kuài bǐ màn hǎo".
搜索.en: One of the major Internet search engines states that ‘Fast is better than slow’.

艘.zh: 一艘船突然从雾中出现。
艘.py: Yì sōu chuán tū rán cóng wù zhōng chū xiàn.
艘.en: A boat suddenly appeared out of the mist.

艘.zh: 这艘船穿过巴拿马运河
艘.py: Zhè sōu chuán chuān guò bā ná mǎ yùn hé
艘.en: The ship went through the Panama Canal.

俗话.zh: 俗话说：高丽菜汤和粥是我们的食物。
俗话.py: Sú huà shuō: gāo lí cài tāng hé zhōu shì wǒ men de shí wù.
俗话.en: There is a saying: cabbage soup and porridge are our food.

俗话.zh: 俗话说：邪不压正；可俗话又说：道高一尺，魔高一丈！
俗话.py: Sú huà shuō: xié bù yā zhèng; kě sú huà yòu shuō: dào gāo yì chǐ, mó gāo yí zhàng!
俗话.en: As the saying goes: "good always triumphs over evil". But there's another saying that: "the fight against evil is a constant struggle".

素食.zh: 纯素食者们闻起来更好。
素食.py: Chún sù shí zhě men wén qǐ lái gèng hǎo.

素食.zh: 爱你自己，成为纯素食者！
素食.py: Ài nǐ zì jǐ, chéng wéi chún sù shí zhě!

素质.zh: 这条路上的许多居民素质都很差。
素质.py: Zhè tiáo lù shang de xǔ duō jū mín sù zhì dōu hěn chà.
素质.en: Most of the residents on this street are wrong 'uns.

素质.zh: 在限定时间内完成任务是一个职员的基本素质。
素质.py: Zài xiàn dìng shí jiān nèi wán chéng rèn wu shì yí gè zhí yuán de jī běn sù zhì.
素质.en: It is a basic quality of an employee to complete his tasks within a fixed time.

算了.zh: 算了，我们聊点开心的事吧！
算了.py: Suàn le, wǒ men liáo diǎn kāi xīn de shì ba!
算了.en: Forget it, let us talk about happy stuff!

算了.py: Yào shi mài wán le, jiù suàn le.
算了.en: If it’s sold out, then just forget it.

算数.py: Yǒu duō shǎo běn suàn shù shū liú zhe?
算数.en: How many arithmetic books are left?

算数.py: Suàn shù chǔ lǐ shù zì.

随即.zh: 他心脏停止了跳动, 随即死亡。
随即.py: Tā xīn zāng tíng zhǐ le tiào dòng ,  suí jí sǐ wáng.
随即.en: His heart stopped beating and he died immediately.

随身.zh: 你不需要随身带着午餐。
随身.py: Nǐ bù xū yào suí shēn dài zhe wǔ cān.
随身.en: You don't need to carry lunch with you.

随身.zh: 你今天最好随身带把伞。
随身.py: Nǐ jīn tiān zuì hǎo suí shēn dài bǎ sǎn.
随身.en: You had better take an umbrella with you today.

随手.en: Please close the door behind you.

随手.zh: 当他写字时, 他总是随手拿着一本字典。
随手.py: Dāng tā xiě zì shí ,  tā zǒng shì suí shǒu ná zhe yì běn zì diǎn.
随手.en: When he writes, he always keeps a dictionary at hand.

随意.py: Suí yì duō chī diǎn yáng yù piàn ba.
随意.en: Help yourself to more potato chips.

随意.py: Bú yào suí yì zài lù biān tíng chē.
随意.en: Don't just park along the road as you please.

岁月.zh: 十年是一段漫长的岁月。
岁月.py: Shí nián shì yí duàn màn cháng de suì yuè.
岁月.en: Ten years is a really long period of time.

岁月.zh: 她怀念自己的青春岁月。
岁月.py: Tā huái niàn zì jǐ de qīng chūn suì yuè.
岁月.en: She pines for the days of her youth.

隧道.zh: 日本最长的隧道在哪里？
隧道.py: Rì běn zuì cháng de suì dào zài nǎ lǐ?
隧道.en: Where is the longest tunnel in Japan?

隧道.zh: 这条隧道是那条的两倍长。
隧道.py: Zhè tiáo suì dào shì nà tiáo de liǎng bèi cháng.
隧道.en: This tunnel is twice as long as that one.

损坏.zh: 货物毫无损坏地到达了。
损坏.py: Huò wù háo wú sǔn huài dì dào dá le.
Wū dǐng bèi bào fēng yǔ sǔn huài le.
损坏.en: The roof was damaged by the storm.

塌.zh: 开罗的一栋大楼倒塌了。
塌.py: Kāi luó de yí dòng dà lóu dǎo tā le.

塌.zh: 若有大地震，房屋会倒塌呀！
塌.py: Ruò yǒu dà dì zhèn, fáng wū huì dǎo tā ya!
塌.en: If there's a big earthquake, the house could really collapse!

踏实.py: Wǒ shì gè jiǎo tà shí dì de rén.
踏实.en: I have my feet firmly planted on the ground.

台风.zh: 昨天的台风把树刮倒了。
台风.py: Zuó tiān de tái fēng bǎ shù guā dǎo le.
台风.en: The tree had been blown down by the typhoon of the day before.

台风.py: Zhè ge qiū jì yǒu hěn duō tái fēng.
台风.en: We have had lots of typhoons this fall.

太空.zh: 太空旅行已不再是幻想。
太空.py: Tài kōng lǚ xíng yǐ bú zài shì huàn xiǎng.
太空.en: Space travel is no longer a dream.

太空.zh: 你怎么在太空里找到食物？
太空.py: Nǐ zěn me zài tài kōng lǐ zhǎo dào shí wù?
太空.en: How do you find food in outer space?

贪婪.zh: 守财奴积聚钱财不是因为他谨慎，而是因为他贪婪。
贪婪.py: Shǒu cái nú jī jù qián cái bú shì yīn wèi tā jǐn shèn, ér shì yīn wèi tā tān lán.
贪婪.en: A miser hoards money not because he is prudent but because he is greedy.

瘫痪.zh: 全面罢工瘫痪了整个国家。
瘫痪.py: Quán miàn bà gōng tān huàn le zhěng gè guó jiā.
瘫痪.en: The general strike paralyzed the whole country.

瘫痪.zh: 他的瘫痪正在恶化，不久他就不能下床了。
瘫痪.py: Tā de tān huàn zhèng zài è huà, bù jiǔ tā jiù bù néng xià chuáng le.
瘫痪.en: His paralysis is progressing, and soon he won't be able to get out of bed.

坦白.zh: 坦白地说，我不喜欢你的发型。
坦白.py: Tǎn bái dì shuō, wǒ bù xǐ huan nǐ de fà xíng.
坦白.en: Frankly speaking, I don't like your haircut.

坦白.zh: 我该不该跟她坦白我的过去？
坦白.py: Wǒ gāi bu gāi gēn tā tǎn bái wǒ de guò qù?
坦白.en: Should I make a confession of my past to her?

探索.zh: 他探索一切逃走的可能性。
探索.py: Tā tàn suǒ yí qiè táo zǒu de kě néng xìng.
探索.en: He is exploring the possibility of all escapes.

探索.py: Wǒ men zhèng zài tàn suǒ huǒ xīng.

探讨.py: Zhè shì zhí dé tàn tǎo de huà tí.

探讨.zh: 学生们在探讨语言和文化。
探讨.py: Xué shēng men zài tàn tǎo yǔ yán hé wén huà.
探讨.en: The students are talking about language and culture.

探望.zh: 她探望了她在监狱里的丈夫。
探望.py: Tā tàn wàng le tā zài jiān yù lǐ de zhàng fu.
探望.en: She visited her husband in prison.

探望.zh: 我的叔叔们有时会来探望我。
探望.py: Wǒ de shū shu men yǒu shí huì lái tàn wàng wǒ.
探望.en: My uncles come to see me from time to time.

掏.py: Tāng mǔ tāo chū yào shi kāi le mén.
掏.en: Tom took out his key and opened the door.

掏.zh: 男子从口袋中掏出枪，吓了我一跳。
掏.py: Nán zǐ cóng kǒu dài zhōng tāo chū qiāng, xià le wǒ yí tiào.
掏.en: To my horror, the man took a gun out of his pocket.

陶瓷.py: Wǒ duì dōng fāng táo cí yǒu xìng qù.

淘气.py: Wǒ shòu bù liǎo táo qì de xiǎo hái.

淘汰.py: Dé guó bèi hán guó táo tài.
淘汰.en: Germany was eliminated by South Korea.

淘汰.zh: 在上一届世界杯上，新西兰在比赛中被墨西哥淘汰。
淘汰.py: Zài shàng yí jiè shì jiè bēi shàng, xīn xī lán zài bǐ sài zhōng bèi mò xī gē táo tài.
淘汰.en: In the last World Cup, New Zealand was knocked out of the competition by Mexico.

特色.py: Zhè lǐ de tè sè cài shì shén me?
特色.en: What is the specialty food here?

特色.zh: 你们这儿什么菜最有特色？
特色.py: Nǐ men zhè ér shén me cài zuì yǒu tè sè?

特长.py: Měi gè rén yǒu zì jǐ de tè cháng.
特长.en: Every man has his own strong points.

特长.py: Nín de tè cháng shì shén me?

提炼.zh: 油是从橄榄中提炼出来的。
提炼.py: Yóu shì cóng gǎn lǎn zhōng tí liàn chū lái de.

提示.zh: 你可以给我一个提示吗？
提示.py: Nǐ kě yǐ gěi wǒ yí gè tí shì ma?
提示.en: Would you give me a hint?

提示.py: Wǒ huì gěi nǐ xiē tí shì.
提示.en: I'll give you a little tip.

提议.zh: 你真笨去接受他的提议。
提议.py: Nǐ zhēn bèn qù jiē shòu tā de tí yì.
提议.en: It was foolish of you to accept his offer.

提议.zh: 他对我的提议不屑一顾。
提议.py: Tā duì wǒ de tí yì bú xiè yí gù.
提议.en: He wouldn't look at my proposal.

体谅.py: Wǒ men dé tǐ liàng tā nián qīng.
体谅.en: We should take into account she is still young.

体系.zh: 太阳系是银河系中一个小的天体系统。
体系.py: Tài yáng xì shì yín hé xì zhōng yí gè xiǎo de tiān tǐ xì tǒng.
体系.en: The solar system is a small celestial system in the Milky Way.

体系.zh: 庞大而精妙的体系往往建立在几个简单的规则之上。
体系.py: Páng dà ér jīng miào de tǐ xì wǎng wǎng jiàn lì zài jǐ gè jiǎn dān de guī zé zhī shàng.
体系.en: A vast and sophisticated system is usually based on a few simple rules.

天才.zh: 爱因斯坦是个数学天才。
天才.py: Ài yīn sī tǎn shì gè shù xué tiān cái.
Tā huàn xiǎng zì jǐ shì gè tiān cái.
天才.en: He had the illusion that he was a genius.

天然气.zh: 煤和天然气是天然燃料。
天然气.py: Méi hé tiān rán qì shì tiān rán rán liào.
天然气.en: Coal and natural gas are natural fuels.

天然气.zh: 你煮饭用天然气还是电力？
天然气.py: Nǐ zhǔ fàn yòng tiān rán qì hái shì diàn lì?
天然气.en: Do you cook by gas or electricity?

天生.zh: 他天生拥有完美的智慧。
天生.py: Tā tiān shēng yōng yǒu wán měi de zhì huì.
天生.en: He is gifted with perfect wisdom.

天生.zh: 汤姆天生就是个运动员。
天生.py: Tāng mǔ tiān shēng jiù shì gè yùn dòng yuán.

天堂.zh: 这个岛是孩子们的天堂。
天堂.py: Zhè ge dǎo shì hái zi men de tiān táng.
天堂.en: The island is a paradise for children.

天堂.zh: 我们会把人间变成天堂。
天堂.py: Wǒ men huì bǎ rén jiān biàn chéng tiān táng.
天堂.en: We will turn the world into a paradise.

天文.zh: 天文学涉及恒星和行星。
天文.py: Tiān wén xué shè jí héng xīng hé xíng xīng.
天文.en: Astronomy deals with the stars and planets.

天文.zh: 他好像对天文学挺有兴趣。
天文.py: Tā hǎo xiàng duì tiān wén xué tǐng yǒu xìng qù.
天文.en: It seems that he is interested in astronomy.

田径.zh: 田径运动会因天雨关系取消了。
田径.py: Tián jìng yùn dòng huì yīn tiān yǔ guān xì qǔ xiāo le.
田径.en: The track meet was called off on account of the heavy rain.

舔.zh: 其他人已经舔干净锅底了。
舔.py: Qí tā rén yǐ jīng tiǎn gān jìng guō dǐ le.
舔.en: The others have already licked the bottom of the pot.

舔.zh: 生活就像是舔仙人掌上的蜂蜜。
舔.py: Shēng huó jiù xiàng shì tiǎn xiān rén zhǎng shàng de fēng mì.
舔.en: Life is like licking honey off a cactus.

挑剔.zh: 你的想法简直无可挑剔。
挑剔.py: Nǐ de xiǎng fǎ jiǎn zhí wú kě tiāo tī.
挑剔.en: Your idea leaves nothing to be desired.

挑剔.zh: 他总是在挑剔别人的毛病。
挑剔.py: Tā zǒng shì zài tiāo tī bié rén de máo bìng.
挑剔.en: He is always finding fault with others.

挑衅.zh: 萨米对顾客变得更加挑衅了。
挑衅.py: Sà mǐ duì gù kè biàn de gèng jiā tiǎo xìn le.
挑衅.en: Sami became more aggressive with customers.

挑衅.py: Tā shì gè tiǎo xìn gāo shǒu.

条理.zh: 汤姆没有以前那么条理。
条理.py: Tāng mǔ méi yǒu yǐ qián nà me tiáo lǐ.
条理.en: Tom isn't as neat as he used to be.

条理.zh: 我是个有决心、有条理、有责任的人。
条理.py: Wǒ shì gè yǒu jué xīn, yǒu tiáo lǐ, yǒu zé rèn de rén.
条理.en: I'm a determined, organized, and responsible person.

条约.zh: 明明签订了互不侵犯条约，竟然还来攻击我们。
条约.py: Míng míng qiān dìng le hù bù qīn fàn tiáo yuē, jìng rán hái lái gōng jī wǒ men.
条约.en: They still attacked us, despite clearly agreeing to sign the non-aggression pact.

停顿.zh: 他不停顿地说了十分钟。
停顿.py: Tā bù tíng dùn dì shuō le shí fēn zhōng.
停顿.en: He spoke for ten minutes without a pause.

停滞.zh: 阿尔及尔从不停滞不前。
停滞.py: Ā ěr jí ěr cóng bù tíng zhì bù qián.

通货.py: Lì lǜ hé tōng huò péng zhàng hěn gāo.
通货.en: Interest rates and inflation were high.

通货.zh: 随着通货膨胀的发展美元贬值了。
通货.py: Suí zhe tōng huò péng zhàng de fā zhǎn měi yuán biǎn zhí le.
通货.en: The value of the dollar declines as the rate of inflation rises.

通用.zh: 在商朝，贝朋为通用货币。
通用.py: Zài shāng cháo, bèi péng wèi tōng yòng huò bì.
通用.en: Seashells were the legal tender in the Shang dynasty.

通用.zh: 英语是很多国家通用的语言。
通用.py: Yīng yǔ shì hěn duō guó jiā tōng yòng de yǔ yán.
通用.en: English is spoken in a lot of countries.

同胞.py: Tā bú yuàn yì wèi tóng bāo zuò zhèng.
同胞.en: He is not willing to testify for his compatriot.

同志.py: Xiàng léi fēng tóng zhì xué xí.
Kuài bù qián jìn, tóng zhì men!

童话.py: Shén xiān zhī zài tóng huà lǐ cún zài.
童话.en: Fairies exist only in fairy tales.

童话.py: Rèn rén wéi xián shì yí gè tóng huà.

统计.zh: 航空专家详细分析了统计数据。
统计.py: Háng kōng zhuān jiā xiáng xì fēn xī le tǒng jì shù jù.
统计.en: The aviation expert analyzed the statistics in detail.

统计.zh: 事实是倔强的，但统计是柔顺的。
统计.py: Shì shí shì jué jiàng de, dàn tǒng jì shì róu shùn de.
统计.en: Facts are stubborn things, but statistics are pliable.

统统.zh: 请给我统统说清楚什么时候在哪里发生了什么事。
统统.py: Qǐng gěi wǒ tǒng tǒng shuō qīng chǔ shén me shí hòu zài nǎ lǐ fā shēng le shén me shì.
统统.en: Please tell me in complete detail what occurred, when and where.

投降.zh: 如果汤姆不投降，就开枪
投降.py: Rú guǒ tāng mǔ bù tóu xiáng, jiù kāi qiāng
投降.en: If Tom doesn't surrender, shoot him.

投降.zh: 我们要向这个怪兽投降吗？
投降.py: Wǒ men yào xiàng zhè ge guài shòu tóu xiáng ma?
投降.en: Are we going to surrender to these monsters?

投票.zh: 他已经足够大去投票了
投票.py: Tā yǐ jīng zú gòu dà qù tóu piào le
投票.en: He's old enough to vote, isn't he?

投票.py: Wǒ yí dìng yào gěi tāng mǔ tóu piào.

投掷.zh: 警方将催泪弹投掷到了建筑中。
投掷.py: Jǐng fāng jiāng cuī lèi dàn tóu zhì dào le jiàn zhù zhōng.
投掷.en: The cops threw tear-gas bombs into the building.

投掷.zh: 事实上，投掷侏儒是奥运会的运动项目。
投掷.py: Shì shí shàng, tóu zhì zhū rú shì ào yùn huì de yùn dòng xiàng mù.
投掷.en: Indeed, dwarf tossing is an Olympic sport!

秃.zh: 他很年轻就开始秃头了。
秃.py: Tā hěn nián qīng jiù kāi shǐ tū tóu le.
秃.en: He started going bald quite young.

秃.zh: 他是个很安静的人，头顶有点秃。
秃.py: Tā shì gè hěn ān jìng de rén, tóu dǐng yǒu diǎn tū.
秃.en: He's a quiet man, a little bald on top.

突破.zh: 他们企图突破敌军的防线。
突破.py: Tā men qǐ tú tū pò dí jūn de fáng xiàn.
突破.en: They attempted to break through the enemy line.

突破.zh: 他在自然地理科学界取得了突破性的成果。
突破.py: Tā zài zì rán dì lǐ kē xué jiè qǔ dé le tū pò xìng de chéng guǒ.
突破.en: He did pioneering work in the field of physical geography.

图案.py: Wǒ zhù yì dào yí gè tú àn.

图案.zh: 墨汁用作染料时会产生有趣的图案。
图案.py: Mò zhī yòng zuò rǎn liào shí huì chǎn shēng yǒu qù de tú àn.
图案.en: India ink produces an interesting pattern when used as a dye.

途径.zh: 必须有外交解决的途径。
途径.py: Bì xū yǒu wài jiāo jiě jué de tú jìng.
途径.en: There must be a way to arrive at a diplomatic solution.

途径.zh: 他寻找一切可能的逃生途径。
途径.py: Tā xún zhǎo yí qiè kě néng de táo shēng tú jìng.
途径.en: He looked for every possible means of escape.

土壤.py: Tǔ rǎng bèi yǔ shuǐ chōng zǒu le.
土壤.en: The rain washed away the soil.

土壤.py: Zhè shì fēi cháng hǎo de tǔ rǎng.

涂抹.zh: 我把起酥油涂抹在鹿肉上。
涂抹.py: Wǒ bǎ qǐ sū yóu tú mǒ zài lù ròu shàng.
涂抹.en: I daub the venison with shortening.

涂抹.zh: 将它们放在烤盘上并且涂抹蛋白。
涂抹.py: Jiāng tā men fàng zài kǎo pán shàng bìng qiě tú mǒ dàn bái.
涂抹.en: Put them on the baking pan and smear them with egg whites.

团结.zh: 团结、公正和自由是幸福的保证。
团结.py: Tuán jié, gōng zhèng hé zì yóu shì xìng fú de bǎo zhèng.
团结.en: Unity, justice and freedom are the pledge of fortune.

团结.zh: 我们必须团结起来才能战胜敌人。
团结.py: Wǒ men bì xū tuán jié qǐ lái cái néng zhàn shèng dí rén.
团结.en: We need to band together to beat the enemy.

团体.zh: 他试着统一不同的团体。
团体.py: Tā shì zhe tǒng yī bù tóng de tuán tǐ.
团体.en: He tried to unify the various groups.

团体.zh: 四月是全国弱势团体医疗月。
团体.py: Sì yuè shì quán guó ruò shì tuán tǐ yī liáo yuè.
团体.en: April is the national minority health month.

推测.zh: 我在推测他可能赢得比赛。
推测.py: Wǒ zài tuī cè tā kě néng yíng dé bǐ sài.
推测.en: I am speculating that he may win the game.

推翻.zh: 预言被实验结果推翻了。
推翻.py: Yù yán bèi shí yàn jié guǒ tuī fān le.
推翻.en: The prediction was falsified by the result.

推翻.py: Fǎn dòng pài bèi rén mín suǒ tuī fān.
推翻.en: Reactionary groups were overthrown by the people.

推销.zh: 这位女士是不是推销员？
推销.py: Zhè wèi nǚ shì shì bu shì tuī xiāo yuán?
Wǒ bèi wù rèn wéi shì tuī xiāo yuán.
推销.en: I was mistaken for a salesman.

吞咽.zh: 食物在吞咽前要经过咀嚼。
吞咽.py: Shí wù zài tūn yàn qián yào jīng guò jǔ jué.
吞咽.en: Food should be chewed before being swallowed.

拖延.zh: 不要拖延去找工作的事。
拖延.py: Bú yào tuō yán qù zhǎo gōng zuò de shì.
拖延.en: Stop putting off finding a job.

拖延.zh: 我不像我以前那么拖延了。
拖延.py: Wǒ bú xiàng wǒ yǐ qián nà me tuō yán le.
拖延.en: I don't procrastinate as much as I used to.

脱离.zh: 他就是那样脱离危险的。
脱离.py: Tā jiù shì nà yàng tuō lí wēi xiǎn de.
脱离.en: That is how he got out of danger.

脱离.zh: 汤姆和瑪丽脱离了危险。
脱离.py: Tāng mǔ hé mǎ lì tuō lí le wēi xiǎn.
脱离.en: Tom and Mary are out of danger.

妥当.py: Kǒng pà zhè lǐ tí fǎ bù tuǒ dàng.
妥当.en: I'm afraid this is an incorrect formulation of the question.

妥当.py: Qì jīn, yí qiè tuǒ dàng.

妥善.py: Wǒ tuǒ shàn bǎo guǎn yuán bǎn kǎo bèi.
妥善.en: I keep the master copy under lock and key.

妥协.py: Wǒ men shì zhe hé tā men tuǒ xié.
妥协.en: We tried to compromise with them.

妥协.zh: 与其向命运妥协，我宁可自杀。
妥协.py: Yǔ qí xiàng mìng yùn tuǒ xié, wǒ nìng kě zì shā.
妥协.en: I would rather kill myself than reconcile myself to my fate.

椭圆.py: Tā yǒu yì zhāng tuǒ yuán xíng de liǎn.

娃娃.zh: 我做了一个洋娃娃给安。
娃娃.py: Wǒ zuò le yí gè yáng wá wa gěi ān.

娃娃.zh: 母亲给我做了一个娃娃。
娃娃.py: Mǔ qīn gěi wǒ zuò le yí gè wá wa.

哇.py: Wā, nǐ zài gàn shén me a?
Wā !  Hǎo jiǔ bú jiàn le.
哇.en: Wow! It's been a long time.

外表.py: Bù kě bèi tā de wài biǎo méng piàn.
外表.en: Don't be fooled by her appearance.

外表.py: Tā de wài biǎo qī piàn le wǒ.

外向.zh: 萊拉很外向、有爱心、会照顾人。
外向.py: Lái lā hěn wài xiàng, yǒu ài xīn, huì zhào gù rén.
外向.en: Layla was very outgoing, loving, and caring.

外行.zh: 外行谈策略，内行谈后勤。
外行.py: Wài háng tán cè lüè, nèi háng tán hòu qín.
外行.en: Amateurs talk strategy, professionals talk logistics.

外行.py: Wǒ nà shí hái shì gè wài háng.
外行.en: I was still an amateur at that time.

丸.zh: 章鱼小丸子真的很美味！
丸.py: Zhāng yú xiǎo wán zi zhēn de hěn měi wèi!

丸.zh: 炸肉丸不是一种健康的零食。
丸.py: Zhà ròu wán bú shì yì zhǒng jiàn kāng de líng shí.
丸.en: A frikandel is not a healthy snack.

完毕.zh: 请你在阅读完毕后归还此书。
完毕.py: Qǐng nǐ zài yuè dú wán bì hòu guī huán cǐ shū.
完毕.en: Please return the book when you have finished reading it.

玩弄.py: Nǐ bù gāi wán nòng tā de gǎn qíng.
玩弄.en: You should not trifle with his feelings.

玩意儿.zh: 能把那玩意儿递给我吗？
玩意儿.py: Néng bǎ nà wán yì ér dì gěi wǒ ma?
玩意儿.en: Can you pass me that thingamajig?

玩意儿.py: Nà wán yì ér zěn me zài zhè ér?

顽固.zh: 他年纪越大变得越顽固。
顽固.py: Tā nián jì yuè dà biàn de yuè wán gù.
顽固.en: He became more obstinate as he grew older.

顽固.zh: 烤箱内如有液体洒出，应立即清理，以免留下顽固污漬。
顽固.py: Kǎo xiāng nèi rú yǒu yè tǐ sǎ chū, yìng lì jí qīng lǐ, yǐ miǎn liú xià wán gù wū zì.
顽固.en: Clean up spills inside the oven as soon as they happen to avoid stubborn stains.

顽强.zh: 尽管受到暴君的迫害，英雄还顽强地斗争。
顽强.py: Jǐn guǎn shòu dào bào jūn de pò hài, yīng xióng hái wán qiáng dì dòu zhēng.
顽强.en: In spite of the tyrant’s persecution, the hero valiantly carried on the struggle.

万分.py: Wǒ gǎn dào wàn fēn jiāo lǜ.

万分.zh: 他因车祸受了重伤的消息让我震惊万分。
万分.py: Tā yīn chē huò shòu le zhòng shāng de xiāo xī ràng wǒ zhèn jīng wàn fēn.
万分.en: I am very much surprised to hear that he got badly injured in a motorcar accident.

网络.zh: 我在下载这份网络档案。
网络.py: Wǒ zài xià zài zhè fèn wǎng luò dàng àn.

网络.zh: 你最喜欢哪一个网络浏览器？
网络.py: Nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ yí gè wǎng luò liú lǎn qì?

往常.zh: 我和往常一样起得很早。
往常.py: Wǒ hé wǎng cháng yí yàng qǐ dé hěn zǎo.
往常.en: I got up early as usual.

往常.zh: 比尔一如往常上学迟到。
往常.py: Bǐ ěr yì rú wǎng cháng shàng xué chí dào.
往常.en: Bill was late for school as usual.

往事.zh: 照片使我忆起了很多往事。
往事.py: Zhào piàn shǐ wǒ yì qǐ le hěn duō wǎng shì.
往事.en: The picture brought back a lot of memories.

妄想.py: Nǐ wàng xiǎng. Shàng chuáng shuì jiào qù!

危机.zh: 牠们正面临绝种的危机。
危机.py: Tā men zhèng miàn lín jué zhǒng de wēi jī.
危机.en: They are in danger of extinction.

危机.zh: 他的公司没有从危机中幸存。
危机.py: Tā de gōng sī méi yǒu cóng wēi jī zhōng xìng cún.
危机.en: His company didn't survive the crisis.

威力.zh: 一名伟大的战士威力显着，无需抵死奋战。
威力.py: Yì míng wěi dà de zhàn shì wēi lì xiǎn zhe, wú xū dǐ sǐ fèn zhàn.
威力.en: A great warrior radiates strength. He doesn't have to fight to the death.

威信.py: Tā de wēi xìn rì jiàn shuāi luò.

违背.zh: 那违背了我做人的原则。
违背.py: Nà wéi bèi le wǒ zuò rén de yuán zé.

违背.zh: 他让我违背了我的意愿。
违背.py: Tā ràng wǒ wéi bèi le wǒ de yì yuàn.
违背.en: He made me go against my will.

唯独.zh: 快乐存在于过去和未来，唯独不存在于现在。
唯独.py: Kuài lè cún zài yú guò qù hé wèi lái, wéi dú bù cún zài yú xiàn zài.
唯独.en: Pleasure is always in the past or in the future, never in the present.

维持.zh: 你在东京如何维持生计？
维持.py: Nǐ zài dōng jīng rú hé wéi chí shēng jì?
维持.en: How did you make a living in Tokyo?

维持.zh: 维持一个人的声誉是很难的。
维持.py: Wéi chí yí gè rén de shēng yù shì hěn nán de.
维持.en: It is hard to maintain one's reputation.

维生素.zh: 水果富含维生素和矿物质。
维生素.py: Shuǐ guǒ fù hán wéi shēng sù hé kuàng wù zhì.
维生素.en: Fruits are rich in vitamins and minerals.

维修.zh: 我的磁带录音机需要维修。
维修.py: Wǒ de cí dài lù yīn jī xū yào wéi xiū.
维修.en: My cassette tape recorder needs fixing.

维修.py: Zhè jiān fáng zi yào wéi xiū le.
维修.en: This house must be done up.

伪造.py: Zhè shì yí gè wěi zào pǐn.
Qiān míng shì wěi zào de.
伪造.en: The signature had been a forgery.

委员.zh: 委员会由四个成员组成。
委员.py: Wěi yuán huì yóu sì gè chéng yuán zǔ chéng.
委员.en: The committee consists of four members.

委员.zh: 他是教区委员会的成员。
委员.py: Tā shì jiào qū wěi yuán huì de chéng yuán.
委员.en: He is a member of the parochial board.

卫星.zh: 月球是地球唯一的卫星。
卫星.py: Yuè qiú shì dì qiú wéi yī de wèi xīng.
卫星.en: The moon is the earth's only satellite.

卫星.zh: 许多卫星绕着土星运行。
卫星.py: Xǔ duō wèi xīng rào zhe tǔ xīng yùn xíng.

为难.zh: 那个团体为难民们提供食品供给。
为难.py: Nà ge tuán tǐ wéi nán mín men tí gōng shí pǐn gōng jǐ.
为难.en: The organization furnished the refugees with food.

为期.zh: 大多数学生都在为期末考试复习。
为期.py: Dà duō shù xué shēng dōu zài wéi qī mò kǎo shì fù xí.
为期.en: Most students are preparing for the final exams.

位于.zh: 城市位于日本的最北端。
位于.py: Chéng shì wèi yú rì běn de zuì běi duān.
位于.en: The city is at the northern end of Japan.

位于.zh: 加拿大位于美国的北面。
位于.py: Jiā ná dà wèi yú měi guó de běi miàn.
位于.en: Canada is to the north of the United States.

畏惧.zh: 天使畏惧处, 愚人敢闯入。
畏惧.py: Tiān shǐ wèi jù chù ,  yú rén gǎn chuǎng rù.
畏惧.en: Fools rush in where angels fear to tread.

畏惧.py: Wǒ men bú wèi jù rèn hé kùn nán.
畏惧.en: We're not afraid of any difficulties.

胃口.py: Duō kuī nǐ wǒ wèi kǒu dōu méi le.
胃口.en: Thanks to you I've lost my appetite.

胃口.py: Zhè ge cài hěn duì wèi kǒu.

温带.py: Wǒ guó shì wēn dài qì hòu.

温和.zh: 这个国家的气候很温和。
温和.py: Zhè ge guó jiā de qì hòu hěn wēn hé.
温和.en: This country has a mild climate.

温和.zh: 总体上说，日本的气候温和。
温和.py: Zǒng tǐ shàng shuō, rì běn de qì hòu wēn hé.
温和.en: Generally speaking, the climate of Japan is mild.

文物.zh: 爱护文物, 人人有责。
文物.py: Ài hù wén wù ,  rén rén yǒu zé.
文物.en: It is everyone's duty to cherish cultural relics.

文献.zh: 你必须每天背一篇古典文献。
文献.py: Nǐ bì xū měi tiān bèi yì piān gǔ diǎn wén xiàn.
文献.en: You should memorize a piece of classical literature every day.

文艺.py: Tā shì wén yì qīng nián.

窝.zh: 一窝黄蜂袭击了孩子们。
窝.py: Yì wō huáng fēng xí jī le hái zi men.
窝.en: A swarm of hornets attacked the children.

窝.zh: 金窝银窝不如自己的狗窝。
窝.py: Jīn wō yín wō bù rú zì jǐ de gǒu wō.
窝.en: Be it ever so humble, there's no place like home.

诬陷.py: Tā bèi qī zǐ wū xiàn le.
诬陷.en: He was framed by his wife.

无比.zh: 伤口发炎后，他感到难忍无比的剧痛。
无比.py: Shāng kǒu fā yán hòu, tā gǎn dào nán rěn wú bǐ de jù tòng.
无比.en: When the wound got infected, he experienced a bout of unbearable pain.

无偿.zh: 我愿意无偿接下这件活。
无偿.py: Wǒ yuàn yì wú cháng jiē xià zhè jiàn huó.
无偿.en: I'd be willing to do that for free.

无耻.zh: 我受够了他的厚颜无耻。
无耻.py: Wǒ shòu gòu le tā de hòu yán wú chǐ.
无耻.en: I've had quite enough of his impudence.

无耻.py: Nǐ rèn wéi tāng mǔ hěn wú chǐ ma?
无耻.en: Do you think Tom is unscrupulous?

无从.en: I have no way of knowing that.

无从.zh: 这首诗是不是莎士比亚写的，恐怕是无从考究的了。
无从.py: Zhè shǒu shī shì bu shì shā shì bǐ yà xiě de, kǒng pà shì wú cóng kǎo jiū de le.
无从.en: Whether Shakespeare wrote this poem or not will probably remain a mystery.

无非.zh: 他无非是别人的跟屁虫。
无非.py: Tā wú fēi shì bié rén de gēn pì chóng.

无可奉告.zh: 对于这个问题我无可奉告。
无可奉告.py: Duì yú zhè ge wèn tí wǒ wú kě fèng gào.
无可奉告.en: I have nothing to say with regard to that problem.

无赖.zh: 这条街的居民大多是无赖。
无赖.py: Zhè tiáo jiē de jū mín dà duō shì wú lài.
无赖.en: Most of the residents on this street are wrong 'uns.

无赖.py: Tāng mǔ shì gè wú lài.

无理取闹.py: Tā zài wú lǐ qǔ nào.

无能为力.zh: 他无能为力，只好放弃计划
无能为力.py: Tā wú néng wéi lì, zhǐ hǎo fàng qì jì huà
无能为力.en: He could do nothing but give up his plan against his will.

无能为力.py: Wǒ duì cǐ wú néng wéi lì.
无能为力.en: There's nothing I can do about it.

无穷无尽.py: Yǔ zhòu wú qióng wú jìn.

无微不至.zh: 这位建筑师显然是一位无微不至的建筑师。
无微不至.py: Zhè wèi jiàn zhù shī xiǎn rán shì yí wèi wú wēi bú zhì de jiàn zhù shī.
无微不至.en: You can see that the architect paid scrupulous attention to detail.

无忧无虑.zh: 只有少数的人是无忧无虑的。
无忧无虑.py: Zhǐ yǒu shǎo shù de rén shì wú yōu wú lǜ de.
无忧无虑.en: Few people are free from cares.

无忧无虑.zh: 他在乡村里过着无忧无虑的生活。
无忧无虑.py: Tā zài xiāng cūn lǐ guò zhe wú yōu wú lǜ de shēng huó.
无忧无虑.en: He is leading an easy life in the country.

无知.py: Tā cháng cháng lì yòng tā de wú zhī.
无知.en: She often takes advantage of his ignorance.

无知.py: Tāng mǔ shì gè wú zhī de shǎ zǐ.

武装.py: Tā men yòng qiāng wǔ zhuāng zì jǐ.
Tā wǔ zhuāng dào yá chǐ.
武装.en: He is armed to the teeth.

侮辱.py: Tāng mǔ méi xiǎng wǔ rǔ shuí.
侮辱.en: Tom didn't mean to insult anybody.

舞蹈.py: Bèi dì shì yí gè wǔ dǎo lǎo shī.
Kuí chéng wéi yí gè wǔ dǎo jiā.

勿.zh: 如有火警，切勿使用升降机。
勿.py: Rú yǒu huǒ jǐng, qiè wù shǐ yòng shēng jiàng jī.
勿.en: In case of fire, do not use the lift.

勿.py: Qǐng wù gěi yě shēng dòng wù wèi shí.
勿.en: Please don't feed the wild animals.

物美价廉.py: Zhēn shì wù měi jià lián.
Wū zi wù měi jià lián.
物美价廉.en: The house looked good; moreover, the price was right.

物资.zh: 那个国家拥有丰富的矿物资源。
物资.py: Nà ge guó jiā yōng yǒu fēng fù de kuàng wù zī yuán.
物资.en: That country is rich in mineral resources.

物资.zh: 救助人员将为地震受灾者发放物资。
物资.py: Jiù zhù rén yuán jiāng wèi dì zhèn shòu zāi zhě fā fàng wù zī.
物资.en: The rescue workers are going to hand out supplies to the victims of the earthquake.

误解.zh: 他们的争吵因误解而起。
误解.py: Tā men de zhēng chǎo yīn wù jiě ér qǐ.
Wǒ men kě néng wù jiě tā le.

务必.zh: 请务必确认门是锁着的。
务必.py: Qǐng wù bì què rèn mén shì suǒ zhe de.
务必.en: Please make sure that the door is locked.

务必.py: Nǐ wù bì yào hǎo hǎo dì xiū xi.
务必.en: Make sure you get plenty of rest.

夕阳.zh: 你看过这么美的夕阳吗?
夕阳.py: Nǐ kàn guò zhè me měi de xī yáng ma ?
夕阳.en: Have you ever seen such a beautiful sunset?

夕阳.py: Měi lì de xī yáng, bú shì ma?

吸取.zh: 你必须从失败中吸取教训。
吸取.py: Nǐ bì xū cóng shī bài zhōng xī qǔ jiào xùn.

吸取.zh: 我希望汤姆已经吸取教训了。
吸取.py: Wǒ xī wàng tāng mǔ yǐ jīng xī qǔ jiào xùn le.
吸取.en: I hope that Tom has learned his lesson.

昔日.zh: 这些照片总是让我想起昔日时光。
昔日.py: Zhè xiē zhào piàn zǒng shì ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ xī rì shí guāng.
昔日.en: These pictures always remind me of the old days.

牺牲.py: Tā xī shēng shēng mìng, chū mài zǔ zhī.
牺牲.en: He sacrificed his life and betrayed the organization.

牺牲.zh: 士兵们已经准备好为国牺牲了。
牺牲.py: Shì bīng men yǐ jīng zhǔn bèi hǎo wèi guó xī shēng le.
牺牲.en: The soldiers were ready to die for their country.

溪.py: Xī shuǐ liú jìn zhè ge chí táng lǐ.
溪.en: The stream flows into the pond.

溪.zh: 他家后面有小溪，清可见底。
溪.py: Tā jiā hòu miàn yǒu xiǎo xī, qīng kě jiàn dǐ.
溪.en: Behind his house is a stream so clear that you can see the bottom of it.

熄灭.py: Huǒ zì rán xī miè le.
熄灭.en: The fire went out by itself.

熄灭.py: Là zhú zì rán xī miè.
熄灭.en: The candle went out by itself.

膝盖.zh: 他从腰部到膝盖都湿了。
膝盖.py: Tā cóng yāo bù dào xī gài dōu shī le.
膝盖.en: He got wet from the waist to the knees.

膝盖.zh: 玛丽处理了膝盖的伤口。
膝盖.py: Mǎ lì chǔ lǐ le xī gài de shāng kǒu.

习俗.zh: 那习俗已经不再盛行了。
习俗.py: Nà xí sú yǐ jīng bú zài shèng xíng le.
习俗.en: That tradition has fallen into desuetude.

习俗.zh: 不同的国家有不同的习俗。
习俗.py: Bù tóng de guó jiā yǒu bù tóng de xí sú.
习俗.en: Each country has its own customs.

袭击.zh: 一窝黄蜂袭击了孩子们。
袭击.py: Yì wō huáng fēng xí jī le hái zi men.
袭击.en: A swarm of hornets attacked the children.

袭击.py: Wǒ men bèi bào fēng yǔ xí jī le.
袭击.en: We were caught in a storm.

媳妇.py: Nǐ xí fù zěn me yàng, tāng mǔ?

媳妇.zh: 婆婆和媳妇就像是暴风雨和冰雹。
媳妇.py: Pó po hé xí fù jiù xiàng shì bào fēng yǔ hé bīng báo.
媳妇.en: Mother-in-law and daughter-in-law are a tempest and hailstorm.

喜悦.zh: 爱把喜悦带给所有的生命。
喜悦.py: Ài bǎ xǐ yuè dài gěi suǒ yǒu de shēng mìng.
喜悦.en: Love is what gives joy to all creation.

喜悦.zh: 她的眼睛闪烁着喜悦的光芒。
喜悦.py: Tā de yǎn jīng shǎn shuò zhe xǐ yuè de guāng máng.
喜悦.en: Her eyes were shining with joy.

系列.zh: 他们办了一系列的音乐会。
系列.py: Tā men bàn le yí xì liè de yīn yuè huì.
系列.en: They gave a series of concerts.

系列.zh: 他刚发表一系列有趣的文章。
系列.py: Tā gāng fā biǎo yí xì liè yǒu qù de wén zhāng.
系列.en: He has just published an interesting series of articles.

细胞.zh: 癌细胞已经扩散到她的胃。
细胞.py: Ái xì bāo yǐ jīng kuò sàn dào tā de wèi.
细胞.en: The cancer has spread to her stomach.

细胞.zh: 人体的组织是由细胞构成的。
细胞.py: Rén tǐ de zǔ zhī shì yóu xì bāo gòu chéng de.
细胞.en: Human tissue is made up of cells.

细菌.zh: 细菌微小到无法用肉眼看到。
细菌.py: Xì jūn wēi xiǎo dào wú fǎ yòng ròu yǎn kàn dào.
细菌.en: Bacteria are so small that they cannot be seen with the naked eye.

细菌.zh: 手机如同马桶一样被细菌污染。
细菌.py: Shǒu jī rú tóng mǎ tǒng yí yàng bèi xì jūn wū rǎn.
细菌.en: A cell phone is as contaminated with bacteria as a toilet is.

细致.py: Xì zhì dì xuǎn zé yì běn shū.

细致.zh: 这两张图片之间有细致的差异。
细致.py: Zhè liǎng zhāng tú piàn zhī jiān yǒu xì zhì de chā yì.
细致.en: There are subtle differences between the two pictures.

峡谷.py: Xiá gǔ duì tā lái shuō fēi cháng shēn.
峡谷.en: The gorge looked very deep to him.

峡谷.zh: 铁桥峡谷是联合国教科文组织世界遗产。
峡谷.py: Tiě qiáo xiá gǔ shì lián hé guó jiào kē wén zǔ zhī shì jiè yí chǎn.
峡谷.en: Ironbridge Gorge is a Unesco world heritage site.

狭隘.zh: 别让狭隘的人让你相信你的梦想过于宏大。
狭隘.py: Bié ràng xiá ài de rén ràng nǐ xiāng xìn nǐ de mèng xiǎng guò yú hóng dà.
狭隘.en: Don't let narrow-minded people convince you that your dreams are too big.

狭窄.py: Zhè ge jiǎo dù huì guò yú xiá zhǎi.
狭窄.en: The angle would be too narrow.

狭窄.zh: 他在一条狭窄的道路上走。
狭窄.py: Tā zài yì tiáo xiá zhǎi de dào lù shang zǒu.
狭窄.en: The man is hiking on a narrow path.

霞.py: Kè lā wá jí dù liǔ xiá.

先进.zh: 美国的太空科技十分先进。
先进.py: Měi guó de tài kōng kē jì shí fēn xiān jìn.
先进.en: America is ahead in space technology.

先进.zh: 这个国家的军事力量很先进。
先进.py: Zhè ge guó jiā de jūn shì lì liàng hěn xiān jìn.
先进.en: The military power of this country is very advanced.

先前.zh: 我先前在中国住了六个月。
先前.py: Wǒ xiān qián zài zhōng guó zhù le liù gè yuè.
先前.en: I've lived in China for six months.

先前.zh: 我们先前不知道要怎么做，所以才求助。
先前.py: Wǒ men xiān qián bù zhī dào yào zěn me zuò, suǒ yǐ cái qiú zhù.
先前.en: We didn't know how to do it, so we asked for help.

纤维.zh: 你要吃多点含膳食纤维的食物。
纤维.py: Nǐ yào chī duō diǎn hán shàn shí xiān wéi de shí wù.
纤维.en: You need to eat more fiber.

掀起.zh: 微风在湖面上掀起了一丝丝漣漪。
掀起.py: Wēi fēng zài hú miàn shàng xiān qǐ le yì sī sī lián yī.
掀起.en: A gentle wind made ripples on the surface of the pond.

鲜明.zh: 广场被鲜明的灯火照亮。
鲜明.py: Guǎng chǎng bèi xiān míng de dēng huǒ zhào liàng.
鲜明.en: The square was illuminated by bright lights.

弦.zh: 你会弹都塔尔二弦琴吗？
弦.py: Nǐ huì tán dōu tǎ ěr èr xián qín ma?

弦.zh: 我弄断了我吉他的一根弦。
弦.py: Wǒ nòng duàn le wǒ jí tā de yì gēn xián.
弦.en: I broke a string on my guitar.

嫌.zh: 多听不多言, 里外人不嫌。
嫌.py: Duō tīng bù duō yán ,  lǐ wài rén bù xián.
嫌.en: He that hears much and speaks not at all shall be welcome both in bower and hall.

嫌.zh: 嫌疑人是一位白人女性。
嫌.py: Xián yí rén shì yí wèi bái rén nǚ xìng.
嫌.en: The suspect is a caucasian female.

嫌疑.zh: 嫌疑人是一位白人女性。
嫌疑.py: Xián yí rén shì yí wèi bái rén nǚ xìng.
嫌疑.en: The suspect is a caucasian female.

嫌疑.py: Liǎng gè zhēn tàn gēn zhe xián yí rén.

现场.py: Zhè lǐ jiù shì yì wài xiàn chǎng le.
现场.en: This is the place where the incident happened.

现场.py: Jǐng fāng jiāng hěn kuài dào dá xiàn chǎng.
现场.en: The police will soon arrive on the scene.

线索.zh: 警方没有发现任何线索。
线索.py: Jǐng fāng méi yǒu fā xiàn rèn hé xiàn suǒ.
线索.en: The police didn't find any clues.

线索.zh: 这封信是揭开谜团的唯一线索。
线索.py: Zhè fēng xìn shì jiē kāi mí tuán de wéi yī xiàn suǒ.
线索.en: This letter is the only key to the mystery.

宪法.zh: 思想自由为宪法所保障。
宪法.py: Sī xiǎng zì yóu wèi xiàn fǎ suǒ bǎo zhàng.
宪法.en: Freedom of thought is guaranteed by the constitution.

宪法.py: Píng děng shì yóu xiàn fǎ bǎo zhàng de.
宪法.en: Equality is guaranteed by the Constitution.

陷入.py: Tā gù yì lìng tā xiàn rù xiǎn jìng.
陷入.en: He deliberately exposed her to danger.

陷入.zh: 他发言完后，大家陷入了沉默。
陷入.py: Tā fā yán wán hòu, dà jiā xiàn rù le chén mò.
陷入.en: When he finished speaking, everyone was silent.

相等.zh: 修饰名词的东西（形容词，或形容词相等语）。
相等.py: Xiū shì míng cí de dōng xī （xíng róng cí, huò xíng róng cí xiāng děng yǔ）.
相等.en: Things that modify nouns (adjective, or adjectival equivalent).

相应.zh: 我们应该了解相应的规则。
相应.py: Wǒ men yīng gāi liǎo jiě xiāng yìng de guī zé.
相应.en: We are supposed to know the rules.

镶嵌.zh: 王冠上镶嵌着数十颗光彩夺目的宝石。
镶嵌.py: Wáng guān shàng xiāng qiàn zhāo shù shí kē guāng cǎi duó mù dì bǎo shí.
镶嵌.en: The crown is adorned with dozens of divinely lustrous gemstones.

响亮.py: Xíng dòng bǐ yǔ yán gèng xiǎng liàng.

想方设法.zh: 她想方设法以一己之力完成了工作。
想方设法.py: Tā xiǎng fāng shè fǎ yǐ yì jǐ zhī lì wán chéng le gōng zuò.
想方设法.en: She managed to finish the work on her own.

向导.py: Tā dān rèn wǒ de xiàng dǎo.

向来.py: Nǐ yí xiàng lái dōu hěn hǎo.

向往.py: Měi gè rén dōu xiàng wǎng xìng fú.

向往.zh: 我向往着和她一起看那部电影.
向往.py: Wǒ xiàng wǎng zhe hé tā yì qǐ kàn nà bù diàn yǐng .
向往.en: I'm looking forward to seeing the film with her.

巷.py: Wǒ zài xiǎo xiàng zi lǐ zhuǎn xiàng le.
巷.en: I turned into a small alleyway.

巷.zh: 幸好，在狄马睡觉的小巷外面，刚好有一家阿瑪尼。
巷.py: Xìng hǎo, zài dí mǎ shuì jiào de xiǎo xiàng wài miàn, gāng hǎo yǒu yì jiā ā mǎ ní.
巷.en: Thankfully, there was an Armani store just outside the alley where Dima had slept.

消除.zh: 能付出爱心就是福，能消除烦恼就是慧。
消除.py: Néng fù chū ài xīn jiù shì fú, néng xiāo chú fán nǎo jiù shì huì.
消除.en: Knowing how to love is success; knowing how to relax is wisdom.

消除.zh: 美国的任务是将共产主义从世界上消除。
消除.py: Měi guó de rèn wu shì jiāng gòng chǎn zhǔ yì cóng shì jiè shàng xiāo chú.
消除.en: The American mission is to eliminate communism from the world.

消毒.zh: 雅尼刚刚对他的挤奶桶进行了消毒。
消毒.py: Yǎ ní gāng gāng duì tā de jǐ nǎi tǒng jìn xíng le xiāo dú.
消毒.en: Yanni has just sterilized his milking bucket.

消防.zh: 消防局在警察局的旁边。
消防.py: Xiāo fáng jú zài jǐng chá jú de páng biān.
消防.en: The fire station is next to the police station.

消防.zh: 消防队很快就把大火扑熄。
消防.py: Xiāo fáng duì hěn kuài jiù bǎ dà huǒ pū xī.
消防.en: The firemen quickly extinguished the blaze.

消耗.zh: 农业需要消耗大量的水。
消耗.py: Nóng yè xū yào xiāo hào dà liàng de shuǐ.
消耗.en: Agriculture consumes a great amount of water.

消耗.py: Ruì shì rén xiāo hào bù shǎo pí jiǔ.
消耗.en: The Swiss consume a large amount of beer.

消极.py: Tā de xìng gé hěn xiāo jí.

销毁.zh: 这则讯息将在五秒后自动销毁。
销毁.py: Zhè zé xùn xī jiāng zài wǔ miǎo hòu zì dòng xiāo huǐ.
销毁.en: This message will self-destruct in five seconds.

销毁.py: Wǒ men dé xiāo huǐ zhèng jù.

小心翼翼.zh: 警察小心翼翼地抬起箱子。
小心翼翼.py: Jǐng chá xiǎo xīn yì yì dì tái qǐ xiāng zǐ.
小心翼翼.en: The policeman lifted the box carefully.

小心翼翼.zh: 我妈妈小心翼翼地打开门。
小心翼翼.py: Wǒ mā ma xiǎo xīn yì yì dì dǎ kāi mén.
小心翼翼.en: My mother opened the door very carefully.

肖像.zh: 墙上有一张鲍勃的肖像画。
肖像.py: Qiáng shàng yǒu yì zhāng bào bó de xiào xiàng huà.
肖像.en: There is a portrait of Bob on the wall.

肖像.zh: 墙上挂着一幅鮑勃的肖像。
肖像.py: Qiáng shàng guà zhe yì fú bào bó de xiào xiàng.
肖像.en: There is a portrait of Bob on the wall.

协会.zh: 这个协会有三十个会员。
协会.py: Zhè ge xié huì yǒu sān shí gè huì yuán.
Wǒ shēn qǐng chéng wéi xié huì huì yuán.
协会.en: I applied for membership in the association.

协商.zh: “中国人民政治协商会议”的简称是“人民政协”。
协商.py: "zhōng guó rén mín zhèng zhì xié shāng huì yì" de jiǎn chēng shì "rén mín zhèng xié".
协商.en: The abbreviation of "Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference" is "CPPCC".

协议.zh: 汤姆和玛丽达成了协议。
协议.py: Tāng mǔ hé mǎ lì dá chéng le xié yì.
协议.en: Tom and Mary came to an understanding.

协议.py: Zuì hòu wǒ men dá chéng le xié yì.
协议.en: In the end, we reached a compromise.

协助.py: Nín xū yào wǒ men de xié zhù ma?
Nǐ xū yào wǒ men de xié zhù ma?

携带.zh: 这个箱子太重了无法携带。
携带.py: Zhè ge xiāng zǐ tài zhòng le wú fǎ xié dài.
携带.en: The box is too heavy to carry.

携带.py: Xié dài wǔ qì shì wéi fǎ de.
携带.en: It's against the law to carry weapons.

写作.zh: 我每天早上在公园写作。
写作.py: Wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng zài gōng yuán xiě zuò.
写作.en: In the morning, I write in the park.

写作.zh: 别指望我会帮你写作业。
写作.py: Bié zhǐ wàng wǒ huì bāng nǐ xiě zuò yè.
写作.en: Don't expect me to help you with your homework.

泄露.zh: 在这点上他泄露了秘密。
泄露.py: Zài zhè diǎn shàng tā xiè lòu le mì mì.
泄露.en: He let out the secret regarding this matter.

泄露.zh: 不要把这些资料泄露出去。
泄露.py: Bú yào bǎ zhè xiē zī liào xiè lòu chū qù.
泄露.en: Keep this information under your hat.

屑.zh: 他对我的提议不屑一顾。
屑.py: Tā duì wǒ de tí yì bú xiè yí gù.
屑.en: He wouldn't look at my proposal.
